"Does that imply that you want my mother to be your woman too? Otherwise, you would never offer such a thing to her, and you guys just finished making out, which was her first experience doing such a thing with a man."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed softly when he heard that. "Hey, your mother is one of the most beautiful women I've ever met, and no other man has ever touched her, so it's natural that I want her to be my woman, right?"

"Humph!" Janette snorted at that. "You are a perverted and lustful incubus, and you even ate your own mother, so I shouldn't be surprised if you have an interest in my mother. However, you are right that my mother is one of the most beautiful women in this realm, and Leon has long been infatuated with her, but she repeatedly rejected him.
Fortunately, he is a person who always adheres to principles and self-respect, so he never forced her to become his queen."

"Hehe! Leon may be one of the rulers in this realm, but he will never succeed in getting Lillea because she will be mine sooner or later, so he can keep dreaming of getting her." Janette facepalmed after hearing that, but she did not deny Zhang Fei's words, especially since she herself had tasted his yang qi and experienced his prowess in bed, and she was truly addicted to both.

"Anyway, I found a blood demon tree in the Sky Jade Realm, and it brought trouble to the cultivators there, so I uprooted it and kept it in my other private place. However, if I leave it there for too long, its demon miasma will cause my wives to die and transform into mindless demons.
Since this realm is a demon realm, I thought about moving it here, and the demon miasma might be useful for you guys, but we must plant it in a place that other demons can't reach."
"A blood demon tree?" Zhang Fei nodded to Janette, who immediately thought of the best place to plant the tree. "I think I know a place for that, but we have to meet Milia at the city gate first."

A few moments later, they arrived at the city gates, where the three Dryads suddenly appeared in front of them, and one of them immediately spoke to him. "Zhang Fei! You should change into your fox form, so I can carry you in my arms."

Zhang Fei smiled bitterly while listening to Cassia's request, and the other two Dryads also agreed with her. However, Janette immediately stopped them. "He's still busy right now, so he doesn't have time for you guys. Anyway, I want to take him to the secret garden, so I want you to take us there, Milia."
"Eh?" Janette's request momentarily stunned Milia. "Princess, that-"

"It's okay; you don't need to think about that." Janette interrupted Milia as she hugged Zhang Fei's waist. "He's my man, so he's now part of us. My mother also likes him, so I'm sure she won't forbid him from entering that place."
"All right, I will lead you two there." Milia then turned to the other two. "You two must guard our gate well, and I will be back soon."
Cassia and Viola wore disappointed looks as they looked at Zhang Fei's back, especially since they were so eager to have fun with Zhang Fei's fox form, but he just left them behind.
'Hey, Mei, show me the status of the three dryads.'
[Alrighty!]

Rank: Viscountess

Abilities: Charm, Life Absorption, Shapeshifting, Ecological Empathy, Mind Link, Knowledge Replication
Strong: Wood
Weak: Metal, Fire

'Hmm? Milia's plant generation, Cassia's forest manipulation, and Viola's knowledge replication all seem interesting.' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered as he read their status. 'What are the uses of their three abilities, Mei?'
[I will show them to you, Master.]

[Forest manipulation: The user can create, shape, and manipulate the forests (including jungles, taiga, rainforests, woodlands, etc.) and everything in them, including all the aspects of the forests.]

[Plant generation: The user can generate plants, including vines, moss, fungi, and parts of the plants, such as leaves, seeds, fruits, and flowers, whether by drawing them from already existing plants, or by manifesting them wherever they want.]

[Knowledge replication: The user can replicate any kind of knowledge, be it knowledge of a subject, a foreign language, or mastery of a fighting style. They can duplicate information from creatures or inanimate media of data, such as books, etc.]

Zhang Fei wasn't very interested in Milia's plant generation because he wasn't a long-range fighter, and Cassia's forest manipulation was quite interesting to him, but he didn't feel like he needed it that much.

However, Viola's knowledge replication piqued his interest greatly, especially since it could help him learn new things, and it would be even better if combined with the comprehension feature in his training space. 'Hehe, I need to get close to Viola and imitate her knowledge replication as quickly as possible, so I can learn new techniques faster.'

[Viola's knowledge replication is indeed useful for you, Master. However, I think you should also mimic Milia's plant generation and Cassia's forest manipulation, and both of them might be useful to you someday. Moreover, your demon mimicry has no limits, so there's no harm in mimicking them, right?]

'Yeah, you're right about that.' Zhang Fei replied with a nod of agreement, but he also still felt amazed by the system and all the abilities contained in it, which gave him extraordinary privileges compared to other cultivators, beasts, or demons. 'Okay, I'll speak with them later; I'm certain they won't mind if I give them a kiss.'

After they walked for some time, Zhang Fei and the others arrived in front of a small waterfall, and Milia immediately led them into the waterfall before arriving in front of a dead path, confusing him.

However, Milia immediately touched the wall at the end of the road and muttered the dryad's native language, and the wall suddenly turned into many tree branches before moving away to both sides. Soon, Zhang Fei could see the beauty of the garden behind it, which was filled with various kinds of trees and flower plants.
"I didn't expect there to be a hidden garden in this kind of place, and other demons don't seem to be able to find this place."

"Haha." Janette laughed as she pulled Zhang Fei into the garden. "Honestly, this garden is a legacy of our ancestors, so only a few people know about it and can open it, and Milia is one of them. Even I, as the dryad princess, couldn't open this place, so I brought her with us."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding before turning to Milia. "Can you help me with something?"

Hearing that, Janette immediately raised her eyebrows, assuming that Zhang Fei was also targeting Milia to become his woman. 'Tch! This lustful incubus! Sooner or later, all the dryads in this forest will fall into his arms, and he will probably become the first dryad king!'
Unfortunately, Janette misunderstood her intentions, especially since Zhang Fei wasn't interested in Milia, and she only wanted to obtain her plant generation ability.
"Since my princess recognizes you as her man, then you are part of us, and I will definitely help you." Zhang Fei smiled while listening to Milia's answer. "What kind of help do you need from me?"
"I want to kiss you."
"Huh?" Milia was stunned for a moment before turning to Janette with a look full of questions, especially since Zhang Fei was her princess, and she was her princess.
"It's okay; you can let him kiss you, and he won't do anything else to you."
Milia nodded to Janette, then looked at Zhang Fei again. "Since my princess gave her permission, you can kiss me."
Wasting no time, Zhang Fei stood in front of Milia and kissed her lips directly, but he didn't do anything else to her, and he only mimicked her ability.
[Ding]
[You succeeded in mimicking the plant generation of a Dryad named Milia.]

As soon as the notification appeared, Zhang Fei immediately moved away from Milia and used his new ability, leaving her stunned, especially when two new flower plants appeared beside him, which was the effect of her own ability.
"Haha!" Zhang Fei was overjoyed after doing so. "Milia, your ability to create new plants is really good, and I can use it to do several things."
"How can you imitate my abilities?" While wearing a confused look, Milia asked Zhang Fei.

Janette immediately patted Milia's shoulder. "You don't need to be confused about that; he is indeed a strange creature, so he can do some things beyond our understanding, and he has also mimicked my and my mother's abilities before."
Milia didn't deny that, especially since she herself had seen Zhang Fei's three forms, and there had never been another human or demon like her before.
'Open the portal to the training space, Mei.'

As soon as Mei opened the portal to the training space, Janette and Milia frowned, and Zhang Fei immediately brought the blood demon tree out from inside, making its demon miasma quickly fill the garden. However, the trees and flower plants in that place seemed unaffected by it, and instead they absorbed it greedily.

Seeing that, the two Dryads immediately tried to absorb the miasma, but they didn't feel any changes in their bodies, confusing them, so Zhang Fei spoke to them to explain. "Honestly, I myself don't know what effect this demon miasma will have on us, especially since I've absorbed quite a lot of it before, but I haven't been able to feel any significant changes in my body.
Perhaps the effect won't work immediately, and we might have to wait quite a long time to know the true effects."

Both Dryad nodded in understanding at Zhang Fei, and Milia pointed toward the garden's center. "In that case, you can plant this tree over there, so I can help you monitor it, and I will inform you if there are any changes that occur to the plants in this place."

Zhang Fei immediately rushed there and planted the blood demon tree in the center of the garden. He then took Janette to leave the garden with his teleportation, especially since he wanted to complete his daily quest as soon as possible.

Meanwhile, Milia approached the blood demon tree, squatted beside it, and touched the black leaves with her fingers. After that, she informed her queen about the blood demon, and Lillea quickly arrived at the garden and checked it. "I don't know where Zhang Fei got this black tree, but I can feel a strong aura from it, even though it hasn't reached maturity yet.
That's why you have to keep watching it carefully; it might be able to help us protect ourselves from the army of the rulers."
"Yes, my Queen."

chapters.title: Chapter 206: The Diyu Realm History
paragraphs: This time, Zhang Fei didn't go to the forest, but he took Janette to a high plateau, which was quite far from the Dryad Forest, especially after she told him there were quite a lot of strong demon beasts in that place, and one of them was the harpies. Moreover, a large number of gargoyles, possessing useful abilities, inhabited an abandoned castle nearby.

"See that? That abandoned castle still stands even though it has been abandoned for thousands of years, and it was the residence of the first demon lord." Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows as he observed the castle seriously, and Janette then pointed at the floating ancient black castle in the sky.

"In the past, the first demon lord found a cave filled with strange rocks, and the rocks could float by themselves, so he ordered his followers to use them to build it. Since then, he has abandoned this castle and relocated there, only to mysteriously vanish along with his twelve aides."

Zhang Fei immediately turned to Janette. "How could someone as powerful as the demon lord mysteriously disappear? Moreover, you previously told me that the last demon lord also disappeared without a trace, so I felt that it was really strange that two powerful demons could disappear just like that."

"It's not just you who feel strange about their disappearance; all of the demons in this realm also feel strange about it." Janette released a heavy sigh before continuing. "Many of them have tried searching for their whereabouts in all corners of this world, including my ancestors.
Unfortunately, they never managed to find the two of them, so they suspect that their disappearance has something to do with people from the Xian and Tian Realms."
"People from the Xian and Tian Realms?" Janette nodded to Zhang Fei, and he suddenly remembered something. "Hey, what exactly are demon lord seeds? Why do the rulers want them so much?"

"In the past, this diyu realm did not have a ruler, and the situation in this realm in the past was much more chaotic compared to now. According to the legend, the first demon lord accidentally discovered the ten black seeds, and he felt an extraordinary dark power radiating from them, so he decided to swallow them.

After that, his power increased rapidly, and he became the strongest demon in this realm, so he challenged all the strong demons at the time and defeated them." Zhang Fei seemed serious about listening to Janette's story, especially since he was quite interested in the history of her realm.

"After he defeated them, he nicknamed himself the demon lord and became the sole ruler of this realm, and he also appointed the twelve strongest demons as his aides, which he gave titles based on the twelve zodiacs.

Even though he was powerful, he did not oppress other demons, and he ruled this realm with great wisdom without distinguishing between our statuses, so he united and grouped all the demons based on their races to avoid unwanted comotion."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Then?"

"See that?" Following Janette's direction, Zhang Fei saw a statue on a hill, its size so large that it was visible from all corners of the Diyu Realm. "It was a statue of the first demon lord, but unfortunately, his appearance made the people of Xian and Tian feel threatened, and they repeatedly attacked this realm to kill him, so they worked together to carry out their plan.

However, he was assisted by his twelve aides at that time, fighting hard against the people of the two realms. In the end, they managed to repulse the invaders, and the three parties involved in the war suffered serious injuries, so they never attacked this realm again, and our lives have become peaceful."
"If all your stories are true, I also think that the disappearance of the first demon lord has something to do with people from both realms."

"Yeah." Janette responded with a nod of agreement. "Anyway, on the day the demon lord disappeared, all the demons saw ten black lights shooting out of the floating castle, and they thought that the ten black lights came from the ten black seeds.

Since then, they have called them the ten demon lord seeds, and they assume that whoever manages to get hold of one of those seeds will get a tenth of the demon lord's strength, so they try hard to find them. Unfortunately, their efforts are always in vain, and no one has been able to find them in years.
That's why I was truly shocked after my mother told me that she found one of them, and she even used it to give birth to me."
"How did Lillea manage to find that?"

Janette released a soft sigh before answering him. "I already asked my mother about it, but she said that she never tried to look for the demon lord seed, and it was the one that summoned her to its location, so she decided to bring it back before using it."
"If you were born from a Demon Lord Seed, why is your demon rank still low?" Zhang Fei asked in confusion.

"It's just an ancestral story, but no one has ever found out the truth." Janette then sighed heavily before speaking in a sad and disappointed tone. "I still couldn't believe that Rose would betray us; her actions have made us Dryads suffer for so many years, and our numbers are steadily decreasing, so only about five hundred Dryads are left now."
"Who's that Rose, Janette?" Zhang Fei asked with a frown.
Janette turned to Zhang Fei. "Rose is one of my mother's sisters, Fei. She is always kind, gentle, and caring for the young Dryads, which is why I can't believe that she betrayed us."

Zhang Fei pulled Janette into his arms and hugged her tightly, as he said. "Well, you don't have to think about her for now, and I'll help you capture Rose later. However, to be able to do that, I have to go to the twin Amaris's sub-realm first, and tomorrow the portal to there will open, right?"

"Yes." Janette nodded and told him. "Anyway, you will definitely enjoy your time in their sub-realm, especially since there are no male demons there, and you will be able to get a lot of female essence there.

However, you must exercise extreme caution to avoid the twins' discovery, particularly given their strong animosity towards male demons, and they will eliminate you if they detect your presence in their sub-realm.

"Oh? Is it true that there are only female demons in their realm? If- Ouch!" Zhang Fei shrieked loudly in response to Janette's intense squeeze on his dick; he then released her from his embrace. "Why did you do that? Do you want to destroy my lineage?"
"Humph!" Janette responded with a snort.
Zhang Fei smiled wryly at her response. "Speaking of the twins, I don't know much about them, especially about their weaknesses, so I can't determine my move against them yet."

Janette immediately told Zhang Fei again. "Lin'er and the others have already told me about the clone you sent to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and the twins are almost identical to the two of you, but they are completely two different individuals.
They can communicate and share thoughts with each other even if they are not in the same place, and they can channel their power to each other in an instant when they are close together."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei was really surprised to hear that, especially since he and his clone couldn't do such a thing.

"You should already understand what you have to do with them, right?" Janette spoke as she pressed her index finger against Zhang Fei's chest. "If they're close, then they'll be powerful, but they won't be that powerful if they're far apart.

Moreover, they can feel all the sensations experienced by each other, just like you and your clone, so you can defeat the other one if you have defeated one of them. Unfortunately, they almost never separate from each other, so you have to think of a way to separate them first in order to defeat them."

"Since they have that kind of ability, I will think about the best way to separate them." Zhang Fei then fell silent for a while in thought before speaking to Janette again. "Since they hate male demons, it would be better if I used my fox form to go to their realm, and they probably won't find out that I can transform into a human, so I can do that more easily."

"I advise you not to do that." Janette's words made Zhang Fei frown. "You see, they are demons with the darkness element, and your fox form always emits a strong light element. Moreover, the darkness and light elements always oppose each other, and the twins are completely different compared to Yue and the others, who are easily tempted by the cuteness of your fox form.
If they detect your light element, they will immediately kill you, so it's crucial that you avoid doing so."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "Since I also can't use my fox form, I will use another method to infiltrate their sub-realm, and they definitely won't notice or be suspicious of my presence."
"Hmm?" Janette squinted her eyes suspiciously. "What kind of method will you use to avoid their detection?"

"Ha ha." Zhang Fei chuckled and summoned his second clone, shocking Janette, especially since he already had one clone before, and the second one was also completely similar to him. However, his second clone's actions shocked her even more, and her jaw dropped, especially since his clone turned into a succubus. "Hahaha!

"See that?

"After he defeated them, he nicknamed himself the demon lord and became the sole ruler of this realm, and he also appointed the twelve strongest demons as his aides, which he gave titles based on the twelve zodiacs.

"Then?"

In the end, they managed to repulse the invaders, and the three parties involved in the war suffered serious injuries, so they never attacked this realm again, and our lives have become peaceful."

paragraphs: [Ding]
[You succeeded in mimicking the poison immunity of a harpy named Frala.]
*Shriek*
[You have killed 1 demon, with 39 remaining.]

Farla let out a final scream before Zhang Fei's slash split her body in two, but he didn't stop there. He flew after another harpy, who immediately fled upon witnessing her companion's death. He channeled his light element into the demon extermination sword before slashing at her, and a white crescent-shaped sword energy shot out from the sword, instantly slicing her body in half.
*Shriek*
[You have killed 2 demons, with 38 remaining.]

"Even though I've used it several times, this sword still continues to amaze me, and I feel that it has become stronger by absorbing some of these demon souls." Zhang Fei then flew towards the ancient castle, but he felt several gargoyles surrounding him using their camouflage.

Even so, Zhang Fei didn't worry about them and instead smiled faintly before enveloping his body in light elements. In addition, he activated his demon eyes to instill fear in their souls. He then used his clone illusion steps to attack them, slashing his sword several times.
*Slash... Slash... slash...*
*Splurt... Splurt... Splurt...*
[You have killed 3 demons, with 37 remaining.]
[You have killed 4 demons, with 36 remaining.]
[You have killed 5 demons, with 35 remaining.]
[You have killed 6 demons, with 34 remaining.]
Instantly, a lot of black blood spurted into the sky, and the gargoyles reappeared with their bodies cut into several pieces before they could even react to Zhang Fei's swift attack.

"Haha!" Zhang Fei laughed in satisfaction after he saw them die, and he didn't even need to break a sweat to kill them. "My training using the gravity feature in the training space was really worth it! These demons can't match my speed, and I'll be able to move even faster once I adapt to the higher levels."

[That's certain, Master. However, these demons belong to the lower ranks, and their ranks are limited to the knight and lady ranks, so they are not your opponents. Look at Janette; her rank is still viscountess rank, but her speed is not too far from yours, even though she hasn't trained in the training space.

So if you encounter a demon like Lillea who is already at marchioness rank or above, then your current speed is still meaningless in front of them, so you have to be careful when you go to the Twins sub-realm tomorrow.]

"I know." Zhang Fei answered with a nod as he watched Janette, who was fighting with several land demon beasts aided by several trees controlled by her, and he could see that her speed was indeed only slightly slower than his.
Suddenly, his gaze shifted to a gargoyle perched at the top of the ancient castle, especially since it was a female gargoyle, so he chased after her as he wanted to imitate her petrification.
The female gargoyle flew away as soon as she saw Zhang Fei flying towards her, especially since she felt afraid of his sword that killed her four friends earlier.

However, Zhang Fei directly used his teleport and moved above the female gargoyle before she could use her camouflage, and he immediately thrust his demon extermination sword through her chest, but he deliberately avoided attacking her vital points.
*Scree*

The female gargoyle released a shrill sound as she felt pain from Zhang Fei's attack, especially since he coated his sword with a light element that was the nemesis for a demon like her. She struggled to get away from him, but her actions actually caused her to continue letting out pained shrills.

Since she continued like that, Zhang Fei pressed the female gargoyle's back with his knees as he crouched down beside her before pulling her horns, making her look at him fiercely. "Hey, that's no use staring at me in that manner; despite the fact that you're a woman, I won't let you go, and I'll kill you after imitating one of your abilities."
[Ding]
[You succeeded in mimicking the petrification of a gargoyle named Treva.]
After the notification appeared, Zhang Fei separated their lips and killed the female gargoyle directly, but his action triggered another notification.
[You have killed 7 demons, with 33 remaining.]
[Alert!]
[The system detects a powerful demon heading towards the host's location, so the host must immediately escape from this place.]

[Masters! Hurry up! Take Janette away from this place! The demon approaching you is extremely powerful, and its rank appears to be comparable to or higher than Lillea's, indicating that you are not its opponent.

Zhang Fei didn't dare ignore the warnings from his system and Mei, so he immediately teleported to the side of Janette, who had just killed several demon beasts, causing her confusion. However, he didn't have time to explain it to her, so he immediately hugged her waist before taking her away, using the nine cloud steps several times.

Shortly after they left, a golden-haired male demon with a large body landed in the area; his appearance was like that of a lion, and his golden eyes looked fierce, making the demons in the area immediately prostrate themselves on the ground because of his presence.
Soon, three demi-humans resembling lions landed behind him, and one of them asked him. "What happened, Sir Leon? Did you feel anything from this place?"

The man was none other than Leon the Leo, one of the twelve rulers of the Diyu Realm. He then gestured towards the corpses of the demons that Zhang Fei and Janette had earlier killed. "Did you guys notice anything unusual about their corpses?"
Hearing that, the three looked at the demon corpses seriously, but they didn't notice anything, so they shook their heads at Leon.

"Fools!" Leon chided them directly. "In this realm, there is no demon who can kill them that neatly, except for me and the other rulers. However, all of them are still in their sub-realms now, and I can feel the power of light from these demon corpses, so I am sure that they weren't the ones who killed these useless low-rank demons."
"The power of light?" The three of them were shocked to hear that. "Does that mean there are people from the Xian Realm infiltrating here, Lord?"

Leon responded to them with a nod as he tried to check the area around them, but Zhang Fei's movement was too fast, with him being able to move 100 km in one fell swoop, so he and Janette were already far from that place. Moreover, he wasn't a demon cultivator, and his senses weren't as sharp as those of normal cultivators or demon cultivators, so he couldn't find their traces.

"We can't let them escape, so I want you to contact our people and order them to leave my sub-realm, and I want them to search for traces of those people from Xian Realm throughout our realm. Otherwise, if we find them too late, their presence will be dangerous for us, and they might do some things beyond our knowledge."
They immediately carried out Leon's orders, but one of them asked him again. "Are we going to the Dryad Forest now, Lord?"

"No." Leon answered by shaking his head. "Initially, I want to go there to persuade Lillea again, but this matter is much more serious and concerns the future of our realm. That's why I want to go to the other rulers to discuss this matter with them; otherwise, everything will be too late, and the three of you can spread out to look for the whereabouts of the intruders as well.
However, you guys are not their opponents, especially since they have the power of light, so all of you have to contact me if any of you have managed to find them."
Unfortunately, Leon had guessed wrongly about the matter, especially since he didn't have any information about Zhang Fei yet, so their efforts would only end in vain.
"Yes, sir."

The three lion demi-humans immediately left the area, and Leon observed the corpses of the demons before releasing a soft sigh and flying to one of the stone platforms to meet the ruler who owned the sub-realm.
"Why did you suddenly take me away from that area? Have you managed to acquire their abilities?" Janette immediately inquired as soon as they reached a new location.

"I've mimicked their abilities, but I suddenly felt the presence of a strong demon, and I wasn't the demon's opponent, so I decided to take you away from there." Zhang Fei then looked at the crowd of demon beasts below them, but they were weaker if they were compared to the harpies and gargoyles.
"Let's go; I want to finish my business quickly, especially since I'm worried the demon can still find us, and we'll go back to the Dryad forest after that."
"All right."

Unlike before, they didn't fight separately, but Zhang Fei and Janette fought side by side, and they quickly killed quite a lot of demon beasts with their combined abilities, so he didn't need to waste too much time completing his quest.
[You have killed 8 demons, with 32 remaining.]
[You have killed 9 demons, with 31 remaining.]
[You have killed 40 demons, with 0 remaining.]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 40 Demons.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 4,000 female essences are added to the balance.]
After the notification appeared in his mind, Zhang Fei immediately took Janette back to the Dryad Forest, but she then pulled her to her private quarter. "Why did you bring me here?"

"Humph!" Janette snorted at his question. "You will return to the Sky Jade Realm and leave your second clone here, right? That's why I want to dual-cultivate with you now, especially since I don't want to do it with your clone."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that and hugged Janette's waist. "Even though our relationship is just a reciprocal one, and you are not my official woman, I will never use my clone to touch you. Moreover, I will still often come here to train, and I can also take you to the Sky Jade Realm, so you shouldn't have to worry about that."

Janette nodded to Zhang Fei. "I haven't been back to this realm for two years, so I want to stay here for a while to accompany my mother. Even so, I will go to the Sky Jade Realm again later, especially since I can only cultivate there or in your mansion, so you can pick me up later."

"Sure, I'll definitely pick you up." Zhang Fei then took out a device and gave it to Janette. "Since my second clone will go to the Twins sub-realm tomorrow, you can use this device to contact him if you all encounter danger, and he will definitely come straight here to help you guys."
"Haha." Janette laughed softly before taking off her clothes, and she then helped Zhang Fei undress before engaging in hot sex with him, making her orgasm again and again.

However, Zhang Fei was surprised because the amount of Janette's female essence increased quite significantly compared to when they had sex on earth, and Mei told him that it was probably the influence of the Dryad Forest, especially since she was a Dryad. Unfortunately, her yin qi was too weak for him, mainly because her cultivation was still very low, but he didn't care much about it.

Even so, Zhang Fei's yan qi was potent enough to help Janette's cultivation break through several times, especially since their cultivation was three major stages apart, making her cultivation reach 1-Star Body Realm directly.

Towards the end of their dual cultivation session, Janette sensed a strange occurrence within her body, which swiftly engulfed her in darkness. "Hah... Hah... Fei, I feel something weird happening inside my body, and this makes me uncomfortable."

"Our shop is fully open today, but sales are still low, and I already talked to Huang Rong earlier, so she will help us take care of it together with her daughter. Additionally, Yang Lu'er informed me that we will complete our product advertisements within a few days, which will significantly increase our sales once they reach the public.
I have also purchased several items in large quantities for our shop in the Sky Jade Realm, but I will still come back here once a week to check everything and restock."
"All right, you can do that, so you can focus more on cultivating in the Sky Jade Realm." Zhang Fei then turned to Guo Lan. "What about you? Do you want to live fully there?"
"No." Guo Lan shook her head at Zhang Fei. "I still have my family here, especially my grandmother, and I am the closest to her, so I will go back and forth between the two realms."
"I see." Zhang Fei himself remembered Guo Lan's grandmother, but he was not very close to her.

"Big Brother!" Zhang Fei turned to Xu Ling'er, who was pouting her lips, and she immediately told him. "I told my mother that I wanted to quit school so I could stay in the Sky Jade Realm to cultivate, but she didn't agree to that, so you had to persuade her."

Zhang Fei turned to Ru Xue, who immediately shook her head. She wanted her daughter to continue her education, even though she was already a cultivator, especially since Xu Ling'er was still too small, and she thought that education on earth was still useful for her.

"Ling'er, I understand your passion for cultivation, but your education is equally important, so I want you to continue your education, okay?" Seeing her lower her face in disappointment, Zhang Fei immediately lifted and sat Xu Ling'er on his shoulders. "Okay, there's no need to be this depressed; how about I accompany you later on for a stroll through the Sky Jade Realm?"
"En." Xu Ling'er just nodded while hugging Zhang Fei's head, but that didn't lessen the disappointment on her face.

"I want you to quit your current hospital, Xue'er." Ru Xue immediately looked at Zhang Fei with raised eyebrows, especially since becoming a doctor was her dream, so she didn't want to stop being one. Understanding his wife's feelings, he then presented her with an alternative solution that was still relevant to her career.

"Even though cultivators can heal injuries using pills and the like, they are still susceptible to disease. Besides, you have the light element, so I think you can combine modern medical techniques and healing cultivation techniques to help them, and we will get more and more jewels from them, which are much more beneficial for all of us."
Ru Xue nodded in understanding. "All right, I'll think about it first."
Zhang Fei then asked Zhang Yue. "What about you, Big Sis? Do you still want to continue your work here?"

"Yes." Zhang Yue nodded to her little brother. "I've just moved to my current office, so I can't resign straight away. However, I've thought about everything seriously, so I've decided to wait some time before I resign, and I'll move to the Sky Jade Realm after that."

However, they were stunned as soon as they arrived at the Chu Clan's back garden, especially after they saw Quan Xun running frantically as the two tigresses chased behind him with fierce looks, as if they wanted to pounce on him.

"What happened, Hua'er? Why did you order them to chase him?" Liu Hua immediately turned to Zhang Fei and explained about Quan Xun's laziness over the past three days. She explained that he had been cultivating continuously without wanting to practice, and she had done this on purpose. After hearing that, he immediately shouted at the two tigresses. "Hey!
You two don't need to hesitate to attack him, so he won't dare slack off anymore."
*Roar... Roar...*
The two tigresses roared loudly and chased Quan Xun faster. They used their front paws to attack him, tearing his back clothes and leaving scratch marks and blood on his back.
"Argh!" Quan Xun screamed in pain, and their attacks almost caused him to fall forward. "Cousin! You are truly abominable! They will definitely kill me!"

Moreover, you yourself said that you want to change, and you are a man, so you have to learn to stick to your own words." Hearing Zhang Fei's words, Quan Xun gritted his teeth and tried to run faster, but they all laughed at seeing his potbelly keep swaying.
"Anyway, I'll take Xue'er and Ling'er for a walk, and you all can cultivate inside the formation."

Ru Xue herself no longer thought about Xu Xuan, and she felt happy with their current situation, especially since she had a husband who loved her, plus there were so many people who cared about them. "Fei'er, I am truly happy to be your wife."
"I, too, feel happy to have you as my wife, Xue'er."

After they left the Chu Clan, Zhang Fei immediately took his wife and stepdaughter for a walk around the city. However, he suddenly sensed the killing intent directed at them, so he opened his map to find the owner of the killing intent, and a faint smile appeared on his face after he saw the name that appeared on the map. 'Heh!

It's been almost a month since we met last time, but his injury still hasn't been recovered. Since he's targeting us, I'll end everything today, so he won't bother us anymore, and they can live more safely.'

chapters.title: Chapter 210: Capture Pang Hong
paragraphs: *Bam*
An old man standing by the side punched a large tree, causing it to explode, but his sole focus remained on Zhang Fei's figure as he continued to grumble in anger. "That bastard!

I don't know how he managed to change his appearance, but I'm sure that guy is that little bastard who thwarted my plan to kidnap Liu Qingyu back then, and he was also the one who caused me to suffer severe injuries after he freed Liu Hua from my control. However, how could his cultivation progress that fast?

I remember for sure that his cultivation was still at 6-Star Elementary Realm back then, but his current cultivation had already reached 3-Star Core Realm, and he was able to achieve it in about a month. Heh! That day, he was able to thwart my plan because those damn beasts helped him, but there weren't any strong beasts in the city, so no one would be able to help him escape from me.
After I capture him, I will skin him alive, and I will give him to that freaking beast in our clan."

The old man is none other than Pang Hong, who still harbors a grudge against Zhang Fei because of his actions in saving the Liu Sisters. Unfortunately, he was overconfident in his own abilities, and he still didn't know that his target had undergone various changes while he was recovering from his injury. His eyes suddenly fell on Ru Xue, and he licked his lips at the sight of her hot figure.

"Hey, that woman's cultivation is still in 1-Star Body Realm, but her face and body are much better than Liu Hua, so it's easy for me to capture her, and I'll make that little bastard suffer by enjoying her body in front of him. As for that little girl, I will kill her in front of the two of them, and her death will definitely destroy them."

However, Pang Hong suddenly got a voice transmission, but his expression turned annoyed after he listened to the message, and he looked around the surrounding area before cursing angrily. "Tch! Pang De is such a bastard! He doesn't trust me, and he even sent his familiar to monitor me."

"Phew." Pang Hong inhaled and exhaled several times to calm himself. "Which clans can I use as our vassals? The Li and Mei Clans have already fallen to the Chu Clan, so I don't have many choices now, especially since this region is much weaker compared to other regions. Hmm? I think I should go to those two clans, especially since they are stronger than the remaining minor clans.

The Wu Clan is the in-laws of the Li Clan, and they will submit to me if I help them take revenge for the destruction of that clan. As for the Ba Clan, the strongest among them is Ba Jiawen, but he's in the demon cave now, so I can take advantage of his absence to take over his clan."
After that, Pang Hong immediately disappeared from the place, and his first destination was the Wu Clan.
"What are you thinking about, Fei'er? Why is your smile so strange?"

Zhang Fei directly told Ru Xue of Pang Hong's presence, which made her expression turn panicked, but he hugged her tighter and calmed her down. "You don't need to worry like this, okay? The current me is indeed no match for that old bastard, but we have Boitata by our side, and she is much stronger than him, so capturing him is just a trivial matter for her."

"Big brother is right, Mom. You panic too easily, and you often forget important things when you panic." Xu Ling'er, who was sitting on Zhang Fei's shoulders, spoke to her mother while shaking her head. "Grandma Boitata is very strong, so no other cultivator can fight against her in this western region. Moreover, she is Big Brother's beast contract, and she will protect us from that evil old man."
Ru Xue smiled bitterly at her daughter's words, and she often felt that Xu Ling'er was much more mature and calmer than her, even though she was still so small.

"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed and looked up at the little girl. "Hey, Ling'er, Boitata is not just my contract beast, and she is my wife now. However, she would sulk if you addressed her as a grandma, so it would be better if you addressed her as an aunt instead."

"No." Xu Ling'er immediately declined. "She's over a thousand years old, so I will always address her as a grandma or maybe a great-grandmother, and you'll protect me if she gets angry with me, right, big brother?"

"Haha! That's for sure! Even though Boitata is my wife, I will punish her if she dares to get angry with you." Xu Ling'er laughed happily when she heard that, and Zhang Fei immediately asked the dragon serpent. 'How is your condition? Have you recovered now?'
[If you didn't have this beast space, I would still be exhausted and likely fall into a deep sleep due to you. Do you want me to capture the old man?]

'Yeah.' Zhang Fei replied with a slight nod. 'I don't care about the people in this region, but our family lives here, and that old bastard seems to be planning something bad against them. That's why I want you to capture him, or he will continue to be a thorn in the flesh if he continues to roam free, and we can live more peacefully without his presence.
Anyway, you can beat him up to your heart's content, but don't kill him. I want to use him to destroy his clan from within.'
[All right then, I will do it now.]

After she said that, Boitata immediately exited the beast space and rushed to Pang Hong's location. However, she refrained from taking immediate action against him, preferring to first learn about his plans, particularly the location of the blood demon tree, which his clan had hidden in the western region.
Then, Zhang Fei continued walking around the city with Ru Xue and Xu Ling'er, and he also took them to check out his shop and restaurant, both of which were filled with buyers, especially his shop.

Meanwhile, Boitata was lying relaxed on the roof of the Wu Clan's main hall, eavesdropping on Pang Hong's conversations with people from that clan. To her surprise, Wu Ling, the clan's patriarch, refused to submit to the Pang Clan, and he also ordered his clan's people to surround him.

However, Pang Hong's cultivation was clearly superior to theirs, so Boitata was certain that they wouldn't be able to do anything to him, and they would die in his hands instead. 'Should I save them? Nah! My husband doesn't care about these people, so I don't need to care about them either, especially since their lives are not our responsibility.'

As expected, the people of the Wu Clan were powerless before Pang Hong's strength and abilities, and almost all of them died at his hands, including Wu Ling. He only left two of their main members, both of whom were women, and he then used the same technique he used on Liu Hua in the past to turn them into his puppets.

Boitata just shook her head after watching Pang Hong slaughter those people. 'This old man is truly evil, but unfortunately he is looking for trouble with the wrong person, especially since my husband is much more evil than him, and he will definitely suffer at his hands.'
After he cleared everything up, Pang Hong left the Wu Clan and took his new puppets with him, and Boitata immediately followed him.

Sometime later, Pang Hong had arrived at the Ba Clan, which was located not far from the Heavenly Sword Sect. Despite being a minor clan, the Ba Clan held a high status in the western forest city, primarily due to Ba Jiawen's role as the sect master of the sect, which earned them respect from the community.

Pang Hong frowned after he discovered a formation that was strong enough to protect the Ba Clan, which was deliberately installed by Ba Jiawen with the help of the elders of the sect. He then tried to destroy it right away, but his action actually activated the formation's defense mechanism and attacked him.
However, it wasn't too difficult for him because the counterattacks were too weak for his level, and he broke them all at once.

"Hmm?" Pang Hong frowned even more as he felt several auras moving rapidly towards him, and he could see the people from the Ba Clan looking at him with condescending gazes from within their clan. 'These bastards! You guys can be happy now, but I will destroy this clan soon.'
Since several elders from the sect headed towards him, Pang Hong immediately fled away from the Ba Clan while carrying his puppets, and Boitata once followed them.

People from the Ba Clan immediately spread the news about Pang Hong's presence in the western region to people from other clans, and many of them held grudges against him and his clan immediately hunted him down, putting him in a desperate situation, especially since he couldn't possibly face them all alone.

In the end, Pang Hong decided to take his puppets to the edge of the western region, and Boitata, who was following them from a distance, could see the same demon miasma she had seen before in the southern region. 'Oh? No wonder Liu Hua's people couldn't find it; it turns out they hid the tree in a place like this, and they definitely didn't expect it.'

Since she couldn't handle the demon miasma, Boitata immediately contacted Zhang Fei and informed him of the location of the blood demon tree's hiding place. However, he already knew this, particularly because he had been closely monitoring her movements via the map. He asked her to leave the matter to him, as well as to focus on capturing Pang Hong.

As soon as Pang Hong and his puppets landed not far from the location of the blood demon tree, Boitata immediately blocked in front of them, making him freeze in place. 'Fuck! Who is this woman? Why did he follow me here? Damn it! I have to escape right now, especially since her cultivation is far above mine and her strength seems to be on par with that of our ancestors.'

"Do you think I will let you go?" Pang Hong felt a cold sweat trickle down his forehead upon hearing Boitata's voice from behind him, particularly considering that she had just been in front of him a moment ago. However, before he could blink, she had already moved behind him, snatching his returning jade.
"Honestly, I'm too lazy to deal with you because you're just an ant in my eyes, but my husband asked me to capture you, especially since your presence threatens his other wives."

"Who-Ugh!" Boitata immediately strangled Pang Hong's neck from behind as she enveloped her other hand in her flames before punching his back quite hard, causing his spine to crack, and he immediately spat out a mouthful of blood from his mouth. "Gah!"

Pang Hong silently ordered his puppets to attack Boitata, but his action was obviously in vain, especially since their cultivation had not even broken through to the Earth Realm, so they were powerless under her restraint. 'Damn it!'
Boitata smirked slightly and spoke to Pang Hong again. "Hey, you know what? My husband allowed me to beat you black and blue, so I'm going to beat you up now before taking you to see him."
"No! Argh!"
*Bam... Bam...*
"Argh! Stop!"
Boitata didn't give Pang Hong a chance to beg, and she directly beat him without holding back, causing his agonized groans to be heard in the area for quite some time.

A while later, Pang Hong lay helplessly on the ground, his entire body encased in bruises; his face, beyond recognition, exuded an overwhelming sense of pain. Boitata proceeded to seal his cultivation before escorting him and his puppets out of the location. However, she cast her gaze towards the distance and unleashed her flames, causing a massive explosion to resound from that direction.
*Boom*

"Phew." Pang Hong inhaled and exhaled several times to calm himself.
"Which clans can I use as our vassals?
The Li and Mei Clans have already fallen to the Chu Clan, so I don't have many choices now, especially since this region is much weaker compared to other regions.
Hmm?
I think I should go to those two clans, especially since they are stronger than the remaining minor clans.
The Wu Clan is the in-laws of the Li Clan, and they will submit to me if I help them take revenge for the destruction of that clan.
As for the Ba Clan, the strongest among them is Ba Jiawen, but he's in the demon cave now, so I can take advantage of his absence to take over his clan."
After that, Pang Hong immediately disappeared from the place, and his first destination was the Wu Clan.
"What are you thinking about, Fei'er?
Why is your smile so strange?"
Zhang Fei directly told Ru Xue of Pang Hong's presence, which made her expression turn panicked, but he hugged her tighter and calmed her down.
"You don't need to worry like this, okay?
The current me is indeed no match for that old bastard, but we have Boitata by our side, and she is much stronger than him, so capturing him is just a trivial matter for her."
"Big brother is right, Mom.
You panic too easily, and you often forget important things when you panic." Xu Ling'er, who was sitting on Zhang Fei's shoulders, spoke to her mother while shaking her head.
"Grandma Boitata is very strong, so no other cultivator can fight against her in this western region.
Moreover, she is Big Brother's beast contract, and she will protect us from that evil old man."
Ru Xue smiled bitterly at her daughter's words, and she often felt that Xu Ling'er was much more mature and calmer than her, even though she was still so small.
"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed and looked up at the little girl.
"Hey, Ling'er, Boitata is not just my contract beast, and she is my wife now.
However, she would sulk if you addressed her as a grandma, so it would be better if you addressed her as an aunt instead."
"No." Xu Ling'er immediately declined.
"She's over a thousand years old, so I will always address her as a grandma or maybe a great-grandmother, and you'll protect me if she gets angry with me, right, big brother?"
"Haha!
That's for sure!

Even though Boitata is my wife, I will punish her if she dares to get angry with you." Xu Ling'er laughed happily when she heard that, and Zhang Fei immediately asked the dragon serpent. 'How is your condition?
Have you recovered now?'
[If you didn't have this beast space, I would still be exhausted and likely fall into a deep sleep due to you.
Do you want me to capture the old man?]
'Yeah.' Zhang Fei replied with a slight nod. 'I don't care about the people in this region, but our family lives here, and that old bastard seems to be planning something bad against them.
That's why I want you to capture him, or he will continue to be a thorn in the flesh if he continues to roam free, and we can live more peacefully without his presence.
Anyway, you can beat him up to your heart's content, but don't kill him.
I want to use him to destroy his clan from within.'
[All right then, I will do it now.]
After she said that, Boitata immediately exited the beast space and rushed to Pang Hong's location.

However, she refrained from taking immediate action against him, preferring to first learn about his plans, particularly the location of the blood demon tree, which his clan had hidden in the western region.
Then, Zhang Fei continued walking around the city with Ru Xue and Xu Ling'er, and he also took them to check out his shop and restaurant, both of which were filled with buyers, especially his shop.
Meanwhile, Boitata was lying relaxed on the roof of the Wu Clan's main hall, eavesdropping on Pang Hong's conversations with people from that clan.
To her surprise, Wu Ling, the clan's patriarch, refused to submit to the Pang Clan, and he also ordered his clan's people to surround him.
However, Pang Hong's cultivation was clearly superior to theirs, so Boitata was certain that they wouldn't be able to do anything to him, and they would die in his hands instead. 'Should I save them?
Nah!
My husband doesn't care about these people, so I don't need to care about them either, especially since their lives are not our responsibility.'
As expected, the people of the Wu Clan were powerless before Pang Hong's strength and abilities, and almost all of them died at his hands, including Wu Ling.
He only left two of their main members, both of whom were women, and he then used the same technique he used on Liu Hua in the past to turn them into his puppets.

Boitata just shook her head after watching Pang Hong slaughter those people. 'This old man is truly evil, but unfortunately he is looking for trouble with the wrong person, especially since my husband is much more evil than him, and he will definitely suffer at his hands.'
After he cleared everything up, Pang Hong left the Wu Clan and took his new puppets with him, and Boitata immediately followed him.
Sometime later, Pang Hong had arrived at the Ba Clan, which was located not far from the Heavenly Sword Sect.
Despite being a minor clan, the Ba Clan held a high status in the western forest city, primarily due to Ba Jiawen's role as the sect master of the sect, which earned them respect from the community.
Pang Hong frowned after he discovered a formation that was strong enough to protect the Ba Clan, which was deliberately installed by Ba Jiawen with the help of the elders of the sect.
He then tried to destroy it right away, but his action actually activated the formation's defense mechanism and attacked him.
However, it wasn't too difficult for him because the counterattacks were too weak for his level, and he broke them all at once.

"Hmm?" Pang Hong frowned even more as he felt several auras moving rapidly towards him, and he could see the people from the Ba Clan looking at him with condescending gazes from within their clan. 'These bastards!
You guys can be happy now, but I will destroy this clan soon.'
Since several elders from the sect headed towards him, Pang Hong immediately fled away from the Ba Clan while carrying his puppets, and Boitata once followed them.

People from the Ba Clan immediately spread the news about Pang Hong's presence in the western region to people from other clans, and many of them held grudges against him and his clan immediately hunted him down, putting him in a desperate situation, especially since he couldn't possibly face them all alone.

In the end, Pang Hong decided to take his puppets to the edge of the western region, and Boitata, who was following them from a distance, could see the same demon miasma she had seen before in the southern region. 'Oh?
No wonder Liu Hua's people couldn't find it; it turns out they hid the tree in a place like this, and they definitely didn't expect it.'
Since she couldn't handle the demon miasma, Boitata immediately contacted Zhang Fei and informed him of the location of the blood demon tree's hiding place.
However, he already knew this, particularly because he had been closely monitoring her movements via the map.
He asked her to leave the matter to him, as well as to focus on capturing Pang Hong.
As soon as Pang Hong and his puppets landed not far from the location of the blood demon tree, Boitata immediately blocked in front of them, making him freeze in place. 'Fuck!
Who is this woman?
Why did he follow me here?
Damn it!
I have to escape right now, especially since her cultivation is far above mine and her strength seems to be on par with that of our ancestors.'

"Do you think I will let you go?" Pang Hong felt a cold sweat trickle down his forehead upon hearing Boitata's voice from behind him, particularly considering that she had just been in front of him a moment ago.
However, before he could blink, she had already moved behind him, snatching his returning jade.
"Honestly, I'm too lazy to deal with you because you're just an ant in my eyes, but my husband asked me to capture you, especially since your presence threatens his other wives."

"Who-Ugh!" Boitata immediately strangled Pang Hong's neck from behind as she enveloped her other hand in her flames before punching his back quite hard, causing his spine to crack, and he immediately spat out a mouthful of blood from his mouth.
"Gah!"

Pang Hong silently ordered his puppets to attack Boitata, but his action was obviously in vain, especially since their cultivation had not even broken through to the Earth Realm, so they were powerless under her restraint. 'Damn it!'
Boitata smirked slightly and spoke to Pang Hong again.
"Hey, you know what?
My husband allowed me to beat you black and blue, so I'm going to beat you up now before taking you to see him."
"No!
Argh!"
*Bam...
Bam...*
"Argh!
Stop!"
Boitata didn't give Pang Hong a chance to beg, and she directly beat him without holding back, causing his agonized groans to be heard in the area for quite some time.
A while later, Pang Hong lay helplessly on the ground, his entire body encased in bruises; his face, beyond recognition, exuded an overwhelming sense of pain.
Boitata proceeded to seal his cultivation before escorting him and his puppets out of the location.
However, she cast her gaze towards the distance and unleashed her flames, causing a massive explosion to resound from that direction.
*Boom*

chapters.title: Chapter 211: Pang Hong's Fate
paragraphs: *Splurt*
Pang De, who was sitting in his chair, immediately spurted blood from his mouth after Boitata destroyed his familiar. "Cough... Cough... Damn it! Who exactly is that woman? Where did she come from?

How could she find my familiar and destroy it in a matter of seconds? Pang Hong is truly such an idiot! I ordered him to seek out two clans to join us as vassals to safeguard the blood demon tree, but his desire for vengeance blinded him, causing him to alert that young man.
I'm sure the woman must be connected to him, and that idiot has fallen into their hands, messing up our situation by leading her to that place."

After giving it some thought, Pang De hurriedly left and headed to the Pang Clan's rearmost area, only to find a black barrier blocking his path. 'Sigh, our ancestors still seem to have difficulty breaking through, so I can't disturb them for now. What should I do now?

At the very least, I need three to four days to arrive in the western region, and it will be too late to prevent those people from taking the blood demon tree from our hands. Moreover, we have already lost one, and our ancestors will definitely blame me if we lose another one.'

In the end, Pang De decided to contact his clan members, who were spread across almost all regions, and he ordered those closest to the western region to head there as soon as possible. 'Sigh, I hope they're not too late, or else our ancestors will punish us all.'
*Bam*

"Gah!" Pang Hong groaned in pain after Boitata slammed him to the ground quite forcefully, but his body shivered in fear as soon as he saw the Liu Sisters and the Wen Twins, who were standing a little far away. 'Fuck! I'm screwed up! Since when did they have a relationship with such a powerful cultivator?'

"I still have to rest, so I'm going back to my husband's place. You guys can do whatever you want to this old trash, but he doesn't want you to kill him." After she said that, Boitata immediately left the Chu Clan, as she didn't need to worry about them, especially since she had already sealed Pang Hong's cultivation previously, so he wouldn't be able to do anything to them.

The Wen Twins then approached the two women, who had been turned into puppets by Pang Hong, and recognized their identities, so Wen Yuan said to Liu Hua. "Big Sis, since they fell into the hands of this old bastard, I assumed that the Wu Clan would have been wiped out by now, especially since they were the higher-ups of that clan."
"I think so." Liu Hua replied as she approached Pang Hong, and a dagger appeared in her hand before she squatted down beside him, causing him to tremble even more because of her murderous look.
Seeing that, Liu Qingyu walked beside her little sister as she asked. "What are you going to do to him, Hua'er?"

"Since Fei'er doesn't want to kill him, I won't kill him either." Liu Hua then thought for a moment before taking out a cloth and stuffing it into Pang Hong's mouth, confusing Liu Qingyu and the Wen Twins. However, their eyes immediately widened by her next action, and she slashed her dagger at his dick, which caused him to grimace in pain and blood flow profusely from his lower body. "Heh!

I wanted to kill you with my hands, but my husband's words were absolute, so I chose to castrate you. Unfortunately, your punishment is not yet complete, and once he returns, you will undoubtedly endure even more suffering."

Liu Hua's action just now made Pang Hong almost lose consciousness because his entire body was filled with pain from Boitata's previous attacks. However, Liu Qingyu suddenly stepped on his chest, channeling her light qi into his body to stop the bleeding, significantly reducing his pain.

After that, Liu Qingyu ordered one of the Chu Clan members to take Pang Hong to prison, especially since they had to wait for Zhang Fei to come back to do something about him, and he then asked her little sister while looking at the two puppets. "Should we ask Fei'er to free them from his control, like he did for you?"
"I don't know." Liu Hua then stood up and examined the two puppets. "Their cultivation isn't very high, and Fei'er also seems to have other plans for Pang Hong, so we'll wait for his decision."
"All right, we will wait for Fei'er's before making a decision regarding them." Liu Qingyu replied with an affirmative nod.
Wen Xuan suddenly asked them. "Isn't Boitata supposed to be able to save the Wu Clan? Why did she let Pang Hong slaughter them?"
"You're right." Liu Hua answered with a nod. "Boitata can indeed save the people of the Wu Clan, but you should already understand his character."

"As cultivators, we tend to act selfishly, especially since we will be drawn into their problems if we are too meddlesome in other people's affairs." The Wen Twins couldn't help but admit the facts behind Liu Qingyu's words. "Before Fei'er destroyed the Li Clan, Li Bao had asked for help from Wu Ling and the Wu Clan, but they refused to help him."

Suddenly, Zhang Fei and the two women appeared before them, but he raised his eyebrows when he saw the two puppets, and Liu Hua immediately told him about Pang Hong. He then asked Ru Xue and Xu Ling'er to cultivate in the back garden before leading the Liu Sisters to the prison, and he also asked the Wen Twins to bring the two puppets along with them.

Zhang Fei smiled evilly as he saw Pang Hong fiercely staring at him, and he immediately entered the prison and stood in front of him. "Hey, Old Man, I'm not gay, so you don't need to look at me like that. You once expressed your desire to kill me, but unfortunately for you, our roles have now flipped, allowing me to take your life at any time.
However, I still need you, so you can rest assured that I won't kill you, but that doesn't mean I'll just let you go; instead, I'll show you something interesting first.

Then Zhang Fei moved toward the Guan Clan member that Liua and the others had captured some time ago. As soon as he transformed into an incubus, Pang Hong's eyes widened in shock, realizing that he was fucked up. 'This little bastard is simply absurd! Back then, he was clearly a demihuman, and he was previously a human, but he's now turned into a demon!'

"As you can see, I am a demon, and I will show you the horror of a demon." Zhang Fei then touched the head of the Guan Clan member, but he turned to look at the Liu Sisters and the Wen Twins. "It would be better if you closed your eyes, because what I'm about to do to this man won't be pleasant to look at, and you guys might be terrified of me later."
"No need; we are experienced cultivators, and we have seen so many terrible things in our lives." The four women unanimously refused.
"All right then." Zhang Fei then activated his life-force absorption ability, causing the man to let out a bloodcurdling scream.
"Argh!"

The four women froze in their spots as they saw his body begin to wither, and his face also quickly became deathly pale. They eventually closed their eyes as well as their sense of hearing, especially since they couldn't bear to watch and listen to his screams as a result of Zhang Fei's ability.

Not only did Zhang Fei's ability frighten them, but it also frightened Pang Hong, who possessed numerous dark techniques. 'What the hell! This little bastard is far more vile than all of us! Even our ancestor's vileness still pales in comparison to his!'

After some time, Zhang Fei completely absorbed the man's life energy and vitality, causing his body to dry out, and he immediately burned the remains to ashes. He then touched the shoulders of the four women, who immediately opened their eyes and turned towards the burnt marks, and they immediately unlocked their sense of hearing.

"I told you all not to watch, but you guys didn't listen to my words." Zhang Fei spoke to them with a shake of his head before he squatted in front of Pang Hong and pressed his palm against his chest, making him tremble in horror, especially after he witnessed the incident just now. "Oh? Such an evil old man like you can still feel fear, huh?
Like I said before, I won't kill you because you are still useful to me, and you will help me destroy your damn clan."
"Are you going to make him your slave, Fei'er?" Liu Qingyu asked him.
"Yes, but I still need something else for him." Zhang Fei then asked the AI girl. 'Hey, Mei, is there a technique I can use to brainwash him?

He won't be able to do anything if I implant my demon slave mark on him, but I want him to be completely loyal to me, and I also need a transformation technique for him, especially since a familiar from one of his clan members witnessed Boitata capturing him, and that person will definitely kill him if he goes back there like this.'

[Hmm? There are two demon abilities that you can use for that, Master. Moreover, you have 30,900 female essences now, and that's enough to buy both of them, so I'll buy them both if you really want them.]
Although Zhang Fei wanted to upgrade his demon body double as soon as possible, the matter at hand was more urgent, so he immediately made a decision. 'Buy them.'
{You got Memory Manipulation Ability x1}
{You got Body Modification Ability x1}
{25,000 female essence has been deducted from your balance}
[Body Modification: The user can change and modify the bodies of oneself and others in general to enhance their physical capabilities, alternating appearances, and so on.]
[Memory Manipulation: The user can change other people's memories according to the user's wishes, so they will be completely loyal to the user.]
'Ha ha ha!' Zhang Fei laughed out loud in his heart after reading both of them, especially the description of the body modification ability, and immediately used it on Pang Hong.

"Argh!" Pang Hong immediately let out a loud scream as he writhed wildly like a worm in heat, due to the effect of Zhang Fei's ability. Even though he didn't know what he had done to him, he could feel that his body was beginning to undergo some internal changes.

The Liu Sisters and the Wen Twins were dumbstruck with dropped jaws, especially since Pang Hong's body was gradually turning into that of a woman, and he looked more and more like a woman with every second that passed.
In about thirty minutes, Pang Hong had already turned into a complete woman, making Zhang Fei smile contentedly after seeing that.
"What the hell? What kind of technique is that, Fei!?" The four women asked with a shout of shock.

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed when he heard them, and he turned to Liu Hua while extending his hand to her. "Please lend me your mirror, Hua'er. I want this old man to see his new body, and he might vomit blood after seeing it."
Liu Hua shook her head helplessly before taking out a mirror and handing it to Zhang Fei. "Is that one of your demon techniques?"

"Yes, my ability is called body modification, and the results are what you guys have seen for yourselves." Zhang Fei then presented the mirror to Pang Hong. "Hey, look in this mirror; you'll definitely like your new body."
*Splurt*

Pang Hong instantly spat out a mouthful of blood after seeing his reflection in the mirror, and he then looked at Zhang Fei as if he had seen a freak. 'Fuck! I really want to kill myself, but that woman has sealed my cultivation!'
"Heh!" Zhang Fei snorted and used memory manipulation on Pang Hong directly, unsealing his cultivation before posing the question. "How many clans are Pang Clan vassals? Which clans are they?"

"What do you mean by that? Aren't your words clear?" Mu Lingshu asked with a cold look. "You want to find partners because you want to use them to increase your strength, which means you consider them as tools, so you are no different from those bastards."

"I-" Mu Lingshu did not continue her words and fell silent, and Zhang Fei [1] could see the sadness on her face.

[Yes, you just need to touch her hand, and I will immediately check her body.]

Mu Lingshu gazed at Zhang Fei [1] with skepticism, particularly considering that he was merely an inner disciple, just like her, and numerous renowned elders had failed to detect anything on her body, leading her to doubt his abilities. However, the seriousness of his expression made her change her mind, and she extended her hand to him. "You can hold my hand."
After Zhang Fei [1] held Mu Lingshu's hand, Mei immediately scanned her entire body, particularly her inner body. 'How is the result?'
[Be patient, Master. I have to check her whole body, and this takes a little time.]

Mu Lingshu looked uncomfortable as Zhang Fei [1] continued to hold her hand, but she didn't stop him, especially since he didn't seem to be harboring any bad intentions towards her. Instead, she waited silently, continuing to gaze at his serious face.

Mu Lingshu suddenly raised her eyebrows when she saw two women walking towards them, and she naturally recognized their identities, especially since they were Luo Yu and Gu Yan. Before long, both women were standing beside Zhang Fei [1], smiling wryly, seeing his hand holding Mu Lingshu's hand, but they chose not to comment because he still looked very serious.

paragraphs: Zhang Fei [1] frowned after hearing that. Mei, what exactly is the abnormality in Mu Lingshu's body? Is the abnormality in her body so severe that it is difficult to cure?
[Master, the stone body is Mu Lingshu's abnormality.]
Stone body? What do you mean by that?' Zhang Fei [1] asked in confusion.

Mei immediately provided him with a detailed explanation. [A woman with a stone body will never be able to become aroused, as the nerves throughout her body are incapable of sensing any sensation, including sexual pleasure, thus preventing her from experiencing an orgasm.
Besides, a woman with that body is also infertile, mainly because her womb is as hard as a stone and her ovaries cannot produce egg cells.]
Zhang Fei [1] was truly shocked to hear that. 'Huh? Is her condition really that bad? Can she be cured, Mai?'
[Yes, Master, her condition is really bad. I've checked the items and pill shops, but I can't find anything that can cure her condition.]
"Do you recognize the abnormality in my body?" Mu Lingshu seriously asked, and judging by his expression, she was sure that he knew it.
"You have never experienced any stimulation in your entire life, including sexual stimulation, right?

Honestly, it happens because you have a stone body, so the nerves throughout your body cannot feel any sensation." However, Zhang Fei [1] had no intention of telling Mu Lingshu that she was infertile because such a thing would deal a psychological blow to her, so he chose to keep it a secret, at least for now, especially since he didn't yet have a solution to help her.

Mu Lingshu turned her face to the side in embarrassment because Zhang Fei [1]'s words hit the mark. In fact, she had repeatedly tried to stimulate her own body, but she couldn't feel anything from her action, so she finally gave up and accepted her condition. "I've never heard of a stone body before, but the abnormality in my body is the same as you said.

As I told you before, Elder Zhiyu and many famous healers had tried to cure me, but their efforts were in vain. That's why my parents had to expel me from our clan, deeming me useless, particularly since no man expressed interest in marrying me. Consequently, I chose to join this sect.
The male disciples in this sect do want me, but they only want my body for their pleasure, so I choose to stay away from them."
"Hey! Parents who choose to abandon their own children are the dumbest parents, and they don't deserve to be parents." Zhang Fei said it angrily.
Mu Lingshu looked at Zhang Fei [1] in confusion because she could see the anger in his eyes and thought that he might have experienced the same thing, or else he wouldn't have acted like that.

"Hey, Fei, why don't you try using your dual cultivation technique?" Mu Lingshu turned her head to Luo Yu, who immediately provided an explanation. "Senior sister, his finger technique is truly amazing. Every time he touches us, Gu Yan and I become so quickly aroused. Perhaps it will be able to help you feel that sensation, so you can allow him to try it.
Moreover, he is different from those idiots, and he will never do anything to you without your permission."
"All right."

Upon hearing that, Zhang Fei [1] instantly used his demon touch, simultaneously igniting his demon pheromone, which Mu Lingshu swiftly inhaled. Despite the pink heart symbol appearing in her eyes, her expression remained normal, devoid of any lewdness, and she showed no reaction to his touch, let alone a moan. 'Fuck! How is this possible? Even my lust demon abilities don't work on her!'

Not only Zhang Fei [1], but even Gu Yan and Luo Yu were shocked to see no change in Mu Lingshu's expression, especially since they knew exactly how terrifying the effects of his abilities were, and they were always overwhelmed if he used them while dual-cultivating with them.
"Have you used your abilities?"

Mu Lingshu's question woke Zhang Fei [1], and he immediately nodded to her. "My abilities are completely useless to you, senior sister. If I used my abilities on other women, I would instantly arouse them."
"Eh?" Mu Lingshu looked at Zhang Fei [1] with repeated blinks. "Do you really have such abilities?"
"Yes, I-"
"Hahaha." Suddenly, they heard two men laughing from a distance, so Zhang Fei [1] and the others immediately turned to them and saw a young woman walking behind them.

One of the men then shouted. "Hey, look at that! There's a man approaching that ugly and arrogant woman! Furthermore, based on his attire, it appears that he has recently received a promotion from the outer disciples; otherwise, he wouldn't be able to enter this area.

"Lingshu, oh Lingshu! You are so ugly, and you come from a minor clan, yet you are so arrogant." The young woman, who was walking behind the two men, spoke with a mocking smile, but her eyes kept glancing at Zhang Fei [1]. 'Oh? How could those lilies be with him? Ahh! I shouldn't be surprised if he can conquer them, especially since he managed to conquer such a fierce woman as Elder Tang.'

"Hehe! Lan Zhen is right; you are too ugly." Despite the second man's statement, his gaze never left Mu Lingshu's breasts, and he licked his own lips. "Back then, you refused to be my partner, but I have her as my partner now. She is much prettier and sexier than you, and her Lan Clan lives in the Central Region, so her status is much higher than yours."

'Fei, they are the top ten in the inner disciples ranking.' Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows at Luo Yu's whisper. 'The short man is Su Cun, and the other one is Sun Bing. Anyway, you have to be careful of Lan Zhen; she has several partners, and one of them is a core disciple.
However, I've heard rumors that she may have used something against them, leading to their complete submission and willingness to do anything for her.

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding while muttering to himself. 'Lan Zhe from the Lan Clan in the central region, huh? It's no wonder if she has such a thing under her sleeve, especially since her clan is one of the vassals of the Pang Clan, and she definitely got it from them.'

Zhang Fei [1] faintly smiled, pulled the three women behind him, and spoke to them with disdain. "You two overestimate yourselves too much, don't you? What is there to be proud of in a relationship with a slut like her? She even cuckolded you two with a bunch of other men! If I were in both of your shoes, then I would kill her directly.

Indeed, senior sister Lingshu may not be as beautiful and sexy as she is, but in my opinion, she is a beautiful and perfect woman because she hasn't had many relationships with too many men like her."

Mu Lingshu was stunned for a moment listening to Zhang Fei [1]'s words, but a sweet and beautiful smile immediately appeared on her face. Noticing her expression, Gu Yan and Luo Yu exchanged glances for a moment before smiling, and they were sure that she would sooner or later fall for him.
"How dare you call Lan Zhen a slut!" The two men shouted and moved to surround Zhang Fei [1], and they rushed to attack him from both sides.

"What ignorance!" Zhang Fei simply shook his head, took the three women away from the place, and used his Clone Illusion Steps to teleport at the same time, a move that neither the two men nor Lan Zhen noticed.
*Bam*

"Argh!" The two men groaned in pain as their attacks landed on each other's faces, particularly because they had targeted Zhang Fei's illusion. As a result, their attacks penetrated the illusion, causing them to fall to the ground immediately.
Seeing that, Lan Zhen moved towards the two men and kicked them in the back while she shouted angrily. "You guys are useless! You two should have fought him, but instead, you punched each other!"
*Clap... Clap...*
Hearing the sound of clapping, Lan Zhen and the two men looked up, but they frowned to see Zhang Fei [1] and the three women sitting leisurely on a large tree branch not far from them.
