However, a black light shining from the head of the last demon beast she killed distracted Feltia's gaze, prompting her to check before taking a black crystal from it. "Hmm?"

"It's a demon core." Janette said as she approached Feltia. "Unlike the core of cultivation beasts, this thing is created from crystallized demon energy. It has four grades: normal, intermediate, advanced, and perfect. The one in your hand is a normal demon core, and you can exchange it for demon coins at demon cities, but you will only get around one hundred demon coins for one normal core."

"Demon cores and demon coins, huh?" Feltia muttered to herself while nodding in understanding. "Isn't a normal demon core already too rare? Then what about the other four grades? I've killed more than 100 demon beasts to date, but I've only got one demon beast core."

"Haha." Janette laughed at that. "If you want to get more demon cores, then you have to kill demon beasts or demons that are quite old, especially since the process of crystallizing demon energy into demon cores takes quite a long time, and the demon beasts you killed previously were still young, except for the last one.

Regardless, you need to seek out demons significantly older than this one to obtain the other two grades of demon cores, particularly if you're aiming for advanced demon cores. As for the perfect demon cores, you can only get them from other demons, not demon beasts."
"Only from other demons, huh?" Janette nodded to Feltia. "Sigh, I'll think about that later, especially since my strength is still insufficient to fight a demon that's too old."
[You obtained 1 normal demon core.]

"That's true." Janette nodded in agreement with that. "Since you intend to visit the twin Amaris's sub realm, it would be beneficial if you collected regular demon cores and traded them for demon coins. This is particularly important because you will need them to reside there, and they may become suspicious if you use your cultivation or other unusual methods for demons.
"I know." Feltia then looked up into the sky towards one of the stone platforms, and she could see changes starting to occur there. "Their sub-realm seems to be opening soon."

Janette immediately looked in that direction before nodding to Feltia. "You're right, their realm will open in about an hour, and you can go there directly after the portal up there opens. "It's okay; I have Boitata by my side, so you don't need to worry about me, and I will definitely be fine there. Anyway, it would be better if you and your mother joined my real body in my training space, and you two could train there together with the others." Feltia suddenly remembered something before telling Janette again.
"Aside from that, I've discovered a useful solution to help you evade their hunt, but I can't implement it right now, and I might only be able to assist you once my first clone exits his seclusion."

Janette still felt amused remembering Zhang Fei and his two clones; even Feltia, who was standing in front of her, was like a different individual, but the three of them were clearly like a hive, especially since everything about them was one.
[Master, there is a demon much stronger than Lillea heading towards this place, and he seems to be one of the twelve rulers, but he doesn't seem to have any evil intentions.]
"Hmm?" Feltia raised her eyebrows before opening a portal to the Dryad Forest. "Janette! Get in now! I'll catch up with you later!"
"Why-"
"Go in!"
Janette was confused by that, but she nodded in agreement and entered the portal directly, and Feltia promptly closed it again.

Shortly after that, an old male demon landed in front of Feltia, but his appearance didn't look like a demon at all. Instead, he was no different from a human old man, and the skin on his body was already wrinkled, but his body was too small, at around 4' 7".
'Scan his status, Mei.'
[Aye, sir!]
Name: Oz the Second
Age: 10,000+ Years Old
Gender: Male
Race: Celestial Demon
Rank: Emperor
Element: Darkness
Physique: Celestial Demon
Abilities: Darkness Power, Absolute Condition, Demonic Protection, Demonic Force Manipulation, Demonic Magic, Demonic Abomination, Size Manipulation, Soul Manipulation, etc.
Strong: Darkness
Weak: Light

Oz did not directly respond to Feltia's question, instead observing her closely. "You're sure you're great for a little human, and you're not even deterred by my presence. My name is Zygoz, the Libra, and I am one of the rulers of this realm."

"Hmm?" 'Why is he disguised as Zygoz? What was his real purpose in doing this? Then where is the real Zygoz?' Feltia harbored doubts in her heart, but she decided to play along with him, particularly because Oz was too powerful for her at the moment. "How did you know that I was a human?"

"Hahaha." Oz laughed when he heard that. "Hey, kid, I always monitor this realm, and I also never let the Dryads out of my sight, so I already noticed your presence in my realm when Janette brought you here."
"I see." Feltia nodded in understanding before asking Oz again. "Why are you coming at me? Do you intend to capture me?"

"Ha ha ha ha!" Once again, Oz laughed loudly, causing Feltia to frown at his attitude. "If I wanted to capture you, I would have done it from the moment you set foot in this realm. Feltia was naturally aware of this, but she felt strange about Oz's attitude. "Aren't you one of them? Why did you come here to warn me?"

Anyway, where is the real Zygoz? Are you impersonating him to divert the attention of the people of the Xian and Tian Realms towards you?"

"Yes." Oz nodded to Feltia. "Your guess is correct; I deliberately disguised myself as Zygoz to divert their attention from me, so they wouldn't know about the plans I had for the future of this realm. As for the real Zygoz, I sealed his demon power and sent him to the human realm with his approval, so the other demon rules won't see through my disguise."
"I see." Feltia nodded in understanding. "What exactly are your future plans for this realm?"

Oz smiled and told her about the details of his plan, but Feltia frowned after hearing them. "As I said before, I'm not interested in power and authority, so I don't have ambitions for that. However, you are different from me, and I can see enormous ambitions in your eyes, so you can have it in the future."

Instead, Feltia released a heavy sigh and shook her head at Oz. "You are right that I have enormous ambitions, but I have no interest in that. Just like you, I only want to protect the people closest to me, and I can only do that if I have such great power. Moreover, these four realms are too small for us, and our ambitions lie in higher realms."
"Higher realms?" Oz looked very surprised to hear that. "Are there still other realms out there?"

"Yes, there are countless realms out there." Feltia answered Oz's question with a nod. "For now, I only know of two other realms, but I will definitely explore others in the future. Anyway, one of the realms that I know of is a demon realm, but that realm is much stronger than this Diyu realm, and your strength is probably only on par with demons at the Duke or Duchess rank there."
"Oh?"
Felia immediately shook her head at Oz because she knew his thoughts. "Honestly, I've never been there in person, so that's just my estimate, and I can't say for sure."

"I see." Oz's expression was filled with excitement upon learning about the existence of a demon far stronger than him, and he was eager to challenge that realm. However, he still hadn't succeeded in making the demons in his realm live in peace, so he immediately ignored that.
"Anyway, I've heard that you want to go to the twins Amaris's sub realm, and I must warn you to be careful there, especially against the black Amaris."
"I know." Feltia then asked Oz. "Do you have anything I can use to contact you? As for your offer, I'll think about it first, and I'll let you know my decision later."

Oz took out a medallion and gave it to Feltia. "You just need to inject your demon power, and I'll come right to you. Anyway, their realm has begun to open, so you can go there immediately. We can continue our conversation at a later time, or else they will discover my disguise."
"That's good."

After Feltia disappeared from his sight, Oz let out a heavy sigh and looked out through one of the holes in the wall. "Sigh, I am the demon lord, but I have to pin my hopes on a human, and I hope that he is truly willing to help me."

Janette, who was fighting nearby, aided her, and together they had already eliminated numerous demon beasts.
[You have killed 60 demons, with 0 remaining.]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 60 Demons.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 6,000 female essences are added to the balance.]

As soon as the notification appeared in her mind, Feltia immediately stopped and wiped the blood left on the demon extermination sword, and it quickly entered her forehead before turning into a sword tattoo there.
However, a black light shining from the head of the last demon beast she killed distracted Feltia's gaze, prompting her to check before taking a black crystal from it.
"Hmm?"
"It's a demon core." Janette said as she approached Feltia.
"Unlike the core of cultivation beasts, this thing is created from crystallized demon energy.
It has four grades: normal, intermediate, advanced, and perfect.
The one in your hand is a normal demon core, and you can exchange it for demon coins at demon cities, but you will only get around one hundred demon coins for one normal core."
"Demon cores and demon coins, huh?" Feltia muttered to herself while nodding in understanding.
"Isn't a normal demon core already too rare?
Then what about the other four grades?
I've killed more than 100 demon beasts to date, but I've only got one demon beast core."
"Haha." Janette laughed at that.

"If you want to get more demon cores, then you have to kill demon beasts or demons that are quite old, especially since the process of crystallizing demon energy into demon cores takes quite a long time, and the demon beasts you killed previously were still young, except for the last one.
Regardless, you need to seek out demons significantly older than this one to obtain the other two grades of demon cores, particularly if you're aiming for advanced demon cores.
As for the perfect demon cores, you can only get them from other demons, not demon beasts."
"Only from other demons, huh?" Janette nodded to Feltia.
"Sigh, I'll think about that later, especially since my strength is still insufficient to fight a demon that's too old."
[You obtained 1 normal demon core.]
"That's true." Janette nodded in agreement with that.
"Since you intend to visit the twin Amaris's sub realm, it would be beneficial if you collected regular demon cores and traded them for demon coins.
This is particularly important because you will need them to reside there, and they may become suspicious if you use your cultivation or other unusual methods for demons.
"I know." Feltia then looked up into the sky towards one of the stone platforms, and she could see changes starting to occur there.
"Their sub-realm seems to be opening soon."
Janette immediately looked in that direction before nodding to Feltia.
"You're right, their realm will open in about an hour, and you can go there directly after the portal up there opens.
Unfortunately, I can't accompany you there; otherwise, they will find out about my return, and they will capture me immediately."
"It's okay; I have Boitata by my side, so you don't need to worry about me, and I will definitely be fine there.

Anyway, it would be better if you and your mother joined my real body in my training space, and you two could train there together with the others." Feltia suddenly remembered something before telling Janette again.
"Aside from that, I've discovered a useful solution to help you evade their hunt, but I can't implement it right now, and I might only be able to assist you once my first clone exits his seclusion."

Janette still felt amused remembering Zhang Fei and his two clones; even Feltia, who was standing in front of her, was like a different individual, but the three of them were clearly like a hive, especially since everything about them was one.
[Master, there is a demon much stronger than Lillea heading towards this place, and he seems to be one of the twelve rulers, but he doesn't seem to have any evil intentions.]
"Hmm?" Feltia raised her eyebrows before opening a portal to the Dryad Forest.
"Janette!
Get in now!
I'll catch up with you later!"
"Why-"
"Go in!"
Janette was confused by that, but she nodded in agreement and entered the portal directly, and Feltia promptly closed it again.
Shortly after that, an old male demon landed in front of Feltia, but his appearance didn't look like a demon at all.
Instead, he was no different from a human old man, and the skin on his body was already wrinkled, but his body was too small, at around 4' 7".
'Scan his status, Mei.'
[Aye, sir!]
Name: Oz the Second
Age: 10,000+ Years Old
Gender: Male
Race: Celestial Demon
Rank: Emperor
Element: Darkness
Physique: Celestial Demon
Abilities: Darkness Power, Absolute Condition, Demonic Protection, Demonic Force Manipulation, Demonic Magic, Demonic Abomination, Size Manipulation, Soul Manipulation, etc.
Strong: Darkness
Weak: Light
'Holy fudge!' Feltia screamed in her heart as soon as she read the status of Oz the Second. 'Goddamnit!
This guy turns out to be the demon emperor of this realm, and he apparently never disappeared!' "Who are you?"
Oz did not directly respond to Feltia's question, instead observing her closely.
"You're sure you're great for a little human, and you're not even deterred by my presence.
My name is Zygoz, the Libra, and I am one of the rulers of this realm."
"Hmm?" 'Why is he disguised as Zygoz?
What was his real purpose in doing this?
Then where is the real Zygoz?' Feltia harbored doubts in her heart, but she decided to play along with him, particularly because Oz was too powerful for her at the moment.
"How did you know that I was a human?"
"Hahaha." Oz laughed when he heard that.
"Hey, kid, I always monitor this realm, and I also never let the Dryads out of my sight, so I already noticed your presence in my realm when Janette brought you here."
"I see." Feltia nodded in understanding before asking Oz again.
"Why are you coming at me?
Do you intend to capture me?"
"Ha ha ha ha!" Once again, Oz laughed loudly, causing Feltia to frown at his attitude.

"You might think that I'm strange, but I'm not interested in power and authority, and I only want a peaceful life for the other demons.
Unfortunately, I'm alone, and I can't possibly stop eleven of them by myself.
Besides, people from the Xian and Tian Realms are also always eyeing this realm, and they won't stop before all the demons are wiped out.
That's why I need many allies to bring about change in this realm, and I believe you are the best choice, which is why I've decided to come see you."
"Indeed, you are quite strange, in my opinion." Feltia said that as she nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 223: Shire Demon City
paragraphs: After she left Oz, Feltia returned to the Dryad Forest, and she immediately sent Janette and Lillea to the training space. After that, she flew to the platform where the portal led to the twin Amaris's sub-realm, and she immediately entered it after the portal fully opened.
[Ding]
[Quest: Explore the Amaris Twins's sub-realm]
[Quest rank: Easy]
[Reward: Easy Gift Pack x 1]
[Ding]
[Quest: Finding a Lost Demon]
[Quest rank: Medium]
[Reward: Medium Gift Pack x 1]
[Ding]
[Quest: Defeat the sand demon snake]
[Quest rank: Hard]
[Reward: Hard Gift Pack x 1]

After the three notifications appeared, Feltia frowned, and she guessed that she would have to go to one of the cities to complete the first quest, like the quest she had gotten when she set foot in the Diyu Realm. However, she felt confused about the second quest, especially since there were no significant clues from it.
As for the third quest, she only needed to find information about the whereabouts of the sand demon snake, so she didn't think too much about it.

Feltia then looked towards the front, but she was stunned because the sub-realm was much bigger than she had previously imagined, and the two sides were completely opposite each other. The area on the left is as bright as day, and the area on the right is darker than night. In addition, she could see a tower rising high into the sky in the middle, perfectly aligned with both areas.
"What the hell is wrong with this place? How can these two areas be so contrasting?"

[The power of the white Amaris and the black Amaris created this sub-realm, so you shouldn't be surprised by its current state. Anyway, I detected a lot of evil energy from the dark area, so I thought the demons and demon beasts in that area were very fierce.]
"What about the bright area?"

[Surprisingly, I didn't detect any evil energy from the bright area, but you should still be careful going into there, especially since appearances are often deceiving and they are likely using something to disguise their evil energy.]

'I know, Mei.' Feltia then opened the map and searched for the Twin Amaris, discovering their position at the tower's highest peak. However, she found another demon ruler there, who was none other than Leon the Leo. She also discovered several large cities in both areas, each home to various demon races.

As for the sand demon snake, she couldn't find the demon beast anywhere, so she thought about going to one of those cities first before looking for information about it. "Since they're busy in the tower, I'll check the dark area first."
[Eh? Master, why don't you check the bright areas first?]

Feltia immediately used the invisibility ability before flying away towards the dark area. "Mei, they are all demons, remember? Furthermore, Janette informed me that Virgil is the only demon possessing the power of light, which left me feeling uneasy about the white Amaris. I suspected there was something unusual in that area, so I decided not to venture there for now."
[Well, that's true. Anyway, are you thinking about accepting Oz's offer, Master?]

"No." Feltia responded as she surveyed the area beneath her, observing that all the inhabitants of the sub realm, whether demons or demon beasts, were female. "Even though I've examined his soul and found nothing untoward in him, I don't know much about Oz. Therefore, I won't blindly trust him, as there's a chance he might use me as a sacrifice to deal with the people from the Xian and Tian Realms.

Moreover, I'm not part of this realm, so I don't care about the fate of the demons in this place except for the Dryads, especially since they are Jannette's relatives, and I only save them if people from both realms are attacking here."

Mei chose not to comment about that matter, especially since her master's character was like that, and she only cared about those closest to her or those who were targeted by her. [Master, I think it would be better if you looked for more normal demon cores first before going to one of those cities, especially since you only have one, and you'll only get a hundred demon coins from it.]

Feltia nodded in agreement and looked for demon beasts that were quite old, especially since Janette had told her that she could only get demon cores from them. After she found several demon beasts that were quite old, she immediately summoned the demon extermination sword to face them.

However, Feltia chose to use her darkness element instead of her usual light element, particularly because she didn't want the three demon rulers to be aware of her presence. Despite this, it didn't pose a problem because her sword was a formidable weapon against them.

In addition, Feltia utilized the tree controls to manipulate the nearby trees, which promptly moved to assist her in combating the demon beasts, leading to a chaotic situation within the herd of demon beasts.

A few hours later, after killing too many beasts, Feltia unsummoned the demon extermination sword, fearing that her actions would raise suspicion among the demons in the sub-realm. After she extracted the normal demon cores from their heads, she immediately used her fire element to burn their corpses.
[You obtained 50 normal demon cores.]

"Hmm?" Feltia suddenly felt a strong demonic aura heading towards her quickly, so she immediately hid behind a large black tree, using her invisibility once again. She raised her eyebrows slightly when she saw Leon flying so quickly towards the portal out of that realm. 'So he is the ruler representing Leo, huh? That guy does look as fierce as a lion, and his demon aura is also powerful.
Even though he is significantly weaker than Oz, I am still not his opponent.'

After Leon disappeared from her sight, Feltia immediately flew quickly in a state of invisibility, but she felt confused about which city she should go to first. In the end, she decided to check on the residents of Shire Demon City, the city closest to her location. Her eyes glistened as she noticed several demon races that caught her attention. "Oh? Dark elves, huh?
I've read that elves are gorgeus, both ordinary elves and dark elves, and I'm really curious about their beauty, so I'll go to that city first to look for them."

[Ha ha ha! Master, you always reprimand me when I label you as a pervert, but your actions clearly demonstrate that you are indeed a pervert! You even decided to go to that city just because of those dark elves!]
After hearing that, the corner of Feltia's lips twitched. "So what if I'm a pervert? If you had a real body, I would definitely eat you too, Mei."
[Humph! You can keep dreaming about it, especially since I don't have a real body, so it will never happen.]

After she flew for some time, Feltia arrived at Shire Demon City, but two female demon guards immediately stopped her as she was about to enter the city, and one of them asked her directly. "What's your name? You're a newcomer to this sub-realm, right?"
"My name is Feltia, and I usually live in Lord Zygoz's sub-realm, so this is my first time here."

The female demon guards didn't seem suspicious hearing Feltia's answer, especially since they also knew that there were many succubi living in Zygoz's sub-realm. "What is your purpose in coming here?"

Feltia shook her head before giving her answer to the female demon guards. "Honestly, I didn't have a specific purpose for coming here, and I felt bored with Lord Zygoz's sub-realm, so I decided to take a look at the sub-realms of the other rulers."
"To enter this city, you must pay for a normal demon core or one hundred demon coins."

'Tch! What a robbery!' Feltia inwardly cursed, but she immediately handed them a normal demon core, and one of them promptly noted down her identity. "Do you know where I can exchange demon cores for demon coins? I didn't bring anything with me when I left my house, and I hunted demon beasts on the way here, so I want to exchange them for demon coins."

"Over there." Feltia immediately followed the direction pointed out by one of the female demon guards, but she quickly raised her eyebrows, especially since the place looked like a pub. "You can go there and meet Lady Ashreth; my lady Amaris has appointed her to oversee this city, so you can exchange your demon cores with her."
"All right, I will go see Lady Ashreth right now."
[Ding]
[Quest: Explore the Amaris Twins's sub-realm.]
[Quest rank: normal]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Normal gift pack x 1 sent to inventory.]

Feltia strolled slowly into Shire Demon City, observing the buildings. She noticed numerous mingzhu-like crystals affixed to the buildings, serving as the city's lighting source. 'Hmm? Mei, who is the strongest demon in this city? Is Ashreth the strongest?'

[Master, Ashreth is not the strongest demon in this city; she holds the rank of countess, just like Janette. The strongest female demon in this city is a female gorgon named Kyllia, who possesses strength comparable to Lillea's and resides in a building at the back of the city. Even so, she's no match for Boitata, so you don't need to worry about her.]

Feltia nodded in understanding as her eyes followed several female dark elves who were walking towards Ashreth's pub. 'Apparently, that woman is the leader of the dark elves in this city, or else they wouldn't be flocking there.'
[Master, Ashreth is indeed a dark elf, so you can go there to seduce her.]
'Goddamnit, Mei! You always ask me to seduce women, but you also call me a pervert!'

[Ha ha ha! It's a fact that you are a pervert, so you don't need to deny it, Master.] Feltia gritted her teeth after hearing that, but Mei then told her again. [Master, look at the building in the northeast; I think you can go there to have fun with the female demons there.]

'Hmm?' Feltia raised her eyebrows as she looked at the building Mei pointed out, but she immediately choked up after seeing the signboard in front of the building. 'Cough... Cough... Hey! It's a brothel! How could you ask me to go there?'
[Master, don't you personally believe that the Yin-Yang Pavilion is comparable to a brothel? So it shouldn't be a big deal if you have fun in that brothel, right?

Moreover, there are no male demons in this sub-realm, so I think those female demons are much better compared to the female disciples of that sect, and you can get tons of female essence from them, which can increase your demon rank even faster.]

Feltia nodded in agreement with that. 'You're right about that. However, I am a man, and I don't want to have fun with them while I'm in the disguise of a succubus like now. If I transform into an incubus now, Ashreth is likely to inform the Amaris Twins about my presence in this city, and Kyllia is likely to launch a direct attack on me. Therefore, I will refrain from taking such risky actions.
Moreover, I'll probably be staying in this city for quite a while, so I don't need to act hastily, and I'll act accordingly.'
Not long after, Feltia arrived in front of Ashreth's pub and entered directly, and a glimmer of desire to subdue her flashed in her eyes when she saw her figure.

Ashreth herself has a beautiful face with long black hair tied in a ponytail, wide pink eyes, a slender nose, pointed long ears, and a long neck. Her black skin exudes an exotic charm, while her body exudes sensuality with her E or F-Cup breasts wrapped in black cloth. The black cloth, shaped like mini jeans, covers her bottom and accentuates her long legs.
[Humph! A pervert will always be a pervert!]
Feltia ignored Mei and approached Ashreth directly. "Excuse me, Lady Ashreth. My name is Feltia, and I am a newcomer to this city."
"Oh?" With a dazzling smile, Ashreth turned to Feltia, and she lifted her chin with one finger while asking. "What can I do for you, young succubus?"
- To Be Continued -

Moreover, I'm not part of this realm, so I don't care about the fate of the demons in this place except for the Dryads, especially since they are Jannette's relatives, and I only save them if people from both realms are attacking here."
Mei chose not to comment about that matter, especially since her master's character was like that, and she only cared about those closest to her or those who were targeted by her.

[Master, I think it would be better if you looked for more normal demon cores first before going to one of those cities, especially since you only have one, and you'll only get a hundred demon coins from it.]
Feltia nodded in agreement and looked for demon beasts that were quite old, especially since Janette had told her that she could only get demon cores from them.
After she found several demon beasts that were quite old, she immediately summoned the demon extermination sword to face them.
However, Feltia chose to use her darkness element instead of her usual light element, particularly because she didn't want the three demon rulers to be aware of her presence.
Despite this, it didn't pose a problem because her sword was a formidable weapon against them.

In addition, Feltia utilized the tree controls to manipulate the nearby trees, which promptly moved to assist her in combating the demon beasts, leading to a chaotic situation within the herd of demon beasts.
A few hours later, after killing too many beasts, Feltia unsummoned the demon extermination sword, fearing that her actions would raise suspicion among the demons in the sub-realm.
After she extracted the normal demon cores from their heads, she immediately used her fire element to burn their corpses.
[You obtained 50 normal demon cores.]
"Hmm?" Feltia suddenly felt a strong demonic aura heading towards her quickly, so she immediately hid behind a large black tree, using her invisibility once again.
She raised her eyebrows slightly when she saw Leon flying so quickly towards the portal out of that realm. 'So he is the ruler representing Leo, huh?
That guy does look as fierce as a lion, and his demon aura is also powerful.
Even though he is significantly weaker than Oz, I am still not his opponent.'
After Leon disappeared from her sight, Feltia immediately flew quickly in a state of invisibility, but she felt confused about which city she should go to first.
In the end, she decided to check on the residents of Shire Demon City, the city closest to her location.
Her eyes glistened as she noticed several demon races that caught her attention.
"Oh?
Dark elves, huh?
I've read that elves are gorgeus, both ordinary elves and dark elves, and I'm really curious about their beauty, so I'll go to that city first to look for them."
[Ha ha ha!
Master, you always reprimand me when I label you as a pervert, but your actions clearly demonstrate that you are indeed a pervert!
You even decided to go to that city just because of those dark elves!]
After hearing that, the corner of Feltia's lips twitched.
"So what if I'm a pervert?
If you had a real body, I would definitely eat you too, Mei."
[Humph!
You can keep dreaming about it, especially since I don't have a real body, so it will never happen.]
After she flew for some time, Feltia arrived at Shire Demon City, but two female demon guards immediately stopped her as she was about to enter the city, and one of them asked her directly.
"What's your name?
You're a newcomer to this sub-realm, right?"
"My name is Feltia, and I usually live in Lord Zygoz's sub-realm, so this is my first time here."
The female demon guards didn't seem suspicious hearing Feltia's answer, especially since they also knew that there were many succubi living in Zygoz's sub-realm.
"What is your purpose in coming here?"
Feltia shook her head before giving her answer to the female demon guards.
"Honestly, I didn't have a specific purpose for coming here, and I felt bored with Lord Zygoz's sub-realm, so I decided to take a look at the sub-realms of the other rulers."
"To enter this city, you must pay for a normal demon core or one hundred demon coins."
'Tch!
What a robbery!' Feltia inwardly cursed, but she immediately handed them a normal demon core, and one of them promptly noted down her identity.
"Do you know where I can exchange demon cores for demon coins?
I didn't bring anything with me when I left my house, and I hunted demon beasts on the way here, so I want to exchange them for demon coins."
"Over there." Feltia immediately followed the direction pointed out by one of the female demon guards, but she quickly raised her eyebrows, especially since the place looked like a pub.
"You can go there and meet Lady Ashreth; my lady Amaris has appointed her to oversee this city, so you can exchange your demon cores with her."
"All right, I will go see Lady Ashreth right now."
[Ding]
[Quest: Explore the Amaris Twins's sub-realm.]
[Quest rank: normal]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Normal gift pack x 1 sent to inventory.]
Feltia strolled slowly into Shire Demon City, observing the buildings.
She noticed numerous mingzhu-like crystals affixed to the buildings, serving as the city's lighting source. 'Hmm?
Mei, who is the strongest demon in this city?
Is Ashreth the strongest?'
[Master, Ashreth is not the strongest demon in this city; she holds the rank of countess, just like Janette.
The strongest female demon in this city is a female gorgon named Kyllia, who possesses strength comparable to Lillea's and resides in a building at the back of the city.
Even so, she's no match for Boitata, so you don't need to worry about her.]

Feltia nodded in understanding as her eyes followed several female dark elves who were walking towards Ashreth's pub. 'Apparently, that woman is the leader of the dark elves in this city, or else they wouldn't be flocking there.'
[Master, Ashreth is indeed a dark elf, so you can go there to seduce her.]
'Goddamnit, Mei!
You always ask me to seduce women, but you also call me a pervert!'
[Ha ha ha!
It's a fact that you are a pervert, so you don't need to deny it, Master.] Feltia gritted her teeth after hearing that, but Mei then told her again.
[Master, look at the building in the northeast; I think you can go there to have fun with the female demons there.]
'Hmm?' Feltia raised her eyebrows as she looked at the building Mei pointed out, but she immediately choked up after seeing the signboard in front of the building. 'Cough...
Cough...
Hey!
It's a brothel!
How could you ask me to go there?'
[Master, don't you personally believe that the Yin-Yang Pavilion is comparable to a brothel?
So it shouldn't be a big deal if you have fun in that brothel, right?

Moreover, there are no male demons in this sub-realm, so I think those female demons are much better compared to the female disciples of that sect, and you can get tons of female essence from them, which can increase your demon rank even faster.]
Feltia nodded in agreement with that. 'You're right about that.
However, I am a man, and I don't want to have fun with them while I'm in the disguise of a succubus like now.
If I transform into an incubus now, Ashreth is likely to inform the Amaris Twins about my presence in this city, and Kyllia is likely to launch a direct attack on me.
Therefore, I will refrain from taking such risky actions.
Moreover, I'll probably be staying in this city for quite a while, so I don't need to act hastily, and I'll act accordingly.'
Not long after, Feltia arrived in front of Ashreth's pub and entered directly, and a glimmer of desire to subdue her flashed in her eyes when she saw her figure.
Ashreth herself has a beautiful face with long black hair tied in a ponytail, wide pink eyes, a slender nose, pointed long ears, and a long neck.
Her black skin exudes an exotic charm, while her body exudes sensuality with her E or F-Cup breasts wrapped in black cloth.
The black cloth, shaped like mini jeans, covers her bottom and accentuates her long legs.
[Humph!
A pervert will always be a pervert!]
Feltia ignored Mei and approached Ashreth directly.
"Excuse me, Lady Ashreth.
My name is Feltia, and I am a newcomer to this city."
"Oh?" With a dazzling smile, Ashreth turned to Feltia, and she lifted her chin with one finger while asking.
"What can I do for you, young succubus?"

paragraphs: Feltia inwardly laughed at Ashreth's behavior before showing her the normal demon cores. "I came here to exchange these cores for demon coins, and I also want to find a place to stay in this city for some time."

"Hmm?" Ashreth immediately counted them before shaking her head. "You will only get five thousand demon coins from these fifty demon cores, and they are only enough for you to rent a house in this city for a month, as the cheapest rent is five thousand demon coins."

'Dang! Even renting a house in this city is so expensive!' Feltia then replied to Ashreth. "I think it's not a problem because I won't be staying in this city for too long, and I'll probably only stay for a month before going to look around other cities. Besides, I can still hunt demon beasts to get more demon cores if I'm short on them, so it's not a problem for me."

"That's true." Ashreth then offered something to Feltia. "Would you like to work at my pub? That way, you won't have to rent a house, and I will pay you two hundred demon coins per day, so you won't have to think about such things anymore."

'Eh? The salary isn't that bad, huh? Even though I will still hunt demon beasts, her offer is not bad, and I can get more demon coins.' After thinking about it seriously, Feltia decided to accept her offer. "All right, I will accept your offer, Lady Ashreth."

"That's good." Ashreth responded with a seductive smile and then lifted Feltia behind the bar counter, a feat of strength that surprised her. However, several groups of female demons suddenly entered the pub, their appearances messy, as if they had just fought a strong opponent.
Feltia didn't care much about those female demons, especially since they weren't that strong in her eyes, and she was more curious about Ashreth. 'Hey, Mei, show me this woman's status.'
[Sure]
Name: Ashreth
Age: 1000+ years old
Gender: Female
Race: Dark Elf
Rank: Marchioness
Element: Darkness
Physique: Elf Physique
Abilities: Regenerative healing factor (passive), enhanced strength, enhanced stamina, dark arts, environmental adaptation (passive), subterranean adaptation (passive), etc.
Strong: Darkness
Weak: Light
'Hmm? Mei, which of her abilities should I copy?'

[Master, your demon physique strengthening method has already made your physique much stronger than most demons or cultivators, and it will continue to do so as your cultivation increases further. Also, your stamina is very high, so I suggest you copy her regenerative healing factor, especially since it is a passive ability and will help you recover faster if you suffer any serious injuries.]
'I see.' Feltia nodded in agreement with that. 'All right, I will find a way to copy her regenerative healing factor.'

The female demons immediately approached the counter, prompting Ashreth to ask them questions. "What happened to all of you? Why are your appearances so messy? Aren't you guys looking for that spoiled girl?"

One of them released a heavy sigh before answering her question. "Lady Ashreth, we won't be able to complete that mission, especially since that siren girl entered the death valley, which is really scary."

"We have reached the death valley before, but there are too many strong demon beasts there, so we are not their opponents, Lady Ashreth." Another female demon responded by applying an item like an ointment to the wounds on her hands.

Another female demon was also explained to Ashreth. "They were right, Lady Ashreth. We tried to fight some of them, but their numbers were simply too many, and two of us died there. That's why we decided to retreat and return to this city, or we would die there."

'Hmm? A siren?' Upon hearing that, Feltia raised her eyebrows and immediately opened the map to locate the death valley, assuming the siren girl had a connection to her second quest. Eventually, she pinpointed the death valley's location, only to discover that it was within White Amaris's domain, concealed by a towering mountain range teeming with numerous formidable demon creatures. 'Tch!
I had previously suspected that the area was indeed unusual, and it turned out to be a truly scary place.'

"I see." Ashreth nodded in understanding after listening to their explanation. "All right, you guys can go back to your places and rest, and I will send a stronger group there to rescue that girl, or her mother will blame us for not being able to save her daughter."
"Yes, Lady Ashreth."

"Let's go." Ashreth immediately pulled Feltia into the door behind the bar, and they walked down a wide hallway. However, the hallway was quite frightening, with numerous heads of various demons and demon beasts mounted on the walls. "Are you scared of them? These heads are trophies from the demon hunters who work under me, and most of them come from outside this sub-realm."

"No." Feltia responded by shaking her head. "I've seen much more horrific things before, so these heads have no impact on me. In any case, who is the siren girl that you and your colleagues were discussing earlier, Lady Ashreth? Why do you look so serious about her disappearance?"

Ashreth sighed softly and told Feltia directly. "Her name is Nauvia, and her mother, Nadea, is one of my Lady Black Amaris' loyal servants, so their status is higher than mine. That girl has a naughty, spoiled, and rebellious character, and she has disappeared numerous times, making it difficult for us to save her.

This is particularly challenging because she frequently escapes to the most dangerous places in this sub-realm, and she has also gone to the sub-realms of other rulers before. Even so, the reward for saving her is always big, so the other demon hunters don't care about their personal affairs and aim for the reward."
"Since her mother is one of my Lady Black Amaris' loyal servants, she should be powerful, right? Why doesn't she look for her daughter herself?"

"Ha ha." Ashreth laughed softly while hugging Feltia's arm. "I don't know for sure about life in the sub-realm of other rulers, but life in this sub-realm is completely different and harsh. The tower offers the best life in this sub-realm, but only the chosen demons can gain entry.

Even though Nadea is now one of my lady's loyal followers, her position is never safe, and many other demons are always targeting it. That's why she is unable to leave the tower, constantly focusing on securing her position, fearing that her life would spiral downhill if she were to be expelled from that place."
'Not only humans, but even demons also think about material things, huh?' Feltia then asked Ashreth again. "Lady, do you know anything about the sand demon snake?"
Ashreth immediately stopped walking and looked at Feltia with raised eyebrows. "Did you come to this sub-realm to hunt the sand demon snake? Do you know how powerful that demon beast is?"

"Haha." Feltia laughed awkwardly as she shook her head at Ashreth. "I don't know for sure about the sand demon snake's strength, but I heard that there is a huge reward for killing it. That's why I thought about hunting it, but I don't know its hiding location."

"You are right; the reward for killing the sand demon snake is indeed great, and it lives in a desert in the bright area." Ashreth answered with a nod. However, the demon beast's strength surpasses that of a marquis or a marchioness, and it also possesses immunity to certain elements, such as poison and petrification. Even Kyllia, the strongest in this city, has challenged it once.

However, their battle resulted in her defeat, leaving her with severe injuries. As for you, your demon rank is still at baroness rank, so you should abandon your desire to challenge that beast, or else your death would be in vain."

'The sand demon snake's strength is slightly higher than the marquis and marchioness, huh? If that's true, I can ask Boitata to kill that snake, and he definitely won't have any trouble doing it.' Feltia muttered inwardly as she searched the map for the desert location Ashreth was referring to. She quickly found it, but the demon beast was not visible there.

Could it possibly be lurking beneath the desert? Sigh. I'll devise a plan to reach there later, particularly since the quest doesn't have a time limit. My primary focus will be on increasing my demon rank, but I need to find some female demons first.'
[Why don't you seduce Ashreth directly, Master? Her demon rank is quite high, and you can get a lot of female essence from her.]

Feltia naturally wanted to seduce Ashreth, but she was one of the Amaris Twins' confidants, so she didn't want to rashly seduce her, especially since she herself was in the enemy's nest, which would be detrimental to her. 'Sigh, I'll think of a way to seduce her, but I won't do it anytime soon.'

"Are you still thinking about hunting the snake demon beast?" Ashreth asked through squinted eyes, and Feltia immediately nodded, causing her to sigh heavily. "You are such a daredevil, huh? What if you join one of the demon hunter groups? You can increase your strength while carrying out several missions that suit your demon rank, and you can hunt that snake once you are truly ready."
"That's not a bad idea, and I'll take you up on your offer." Feltia nodded in response before posing another question. "Do you always care about all demons as much as you do about me, Lady Ashreth?"

"Ha ha." Ashreth laughed at Feltia's question. "Honestly, I don't really care if they die while carrying out the mission, and that's actually better because the population in this sub-realm is already too large, and their death will make the competition even less. However, you are such a cute succubi, so I don't want you to die."
'What a ridiculous reason!' Feltia silently spoke. "Why do you care so much about succubi? Do you really like the demons of my race?"

"Yes, I do like succubi, but I hate incubus." Feltia raised her eyebrows after hearing that, and Ashreth then explained it to her. "You must already know that there are only female demons in this realm, right? This is because the two rulers don't like male demons, and neither do the female demons who live here, including me."
"So all female demons in this realm are like people of the same sex, huh?"

"Yes." Ashreth answered with a nod. "Moreover, you, succubi, have some unique abilities that can make us horny and orgasm without having to have sex, right? That's why I like your race; however, there aren't many of them in this sub-realm, so I want you to stay by my side to help me with your abilities."

[Hahaha!] Mei suddenly laughed inside Feltia's mind. [Isn't this a good opportunity for you, Master? Ashreth has already stated her wishes clearly, so you don't need to be afraid of her and other demons anymore, and you can make the best use of the opportunity in front of you.]
After hearing that, Feltia shook her head slightly. "All right, I will help you as much as possible, Lady Ashreth."

"Hehe, that's good." Ashreth then took her to the room at the end of the hall, where many female demons gathered. "Hey guys, Feltia is a newcomer to this sub-realm, and she will stay here with you all from today onward, so I hope you guys will treat her well, or I will punish you if any of you dare to treat her badly."
Those female demons nodded to Ashreth, but they also felt jealous of Feltia, especially since she preferred her so much.

Ashreth then pointed to one of them, who was a dark elf like her. "Fyr, I have to go meet our rulers, so Feltia will join your group, and you can explain to her about the demon hunter rules and stuff."
"Yes, Sister Ashreth."
Ashreth then turned to Feltia. "For the time being, you can learn many things from Fyr, and I will see you again after I return from the tower."
- To Be Continued -

While Zhang Fei and his two clones were busy with their own affairs, three days had already passed in the Sky Jade Realm.

A woman with long black hair wearing a long gray dress was standing in the sky above the vast expanse of ocean, but her eyes were filled with uncertainty, and her expression was also confused. "Sigh, I have to meet them, especially since I can't decide it on my own, so I'll ask for their opinion first."
After saying that, the woman jumped into the ocean, transformed into a giant white sea serpent, and swam to the bottom at full speed.

Some time later, the woman arrived in front of an underwater cave, and she used her tail to open the formation panel at the side of the entrance. After that, he darted into the cave passage, reaching its end within a few minutes.

Even though the cave was underwater, the inside was spacious and dry. The woman then leaped out of the water, transformed back into her human form, and swiftly flew into the cave's hall. There are two giant sea serpents that appear to be sleeping in the hall; one is reddish white, and the other is pinkish white.
"Mother! Grandmother!"
Upon hearing that, the pair immediately opened their eyes, and the pinkish-white sea serpent questioned her. "Why did you suddenly come here, Xueyi?"

Shen Xueyi released a soft sigh before replying to her. "Mother, I'm facing a problem, and I can't decide it myself, so I decided to come here to talk to you first, especially since this problem is related to Yu'er."

Shen Xueyi's expression was so serious that the two sea serpents immediately turned to their human forms. The reddish-white sea serpent turned into a tall and slender woman; she had long black hair. Even though she looks sexy and seductive in a long black and white dress, she exudes a calming and immersive aura.
Her elliptical face is quite pretty, with two wide eyes, thin eyebrows, a slender nose, and thick pink lips underneath.

As for the pinkish-white sea serpent, she turned into a woman with waist-length brown hair. Unlike the previous woman, a pink and white dress covered her curvaceous body. If the previous woman's breasts were small, then the second woman had quite big breasts. Her oval face looks lovely, with slanted brown eyes, a pair of sharp eyebrows, an attractively sharp nose, and thin red lips.
Even so, her expression was too serious, and she didn't seem to like to smile.
Shen Huang, the long black-haired woman, was the third-generation ancestor of their clan. The brown-haired woman was Shen Xinya, the fourth generation of their clan.
"Now you can tell us about your problem, Little Xueyi." Shen Huang said it after they sat together on the cave floor.

Shen Xueyi nodded to her grandmother, then began to tell them about Shen Yu's relationship with Zhang Fei. In addition, Shen Xueyi shared with them all the information she had previously learned from her daughter about him, including his affiliations with the Liu Clan and several other clans, as well as his actions in subduing Boitata despite his relatively low cultivation level.
After Shen Xueyi finished telling them everything, Shen Huang and Shen Xinya exchanged glances, and their expressions also turned serious.

"Do you two recognize the type of his fox bloodline, Mother and Grandmother?" Shen Xueyi asked with curiosity, as the two women's serious expressions suggested they recognized Zhang Fei's fox bloodline.
They did not directly answer Shen Xueyi's question, and Shen Xinya asked her mother instead. "Do you think that Zhang Fei came from that legendary fox race?"

"Yes." Shen Huang replied with a nod. "If Yue'er is telling the truth about Zhang Fei's bloodline being superior to the moon foxes, then there is no doubt that he came from that legendary fox race. However, that race has long disappeared from this realm, so I felt weird with his sudden appearance."
"The legendary fox race?" Shen Xueyi raised her eyebrows in confusion. "Which fox race are you referring to? Is there really a fox race that can surpass those moon foxes?"

The two women sighed softly, and Shen Huang then explained it to her granddaughter. "In the past, before the Moon Fox Race inhabited this realm, there existed a fox race that was far superior to those living here, but the entire fox race abruptly decided to leave this realm.

According to our ancestors' story, they deliberately left because the Qi in this realm was no longer sufficient to sustain them. If they continued to stay, this realm would eventually run out of Qi, which could lead to its destruction. That's why they decided to leave this realm and move on to a higher realm, but our ancestors did not have solid information about that."
Shen Xueyi felt even more confused by their explanation. "Grandma, what exactly is his fox bloodline?"

"That fox race's name is the heavenly fox, and they are far superior to those moon foxes." Shen Xueyi, who had never heard of the fox race before, raised her eyebrows as Shen Huang continued. "You don't need to be confused about them, and they really existed in this realm far in the past.

However, they erased all records of their race before they left this realm, and they also erased the memories of all the inhabitants of this realm. However, they deliberately didn't erase the memories of us beasts, especially since they were too superior to us, and they looked down on us."

"How could they perform such a feat?" Shen Xueyi asked in shock because their feats were too terrifying, as they could even erase their existences from the memories of all the residents of the Sky Jade Realm.

"The heavenly fox race is indeed terrifying, and their strength has no limits." Shen Xinya said it with a sigh. "According to legend, they have the ability to teleport, and they can also switch realms easily, which is why we are certain that Zhang Fei is their member."
Despite their previous statements, Shen Xueyi appeared to find it difficult to accept them. "Anyway, what do you mean by higher realm?"

Shen Huang chuckled at Shen Xueyi's curious expression. "According to legend, the Saint Realm is not the pinnacle of cultivation, but there is still a Quasi-Divine Realm above it, Little Xueyi. Once we surpass that realm, we will be rejected by the laws of this realm, and we will be sent to a higher realm."
Shen Xueyi took a deep breath and muttered to herself. "Even reaching the sovereign realm is really not easy, let alone the quasi-divin realm."

"Cultivation is never easy." Shen Xinya said it with a shake of her head. "Your grandmother and I have lived in seclusion for a long time, but our cultivation is still stuck at the 10 Star Heaven Realm. Even though we have repeatedly tried to break through to the sovereign realm, we have never managed to get past the final barrier."

"Yeah, that's true; I also had a hard time breaking through to that stage." Shen Xueyi replied with a bitter smile on her beautiful face. "So, what should I do about Yu'er? She appears to have been enamored with Zhang Fei, and she never liked Shen Tianyu either. However, I don't dare make a decision about their engagement, so I want to hear your opinions first."

chapters.title: Chapter 226: Their Decisions
paragraphs: After they thought about it for some time, Shen Huang immediately announced her decision. "If Yu'er has indeed fallen for Zhang Fei, I think it would be better if we didn't stop them from being together, and you could cancel her engagement with Shen Tianyu.

The heavenly fox is far superior to ordinary serpents like us, and you have experienced his power for yourself, so you should already understand a little about it. Even though he doesn't use his bloodline power directly, you already feel pressured by his aura; let alone if he uses it on you directly, you will be completely helpless before him."

"I agree with your grandmother, and you should cancel their engagement as soon as possible, Xueyi." Shen Xinya said as she nodded. "If Shen Haoran demands control of the Shen Clan in exchange, then you can hand over the control to him, and you can stay here with us to focus on cultivating afterwards."

"Eh?" Shen Xueyi was surprised by her mother's answer. "Mother, if I hand over control of our clan to Shen Haoran, then the situation within our clan will become chaotic, especially since Shen Wansan has also harbored the ambition to lead our clan. Furthermore, he will probably use his authority to suppress Yu'er, and he may force her to marry Tianyu."

"Haha." Shen Xinya laughed softly at her daughter's answer. "Actually, you don't need to worry about Yu'er, do you? We're absolutely certain that Zhang Fei is a heavenly fox, and she'll be safe if she stays by his side. Even though Shen Haoran's cultivation has reached the 9-Star Heaven Realm, we, as beast cultivators, differ from human cultivators.
His high cultivation will be ineffective against a higher bloodline, rendering him powerless to harm her."

Shen Huang then added to her daughter's words. "All of them are old now, but they were too greedy, and their ambitions eclipsed the heavens. Actually, our ancestors didn't think much about the future of our clan, and they never intended to make our clan the strongest in this realm, so I think it doesn't matter if our clan ends up being divided under Shen Haoran's leadership.

That way, you don't need to think about worldly affairs anymore, and you can focus on your cultivation here with us to break through to the sovereign realm. As for Yu'er, she is still very young now, so let her do whatever she wants, and she will be safe by Zhang Fei's side, which will be of great benefit to her."
"All right then, I will return to our clan and discuss this with Shen Haoran."
After Shen Xueyi vanished from their sight, Shen Xinya spoke to her mother. "It seems we have to come out of seclusion for some time, Mother."

"Yes." Shen Huang agreed with her daughter. "Even though I'm certain Zhang Fei is a heavenly fox, it would be better if we went back to our clan and checked on him directly. However, we have to do it carefully and don't alert him, or we'll be in danger if he thinks of us as his enemies."

"That's right." Shen Xinya nodded in agreement, but she suddenly had another idea. "Mother, what do you think if we approach Zhang Fei openly? If a heavenly fox really has the ability to freely go back and forth to other realms, we might be able to ask for his help to send us to a higher realm, and we might be able to break through to the sovereign realm faster."

"Hmm?" Shen Huang herself felt tempted by that, especially since she had been cultivating for too long, but she always found it difficult to break through to that stage, and she felt that something was lacking, so she repeatedly failed to break through.
"Forget it; we still don't know Zhang Fei, and he will probably think that we just want to take advantage of him if we do that, so let everything flow like water."
After that, they immediately left their seclusion cave, swam to the ocean's surface, and then proceeded to the Yin-Yang Pavilion.
Meanwhile, a woman infiltrated a clan, carefully examining the whereabouts of its members, only to be relieved when she discovered no one was present.

'Apparently, Pang Gui and Pang Zhen are busy taking care of our vassals in other regions, and Pang De already knows that the blood tree demon in the western region has fallen into the hands of my master, so he probably went to the central region to protect the tree there.'

The woman was none other than Pang Hong, who had become Zhang Fei's slave, and she immediately went to several areas in the clan to carry out her master's orders. Carefully, she planted the plant seeds that he had given her before, especially in important areas like the seclusion cave of the ancestors of the clan.

After successfully planting all the seeds, Pang Hong immediately left the Pang clan. However, she remained in the region, waiting for Zhang Fei's next order. He also took the two female puppets with her to hide somewhere else.

Zhang Fei's beast form finally evolved to four tails thanks to Boitata's beast essence, but he felt a little annoyed because the amount of beast essence he needed to evolve to five tails was simply too much, five times more than when he evolved to four tails, meaning it would take longer for him to evolve to five tails.

Zhang Chen, who felt uncomfortable watching his grandson dual-cultivate with them, decided to leave the training space whenever they carried out their sexual activities. Ru Xue resigned from the hospital after Huang Rong assisted her in communicating with the hospital, allowing her to concentrate on her training and cultivation in the training space. Zhang Fei, aware of his wife's eagerness to assist others, asked Liu Qingyu to prepare a small building for her clinic.

Additionally, Zhang Fei decided to buy modern medical equipment for Ru Xue's clinic from Earth, but he needed to install numerous solar panels to power them, particularly given the absence of electricity in the Sky Jade Realm.

That's why he returned to Earth to buy everything and monitor the progress of his shop, and Yang Lu'er had already taken care of his shop's affairs, including product advertising, so he didn't need to think too much about it.

However, Yang Lu'er was unable to complete the preparations quickly, particularly due to the need for special orders of modern medical equipment, which required some time. In addition, he accompanied her for a short while, but not for too long, as he preferred to concentrate on his training and cultivation.

As for Lillea, she wasn't too worried about training in the training space, especially since Zhang Fei had already told her that the time flow inside was four times faster than the Diyu Realm, so she could train to her heart's content.
Even though they don't dual-cultivate, they still help each other by giving their own yang qi and female essence to each other, which makes his demon rank almost level up to viscount rank.

Seeing that her husband had opened his eyes, Liu Hua immediately approached him while reminding him. "Fei'er, you should stop dual-cultivating with us for a few days, and your clone should also stop dual-cultivating with the female disciples of the Yin-Yang Pavilion, especially since your cultivation has already broken through six minor stages in rows in just three days.

That's why you have to stabilize it first, or your cultivation foundation will fall apart if your cultivation increases too rapidly. Furthermore, you must prepare yourself to break through to the soul realm, which is not as easy as breaking through to the core realm."

"Yeah, you're right about that. Actually, I have planned that myself, and I want to focus on my training for the next few days." Zhang Fei answered, pulling Liu Hua to sit beside him. "Even so, I will still supply them with my yang qi, so their cultivation won't lag far behind mine."

Liu Hua instantly concurred, as Zhang Fei's rapid advancement in cultivation had left everyone, lagging behind him, except for her and her big sister. Even Chu Ying, who previously had the highest cultivation among them, is now behind him, mainly because his women are too numerous.

"It's fine if you do that for them, and each of them can stabilize their cultivation while they wait for you to finish dual-cultivating with the others. Anyway, we've been here for three days, and the Wen Twins should have almost arrived at the Qiao Clan, so I have to go out first to contact them and make sure everything goes smoothly."
"All right." After that, Zhang Fei immediately sent Liu Hua out of the training space, and he himself joined his other wives to continue his training.

As soon as she arrived at the Chu Clan, Liu Hua immediately met Liu Qingyu while contacting the Wen Twins, who informed her that they had arrived in the eastern region. "They're on their way to the Qiao clan, Big Sis."
"En." Liu Qingyu nodded to his little sister. "Since Qiao Ran is with them, the Qiao Clan will comply with his orders, and Qiao Fei, who is still in the demon cave, won't be able to stop them.

However, they may face opposition from the Huan Clan due to their allegiance to Huan Jingtian, but it won't be a significant issue as he was away, and Fei'er had already sent Huan Chong to the Netherworld Realm."

"Let's wait for news from the Wen Twins, then." Liu Hua then turned to the two tigresses, who were playing around in the garden, before asking her big sister again. "What do you think if Ying'er makes a contract with one of them? After all, she still doesn't have a beast contract, and Qing'er has Jie Yuan by her side."

"Hmm?" Liu Qingyu raised his eyebrows while watching the two tigresses. "It's feasible, and I'm sure that Fei'er won't object to it. However, the other tigress will feel jealous if her sister finds a master, so we should also find one for her. It would be better if you became her master, especially since you are one of his wives."

Hearing her last sentence, Liu Hua looked at her big sister with a strange look, especially since Liu Qingyu herself could be considered one of Zhang Fei's women, and they had dual-cultivated many times. Unfortunately, her status is still another man's wife, and Chu Hong is still alive, so she can't be his official woman yet.

"I know what you're thinking." Liu Qingyu expressed her thoughts while shaking her head. "Honestly, I enjoyed my time with Fei'er, but I kept feeling guilty towards Chu Hong because of my affair with him, and I didn't dare imagine the consequences if he and our daughters found out about our relationship, especially Xing'er."

Ling Hua could naturally understand her big sister's feelings, so she embraced Liu Qingyu's shoulders, but she felt at a loss to comfort her. Suddenly, she got a voice transmission from the Wen Twins. "They just arrived at the Qiao Clan."

"If Yu'er has indeed fallen for Zhang Fei, I think it would be better if we didn't stop them from being together, and you could cancel her engagement with Shen Tianyu.
The heavenly fox is far superior to ordinary serpents like us, and you have experienced his power for yourself, so you should already understand a little about it.
Even though he doesn't use his bloodline power directly, you already feel pressured by his aura; let alone if he uses it on you directly, you will be completely helpless before him."
"I agree with your grandmother, and you should cancel their engagement as soon as possible, Xueyi." Shen Xinya said as she nodded.
"If Shen Haoran demands control of the Shen Clan in exchange, then you can hand over the control to him, and you can stay here with us to focus on cultivating afterwards."
"Eh?" Shen Xueyi was surprised by her mother's answer.

"Haha." Shen Xinya laughed softly at her daughter's answer.
"Actually, you don't need to worry about Yu'er, do you?
We're absolutely certain that Zhang Fei is a heavenly fox, and she'll be safe if she stays by his side.
Even though Shen Haoran's cultivation has reached the 9-Star Heaven Realm, we, as beast cultivators, differ from human cultivators.
His high cultivation will be ineffective against a higher bloodline, rendering him powerless to harm her."
Shen Huang then added to her daughter's words.
"All of them are old now, but they were too greedy, and their ambitions eclipsed the heavens.

That way, you don't need to think about worldly affairs anymore, and you can focus on your cultivation here with us to break through to the sovereign realm.
As for Yu'er, she is still very young now, so let her do whatever she wants, and she will be safe by Zhang Fei's side, which will be of great benefit to her."
"All right then, I will return to our clan and discuss this with Shen Haoran."
After Shen Xueyi vanished from their sight, Shen Xinya spoke to her mother.
"It seems we have to come out of seclusion for some time, Mother."
"Yes." Shen Huang agreed with her daughter.

However, we have to do it carefully and don't alert him, or we'll be in danger if he thinks of us as his enemies."
"That's right." Shen Xinya nodded in agreement, but she suddenly had another idea.

If a heavenly fox really has the ability to freely go back and forth to other realms, we might be able to ask for his help to send us to a higher realm, and we might be able to break through to the sovereign realm faster."

After that, they immediately left their seclusion cave, swam to the ocean's surface, and then proceeded to the Yin-Yang Pavilion.
Meanwhile, a woman infiltrated a clan, carefully examining the whereabouts of its members, only to be relieved when she discovered no one was present.

'Apparently, Pang Gui and Pang Zhen are busy taking care of our vassals in other regions, and Pang De already knows that the blood tree demon in the western region has fallen into the hands of my master, so he probably went to the central region to protect the tree there.'
The woman was none other than Pang Hong, who had become Zhang Fei's slave, and she immediately went to several areas in the clan to carry out her master's orders.
Carefully, she planted the plant seeds that he had given her before, especially in important areas like the seclusion cave of the ancestors of the clan.
After successfully planting all the seeds, Pang Hong immediately left the Pang clan.
However, she remained in the region, waiting for Zhang Fei's next order.
He also took the two female puppets with her to hide somewhere else.
