chapters.title: Chapter 227: Take Over The Clan
paragraphs: As soon as they arrived at the Qiao Clan, Qiao Ran immediately gathered all her clan members in the main hall, but they were wondering about the presence of the Wen Twins and the people from the demon fox group, especially since most of them released their killing intent to provide deterrence against them.

Even though she disagreed with Zhang Fei's wishes, Qiao Ran had no choice but to follow his wishes due to the demon slave mark in her soul, and she announced to them that their clan would join under the auspices of the Chu Clan, which shocked them.

Some of them wanted to oppose Qiao Ran's decision, but the Wen Twins and the people from the demon fox group immediately moved to stop them, pressing their weapons on their necks, causing them to break out in a cold sweat. "All of you only have two choices: submit to us or die! Think carefully before you guys make a decision."

Qiao Ran inwardly sighed, watching the actions of the Wen Twins and the others, and he then spoke to his clan members again. "I understand your thoughts, but the situation has changed because my mother has decided to become a vassal of the Pang Clan, and all the cultivators in this realm already know about it.
That's why I made this decision to protect us, and joining the Chu Clan is the best course of action for us. Otherwise, the other cultivators might attack our clan and massacre us."

The revelation made the people from the Qiao Clan even more shocked, as they knew exactly how evil the people from the Pang Clan were. Unfortunately, they didn't know anything about the matter because the decision was taken unilaterally by Qiao Fei and Qiao Ran, especially since they were both the decision-makers in their clan.

"Moreover, the Zhang Clan from the Central Region supports the Chu Clan, making it advantageous for us to be under their protection." Qiao Ran's words caused those people to waver, and they also believed her decision to be beneficial, especially since not many people could have a relationship with people from that region, and the Zhang Clan was the second most powerful group there.

"My mother, who is far away in the demon cave, is still unaware of this matter. If I inform her about it now, she will relay it to the Pang Clan. Therefore, I will wait for her return before informing her about my decision. However, my decision to join them does not imply that we will abandon our clan; our clan will continue to exist as usual, but the decision will be in their hands."
Seeing those people's expressions, the Wen Twins and the people from the demon fox group immediately withdrew their killing intent, allowing them to breathe freely again.

After seriously considering Qiao Ran's words, they chose to accept her decision to join the Chu Clan. After all, they were aware that the decision to become a vassal of the Pang Clan was a grave mistake, and they did not want to die at the hands of other cultivators.

Once everyone agreed to the decision, Qiao Ran led the Wen Twins to her clan's treasury, where they promptly stored the treasures in their storage ring, as instructed by Zhang Fei. Despite this, they left behind a significant amount to cater to the Qiao Clan's needs, and they could obtain more through their various businesses in the eastern region.

Qiao Ran felt helpless watching them take most of his clan's treasures, especially since she and her mother had been collecting them for so long, but their years of hard work had been in vain because they would become Zhang Fei's. "Are we going to the Huan Clan now?"
"Yes." Wen Yuan replied with a nod. "However, we will not directly attack that clan; Big Sis Hua asked us to investigate the situation within the clan first."

Wen Xuan immediately added her twin sister's words. "Since Huang Jingtian is your partner in name, Big Sis Hua wants you to persuade them first to avoid bloodshed. However, if they are not willing to obey you and insist on putting up resistance, then we will attack them and slaughter them according to Zhang Fei's orders."

"We don't need to waste time waiting, and you can order them to prepare to attack the clan directly." The Wen Twins raised their eyebrows at Qiao Ran's answer, especially since the Liu Sisters asked them to minimize casualties.
"Despite my status as Huang Jingtian's partner in name, they will never obey me, especially since he has already given something to the main members of his clan, so they are completely loyal to him."
"What did Huang Jingtian give them?"

Qiao Ran shook his head at Wen Yuan. "Before my mother and I decided to join the Pang Clan, Huang Jingtian had already brought his clan to join them, and they gave him something to control his clan's people."
"What about you? Do you and your mother give that kind of thing to your clan people?"

"Didn't you see my clan members' reactions yourself before?" Qiao Ran then walked to a painting and lifted it up, and she took out a black bottle from a small hole behind the painting before giving it to the Wen Twins. "Pang Zhen didn't tell us the name of the pills, but he said that these pills can control the minds of our clan members.
Although we also want power, we are different from Huang Jingtian, and we don't want to use it on our clan members."
After they checked the pills in the bottle, the Wen Twins immediately contacted the Liu Sisters and informed them about it, and Liu Hua immediately ordered them to destroy the Huan Clan completely.
Wen Yuan then spoke to Qiao Ran. "Bring some of the strongest people in your clan to go with us, and we will eradicate the Huan Clan today."
"All right."
After Qiao Ran gathered several people from her clan, they immediately left for the Huan Clan, which was only a few miles away from the Qiao Clan.

However, they refrained from taking immediate action to destroy the Huan Clan due to the daytime and the large number of people in the city, fearing that their actions could cause a significant disturbance. Instead, they decided to wait until nightfall.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] sat in a chair with a satisfied smile on his face, especially after he dual-cultivated with those female disciples. However, only Xia Qianqian, whose cultivation has increased quite significantly, especially since her previous cultivation was still at 7-Star Foundation Realm but has reached 10-Star now, will break through to the core realm soon.

"You're truly insane, you know." Zhang Fei [1] immediately turned to Shi Yue, who was still naked and exhausted after dual-cultivating with him several times in the past three days, but her cultivation and physique were much stronger than Luo Yu and the others, so her condition was much better than theirs.

"I know that you are special and have many other partners out there, but I still have difficulty understanding your cultivation speed. Anyway, you shouldn't break through to the Soul Realm anytime soon, and it would be better if you waited some time to do so."
"I know." Zhang Fei [1] nodded to Shi Yue. "Hua'er has also told me about it, so I will stop dual-cultivating with you guys for the time being, and I will only help them with my yang qi."

Shi Yue was relieved by Zhang Fei [1]'s answer. "I don't know what exactly your problem is that makes you so thirsty for power, but you must always remember that power cannot be built overnight, or you will suffer the losses yourself, and worst of all, you could become a cripple if you are too hasty with it."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed and pulled Shi Yue onto his lap. "Why are you so worried about me? Are you afraid that no one can satisfy you anymore?"

"Humph!" Shi Yue snorted at Zhang Fe [1] before admitting it. "That's right; I care about you because you are the only man who can satisfy my lust, so I don't want to lose you, or I will also suffer if something bad happens to you. Anyway, I met Tang Rou yesterday, and she seemed so scared after her dual cultivation with you a few days ago."

"Hehe." Zhang Fei [1] chuckled upon hearing about the old woman. "At first, I didn't think about dual-cultivating with her, especially since she was too old and weak. However, she suddenly kidnapped me and gave me a liquid that had an aphrodisiac-like effect, so I dual-cultivated with her to teach her a lesson, but I didn't expect that she would be so scared now."
"Does that mean you won't dual-cultivate with Tang Rou anymore?"

"No." Zhang Fe [1] answered by shaking his head. "I was never attracted to her in the first place, so I won't dual-cultivate with her anymore. Actually, I'm more attracted to Yan Luan'er, especially since her Yin Qi is quite strong, and it's stronger than yours. Unfortunately, she holds the position of vice sect master in this sect, making it impossible for me to get closer to her."

After hearing that, Shi Yue narrowed her eyes, but she herself admitted that Yan Luan'er was indeed much better than her in terms of cultivation and Yin Qi. "In fact, you don't need to think about that. Her character is too wild and nonchalant, and she's harder to control compared to Yan Zixiu. That's why I'm sure that she will come to you soon, so you can dual-cultivate with her later.
Besides, she'll probably bring Xi Zihua with her, so you can get two birds at once."
Zhang Fei [1] nodded with a smile before speaking to Shi Yue again. "Anyway, I need your help to meet someone, and he is one of my goals for joining this sect."
"Who is that woman?"
"Shen Yu."

"Huh?" Shi Yue was shocked to hear that name come out of Zhang Fei [1]'s mouth. "How do you know Shen Yu? Do you have a special relationship with her? Do you know her status in the sect? She is also Shen Tianyu's fiancée, and they will be getting married soon."

"I met Yu'er at Blazing Volcano Mountain some time ago, and I was attracted to her the moment we met there." Shi Yue was stunned for a moment after hearing that, but she remembered that Shen Yu had indeed gone there with several other disciples, and Zhang Fei [1] then continued.

"At first, I didn't know that she already had a fiancé, but I've heard many things about her from Ning Xiang and Du Yuan, including about her status in her clan. However, I don't care about her fiancé or her status, and I'll still take her as my woman. If Shen Tianyu and the rest of the Shen Clan want to oppose our relationship, then I will destroy them, so I hope you can help me meet her."

Shi Yue massaged her forehead after hearing Zhang Fe [1]'s answer, especially since his relationship with Shen Yu would bring chaos to their sect in the future. However, his expression made her believe that he would really do that, causing her to let out a soft sigh.
"I really want to help you meet him, but my elder's status in this sect is not as high as others, so they won't allow me to enter that place."
"Do you know Yu'er's exact location?"

"Shen Yu is at the bottom of the tower, so we have to pass through several areas to get there, including the place where Shen Tianyu performed seclusion." Hearing that, Zhang Fei [1] immediately shifted Shi Yue from his lap and hurried to get dressed, but she immediately grabbed his hand. "Are you thinking about going there?
If Shen Haoran and the people from the Shen Clan find out about your presence there, let alone meet her, then they will definitely capture you and punish you severely."

Zhang Fei [1] immediately activated his invisibility, causing Shi Yue's jaw to drop, especially since she could still feel his hands, even though she couldn't see his figure. "Before, I restrained myself because I didn't know Shen Yu's exact location, but I now know, so I'm going to meet her."
Shi Yue let out a heavy sigh once Zhang Fei [1] left, and she immediately got dressed before leaving his room. "I really hope they won't find him, or the situation will become troublesome."

"We don't need to waste time waiting, and you can order them to prepare to attack the clan directly." The Wen Twins raised their eyebrows at Qiao Ran's answer, especially since the Liu Sisters asked them to minimize casualties.
"Despite my status as Huang Jingtian's partner in name, they will never obey me, especially since he has already given something to the main members of his clan, so they are completely loyal to him."
"What did Huang Jingtian give them?"
Qiao Ran shook his head at Wen Yuan.
"Before my mother and I decided to join the Pang Clan, Huang Jingtian had already brought his clan to join them, and they gave him something to control his clan's people."
"What about you?
Do you and your mother give that kind of thing to your clan people?"

"Didn't you see my clan members' reactions yourself before?" Qiao Ran then walked to a painting and lifted it up, and she took out a black bottle from a small hole behind the painting before giving it to the Wen Twins.
"Pang Zhen didn't tell us the name of the pills, but he said that these pills can control the minds of our clan members.
Although we also want power, we are different from Huang Jingtian, and we don't want to use it on our clan members."
After they checked the pills in the bottle, the Wen Twins immediately contacted the Liu Sisters and informed them about it, and Liu Hua immediately ordered them to destroy the Huan Clan completely.
Wen Yuan then spoke to Qiao Ran.
"Bring some of the strongest people in your clan to go with us, and we will eradicate the Huan Clan today."
"All right."
After Qiao Ran gathered several people from her clan, they immediately left for the Huan Clan, which was only a few miles away from the Qiao Clan.

However, they refrained from taking immediate action to destroy the Huan Clan due to the daytime and the large number of people in the city, fearing that their actions could cause a significant disturbance.
Instead, they decided to wait until nightfall.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] sat in a chair with a satisfied smile on his face, especially after he dual-cultivated with those female disciples.

However, only Xia Qianqian, whose cultivation has increased quite significantly, especially since her previous cultivation was still at 7-Star Foundation Realm but has reached 10-Star now, will break through to the core realm soon.

"You're truly insane, you know." Zhang Fei [1] immediately turned to Shi Yue, who was still naked and exhausted after dual-cultivating with him several times in the past three days, but her cultivation and physique were much stronger than Luo Yu and the others, so her condition was much better than theirs.
"I know that you are special and have many other partners out there, but I still have difficulty understanding your cultivation speed.
Anyway, you shouldn't break through to the Soul Realm anytime soon, and it would be better if you waited some time to do so."
"I know." Zhang Fei [1] nodded to Shi Yue.
"Hua'er has also told me about it, so I will stop dual-cultivating with you guys for the time being, and I will only help them with my yang qi."
Shi Yue was relieved by Zhang Fei [1]'s answer.

"I don't know what exactly your problem is that makes you so thirsty for power, but you must always remember that power cannot be built overnight, or you will suffer the losses yourself, and worst of all, you could become a cripple if you are too hasty with it."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed and pulled Shi Yue onto his lap.
"Why are you so worried about me?
Are you afraid that no one can satisfy you anymore?"
"Humph!" Shi Yue snorted at Zhang Fe [1] before admitting it.
"That's right; I care about you because you are the only man who can satisfy my lust, so I don't want to lose you, or I will also suffer if something bad happens to you.
Anyway, I met Tang Rou yesterday, and she seemed so scared after her dual cultivation with you a few days ago."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [1] chuckled upon hearing about the old woman.
"At first, I didn't think about dual-cultivating with her, especially since she was too old and weak.
However, she suddenly kidnapped me and gave me a liquid that had an aphrodisiac-like effect, so I dual-cultivated with her to teach her a lesson, but I didn't expect that she would be so scared now."
"Does that mean you won't dual-cultivate with Tang Rou anymore?"
"No." Zhang Fe [1] answered by shaking his head.
"I was never attracted to her in the first place, so I won't dual-cultivate with her anymore.
Actually, I'm more attracted to Yan Luan'er, especially since her Yin Qi is quite strong, and it's stronger than yours.
Unfortunately, she holds the position of vice sect master in this sect, making it impossible for me to get closer to her."
After hearing that, Shi Yue narrowed her eyes, but she herself admitted that Yan Luan'er was indeed much better than her in terms of cultivation and Yin Qi.
"In fact, you don't need to think about that.
Her character is too wild and nonchalant, and she's harder to control compared to Yan Zixiu.
That's why I'm sure that she will come to you soon, so you can dual-cultivate with her later.
Besides, she'll probably bring Xi Zihua with her, so you can get two birds at once."
Zhang Fei [1] nodded with a smile before speaking to Shi Yue again.
"Anyway, I need your help to meet someone, and he is one of my goals for joining this sect."
"Who is that woman?"
"Shen Yu."
"Huh?" Shi Yue was shocked to hear that name come out of Zhang Fei [1]'s mouth.
"How do you know Shen Yu?
Do you have a special relationship with her?
Do you know her status in the sect?
She is also Shen Tianyu's fiancée, and they will be getting married soon."

"I met Yu'er at Blazing Volcano Mountain some time ago, and I was attracted to her the moment we met there." Shi Yue was stunned for a moment after hearing that, but she remembered that Shen Yu had indeed gone there with several other disciples, and Zhang Fei [1] then continued.
"At first, I didn't know that she already had a fiancé, but I've heard many things about her from Ning Xiang and Du Yuan, including about her status in her clan.
However, I don't care about her fiancé or her status, and I'll still take her as my woman.
If Shen Tianyu and the rest of the Shen Clan want to oppose our relationship, then I will destroy them, so I hope you can help me meet her."
Shi Yue massaged her forehead after hearing Zhang Fe [1]'s answer, especially since his relationship with Shen Yu would bring chaos to their sect in the future.
However, his expression made her believe that he would really do that, causing her to let out a soft sigh.
"I really want to help you meet him, but my elder's status in this sect is not as high as others, so they won't allow me to enter that place."
"Do you know Yu'er's exact location?"

"Shen Yu is at the bottom of the tower, so we have to pass through several areas to get there, including the place where Shen Tianyu performed seclusion." Hearing that, Zhang Fei [1] immediately shifted Shi Yue from his lap and hurried to get dressed, but she immediately grabbed his hand.
"Are you thinking about going there?
If Shen Haoran and the people from the Shen Clan find out about your presence there, let alone meet her, then they will definitely capture you and punish you severely."
Zhang Fei [1] immediately activated his invisibility, causing Shi Yue's jaw to drop, especially since she could still feel his hands, even though she couldn't see his figure.
"Before, I restrained myself because I didn't know Shen Yu's exact location, but I now know, so I'm going to meet her."
Shi Yue let out a heavy sigh once Zhang Fei [1] left, and she immediately got dressed before leaving his room.
"I really hope they won't find him, or the situation will become troublesome."

chapters.title: Chapter 228: Meeting Shen Yu
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [1] casually walked down the stairs to the bottom of the tower while paying attention to every area he passed, and he saw many young cultivators from the Shen Clan cultivating in every available room there, both men and women. Fortunately, his invisibility prevented the strong cultivators of that clan from detecting his presence and aura.

After walking for a long time, Zhang Fei [1] arrived at a slightly different room from the others, and he saw a quite handsome young man cultivating inside. He then used his status to check the man's status, and he found out that the man was Shen Yu's fiancé, Shen Tianyu. "So this guy is her fiancé, huh? Should I do something to him?
However, if I do that, I will definitely alert the people of the Shen Clan, and I won't be able to meet and talk to Yu'er if that happens.'

Mei suddenly told him. [Master, I think there is an item in the system shop that you can use to distract him from his cultivation, and he might get injured if you use it on him, so you can delay his marriage with Shen Yu.]

Zhang Fei [1] was stunned after listening to Mei's words, and he thought that she was becoming more evil with each passing moment, which was probably due to his influence. 'What kind of items can I use on him?'
[Hehe. You'll definitely like the effect, master.]
{You got Phantasm Incense x1}
{1,000 red jewels have been deducted from your balance}
[You can take the incense now and use a small amount of your fire qi to light it, Master.]

Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows upon seeing that, and he naturally understood the incense's effect based on its name, so he immediately took it and lit it before directing the smoke towards Shen Tianyu.

As soon as Shen Tianyu inhaled the smoke from the incense, Zhang Fei [1] could see the change in his expression, and his expression quickly became obscene as he began to fall into his own delusions. 'Tch! All of the items in the system shop are overpowered! The incense's effect is almost instantaneous.'
However, Zhang Fei [1] was unaware of Shen Tianyu's fantasy until he suddenly heard his low mumbling. "Hehe, Yu'er, we are finally married, and you will be my woman tonight."
'Humph! You can enjoy your fantasies, and I'll go meet the real Yu'er.'

After that, Zhang Fei [1] walked down to the lowest area of the tower, and his gaze lit up when he saw Shen Yu in her sea serpent form curled up in the middle of the artificial lake, so he canceled his invisibility. "I've finally met you, Yu'er. Hey, Mei, open the portal to the training ground; I'll use my real body to talk to her."
[Aye Sir!]
Zhang Fei left the training space as soon as Mei opened the portal, walking straight towards Shen Yu.
Hearing the footsteps, Shen Yu slowly opened her eyes. However, the sight of the two Zhang Fei stunned her, causing her eyelids to open and close repeatedly as she stared at them.

She thought that she was hallucinating because she missed him so much, especially since there shouldn't be any other cultivators who could barge into her place under the watchful eyes of the strong cultivators of her Shen Clan.
Seeing her expression like that, Zhang Fei smiled at Shen Yu and opened his arms to the side. "Yu'er, it's me; I came here to meet you."
"Zhang Fei? Is this really you?" Shen Yu asked him, still with a look of disbelief.
"Yes, you're not dreaming; it's really me."

Hearing that, Shen Yu immediately returned to her human form and dashed toward Zhang Fei, disregarding her still-naked body. Shen Yu immediately jumped into Zhang Fei's arms, hugged him tightly, and spoke while sobbing. "Sob... I thought you would never come to see me... Sob... if you had come any later, we definitely wouldn't have been able to meet because I would already be Shen Tianyu's wife."

"I'm sorry I made you wait so long." Zhang Fei said apologetically as he hugged Shen Yu tightly. "I've confessed my feelings for you, and I want you to be my wife, so I won't let you marry another man."
"Haha." Shen Yu giggled while rubbing her face against Zhang Fei's chest. "I'm glad you're here now."

Zhang Fei himself was naturally happy to see her again, and he pushed Shen Yu back a little before wiping her tears. After that, he cupped her cheeks and planted a soft kiss on her sweet lips, and she unhesitatingly kissed him back before closing her eyes and hugging his neck.

Since she was naked, Zhang Fei immediately took off his clothes and took Shen Yu into the artificial lake, where they continued their increasingly hot kiss. Even so, he didn't do anything else to her; he just savored their kiss, especially since the situation didn't allow them to move on to the next stage.
"Mhn~" Shen Yu moaned softly as Zhang Fei pulled her tongue into his mouth, where he gently sucked it as he savored her warm and sweet nectar. "Mhn~"

To make the atmosphere more comfortable for them, Zhang Fei brought Shen Yu to sit inside the artificial lake with her on his lap, and she shyly wrapped her legs around his waist, especially after she realized that they were both naked.

After they kissed for a few minutes, Zhang Fei broke off their kiss, but Shen Yu immediately buried her red face into his broad shoulders. "Haha, why are you embarrassed like this? Sooner or later, you will definitely become my wife, so you don't need to be embarrassed towards me."
"How did you get in here? Didn't the people from my clan stop you?" Shen Yu then looked back at Zhang Fei [1]. "Who is he? How can there be two of you?"
"I am him, and he is me."

Shen Yu was dumbfounded listening to Zhang Fei [1] answer her, and she then looked at the real Zhang Fei with a look full of questions, so he immediately explained it to her. "He is my clone that I purposely sent to this sect to search for you and to find dual cultivation partners, especially since I can't leave my other wives behind. You should already realize it, right?

Even though he is my clone, we are actually the same individual. That's why I was able to come here as soon as he found you, especially since the two of us share everything, including our minds and techniques. Anyway, your clan member still didn't notice my presence in this place, which is thanks to one of my special abilities."

"A special ability?" Zhang Fei nodded and pointed at his clone, and Shen Yu was astonished as soon as his clone disappeared, especially since she couldn't feel his presence, including his aura. "An invisibility ability, huh? I've met some beasts that had such an ability in the past, but their ability couldn't conceal their presence and aura as neatly as yours."
"That's for sure!" Zhang Fei answered with a proud look. "They are ordinary beasts, and I am a heavenly fox, so all my abilities are much better than theirs."

"Hmm?" After hearing that, Shen Yu felt confused, as it was his first time learning about the heavenly fox. "Hey, you are a mythical beast, right? I once met people from the Moon Fox Race, and they were divine beasts. However, your beast aura outshone theirs, suppressing my bloodline upon our first encounter.
A few days ago, my mother also told me that she felt pressured when she stood next to you, but I've never heard of your fox race before."

"Haha." Zhang Fei chuckled after listening to Shen Yu. "After all, there are no other heavenly foxes besides me in this realm, and I come from another realm. However, my realm is a mortal realm, and my realm doesn't have Qi like this realm, so I decided to bring my family and my wives to this realm."

Shen Yu felt curious after hearing that, and she believed that Zhang Fei was not lying to her, especially since she had already witnessed some of his amazing abilities, including his teleportation ability, when he saved Du Yuan and Ning Xiang back then. Besides, he was able to infiltrate her clan's residence to meet her, and her clan's people were also still unaware of his presence.

'Mei! Open the gate to the earth!' Once again, Shen Yu was stunned as soon as the gate appeared before her eyes, and Zhang Fei directly led her through it. However, they didn't stay there for long, and he brought her back right away, or else the people from the Shen Clan would notice if she was missing for too long. "Do you believe me now?"

"Yes." Shen Yu responded by nodding. "In my entire life, I have never heard of another realm, let alone gone there. Even though it's only for a short time, I am really satisfied to be able to see your home realm, and I wish I could spend more time with you there."

"Don't worry, I will definitely take you on a trip to my home realm one day." Zhang Fei then turned to his clone, who immediately used invisibility to leave them. "It's just the two of us now, so we can have fun without distractions."

Upon noticing Zhang Fei's peculiar expression, Shen Yu swiftly covered her chest with her hands and inquired with narrowed eyes. "What are your thoughts? Why is your expression like that? Are you still not satisfied after dual-cultivating with seven women at once for three consecutive days?"

"Oh?" Instead, Zhang Fei smiled mischievously and teased Shen Yu. "Hmm, I didn't expect that my lovely serpent is such a naughty woman and a voyeur, and you even know that my clone dual-cultivates with them."

"No! I'm not that kind of woman!" Shen Yu denied that as she pursed her lips. "Three days ago, my mother came here and told me that you had joined this sect, and you had just been promoted to inner disciple. That's why I decided to check on you because I missed you so much, but I found you dual-cultivating with them instead.
However, I didn't expect that you already had Du Yuan and Ning Xiang as your dual cultivation partners, and they were willing to be your partners because you saved them from death."

"You're right about them; I came to them on purpose because I was sure that they wouldn't reject me after that incident." Zhang Fei then pulled Shen Yu's hands away from her chest before looking up and down at her beautiful, naked body, which made her heart flutter. "Honestly, I want to eat you right now, but I know that it will bring you trouble, so I have to restrain myself for now."

"En." Shen Yu replied with a weak nod. "As you already know, I am Shen Tianyu's fiancée, and our marriage won't be long now. However, I have never liked him, and in fact, I despise him, particularly because he frequently coerces female disciples into serving him. That's why I don't want to marry him, but I can't refuse it because our engagement was arranged by our clan according to our traditions."
Zhang Fei sighed softly and grabbed Shen Yu's shoulders. "Do you believe me?"
"I do."

"In that case, you don't need to think about your marriage to Shen Tianyu, and I will definitely take you away from this place if they still force you to marry her." However, Shen Yu felt hesitant and worried after hearing that, especially since there were so many strong cultivators in her clan.

Even though Zhang Fei was a mythical beast, and he also had a divine beast by his side, there was no way they could face so many powerful cultivators at once. "Trust me, okay? For the time being, you just need to focus on your cultivation, and I will help you break through to the earth realm, which will make you stronger than him."

"How can you help me break through to the Earth Realm?" Shen Yu inquired with uncertainty, particularly considering that Zhang Fei's cultivation was still significantly lower than hers, and she had also repeatedly failed to reach that level.

"Huh?" Shen Xueyi and Shen Yu immediately turned to him, their faces full of questions. "What have you done to him?"

sentences.text: Shen Yu showed Zhang Fei's remaining cum in her mouth to her mother before swallowing it, causing Shen Xueyi to sigh helplessly at her daughter's behavior.
"Mother, you have seen for yourself that I have done such things with him, so you should already understand my feelings.
I only want to be his wife, so I hope you are willing to annul my engagement to Shen Tianyu, even if it means breaking our clan's traditions."
'Tch!

I came here because I wanted to tell you that your grandmother and great-grandmother had agreed to cancel your engagement with Tianyu, but these two kept restricting my movements and not letting me talk, so I couldn't tell you.' Shen Xueyi inwardly grumbled as she looked at Zhang Fei and Boitata, hoping they would let her go soon so she could tell her daughter about it.

"Yu'er, you should have started to feel the changes in your body after swallowing my yang qi, so you should start meditating and swallowing those pills, and you will break through to the Earth Realm after that."
"Yes, I will do it now." Shen Yu immediately followed Zhang Fei's words by sitting cross-legged in front of them.
She took out the pills before starting to swallow them one by one, starting with the Essence Qi Pill, which would increase her Qi absorption speed so her body could absorb his yang qi faster.
Shen Xueyi frowned as she looked at the pills in her daughter's hand.
Despite her sealed cultivation, her beast instinct, honed over 500 years, sensed the changes in her daughter's body. 'What kind of pills are they?
Where did this brat get those pills from?
Moreover, the Qi flow in Yu'er's body has become faster than before, and she might be able to break through to the Earth Realm today.'

After her body absorbed the Essence Qi Pill, Shen Yu swallowed the Meridian Cleansing Pill, and black liquid began to cover her body after the pill took effect, so Zhang Fei helped her cleanse her body.
Minutes later, Shen Yu swallowed a Dantian Strengthening Pill, which was useful for making her Dantian two times stronger than other cultivators, so she would not easily suffer serious injuries.

After she finished that, Shen Yu decided to summon her cultivation soul in the form of a pink serpent, which made Zhang Fei eager to break through to the soul realm, and she immediately swallowed the Soul Enhanced Pill.
Shen Xueyi, who was still under the pressure of Zhang Fei and Boitata's aura, looked amazed after she witnessed several changes in her daughter's body.
Her expression became even more amazed after the Soul Enhanced Pill took effect, especially since Shen Yu's cultivation soul became brighter and stronger. 'Sigh!
I don't know where this brat got all those pills, but I'm truly grateful that he gave them to Yu'er, and he will definitely be able to surpass us in the future.'

A while later, Shen Yu had already drawn her cultivation soul back into her body, and she immediately swallowed the fifth pill, the Yin Purifying Pill, which was useful for refining her yin qi and making it two times purer.
After observing everything, Zhang Fei nodded in satisfaction and gave Shen Yu instructions.
"Yu'er, you can swallow the Beast Body Tempering Pill, and your beast form will become stronger after being tempered by it."
"En." Shen Yu nodded and swallowed the pill right away, but a few moments later, her expression turned painful due to the pill's effects.
Even so, she knew for sure that the pill's effect was very important in helping her, so she tried hard to endure the pain.

Seeing that, Shen Xueyi panicked and was afraid that something would happen to her daughter, but she saw Zhang Fei's expression so calm, and Boitata also smiled while nodding repeatedly with her gaze not moving from Shen Yu.
Sometime later, Shen Yu's expression had returned to normal, making her breathe a sigh of relief, and Shen Xueyi also became calmer after nothing happened to her daughter.
"Now, swallow the Beast Talent Pill, and it will increase your talent, so no one in your clan will be able to rival you."
'Beast talent pill?' Shen Xueyi muttered in shock after she heard about the effects of the pill. 'Could it be that he bought the pill in other realms?

We have searched for such a pill in all corners of this realm, including the central region, but not a single cultivator has the recipe to concoct such a pill, including Feng Yao, the sect master of the Blazing Phoenix Sect!'
Shen Yu swallowed the pill without hesitation, especially since he had experienced the effects of the previous six pills.

However, she herself had many questions in her heart about the pills, mainly because their effects worked almost instantly after she swallowed them, and the pills in the Sky Jade Realm couldn't work that fast.
Several minutes later, Zhang Fei spoke to Shen Yu again.

Although your beast rank will not immediately increase to quasi-divine, it will make it easier for you to reach that rank, and you can also become a divine beast in the future."
Unlike Shen Yu, who gleefully swallowed the Beast Advancement Pill, Shen Xueyi was completely rendered speechless by everything she had witnessed and heard herself.

Although she felt jealous about it, Shen Xueyi also felt happy for her daughter, and she sincerely hoped that Shen Yu would truly become a divine beast in the future. 'Sigh!
Unlike Tianyu, this brat truly loves Yu'er, and he is even willing to help her to such an extent.

*Boom*
Shen Yu's body suddenly released a powerful shock wave, and Zhang Fei immediately moved behind her, pressing his palm against her back to channel his qi into her body.
"Break through that final barrier, Yu'er!"
*Boom*

Another powerful shock wave swept across the lower area of the tower once Shen Yu successfully broke through to the 1-Star Earth Realm, and the Qi fluctuations within her body slowly subsided before disappearing completely a few moments later.

chapters.title: Chapter 231: Meet The Ancestors
paragraphs: The three women stood in front of the naked Shen Tianyu, observing his strange behavior, as if he was fucking a woman, while his mouth continued to call out Shen Yu's name.
Shen Xueyi was genuinely irritated upon hearing this. "Zhang Fei's phantasm incense seems to have had a tremendous impact on him, Grandmother."

"Yes." Shen Huang replied with a nod. "Zhang Fei is truly unusual, and he even has so many pills that are extremely beneficial for cultivators and beasts. Yu'er has a good fate because he chose her as his wife, and I'm sure that she will become a divine beast in the future, surpassing all of us."

"Besides, Zhang Fei also has a clone that is completely identical to his real body." Shen Xueyi immediately turned to Shen Xinya with a confused look. "You were too excited to tell Yu'er about our decision, so you failed to notice that there was another him in the inner disciple area. Everything about his clone was completely identical to him, including his aura and cultivation.
If we hadn't seen the real him with your daughter earlier, then we wouldn't have realized that it was his clone."

After hearing that, Shen Xueyi let out a heavy sigh, feeling that Zhang Fei's abilities exceeded common sense. She herself had the clone technique, but it was far inferior to her real body, and she couldn't maintain it all the time, especially since it would consume a lot of her qi.

"I don't know what will happen to this brat after he escapes from the incense's effects, but this guy won't end well, and it might affect his cultivation." Both women nodded in agreement with Shen Huang. "This way we have plenty of time to stall his marriage with Yu'er, and we can think of the best way to cancel it."

Shen Xinya then spoke with her daughter to convey her ideas. "Xueyi, I believe you don't need to speak to Shen Haoran right now. Instead, you should begin removing those who are loyal to him, as this will gradually reduce his influence within our clan. Besides, you can coordinate those who are loyal to you and Shen Wansan, so they can help us deal with him."
"Yes, mother." Shen Xueyi then asked them. "Are you two going straight back to the underwater cave now?"
"No." Both women answered by shaking their heads. "Since Zhang Fei left his clone in this sect, we wanted to observe him for now, especially since we still have many questions about him."

Shen Xueyi nodded in understanding. "Anyway, you guys better be careful, lest Zhang Fei do something bad to both of you, especially since his bloodline is truly powerful, and I'm completely helpless before him."

Shen Huang and Shen Xinya were naturally aware of this, especially since they had witnessed for themselves how Zhang Fei suppressed Shen Xueyi earlier. Not to mention, Boitata had a higher bloodline than them because of her status as a divine beast, and her cultivation was also on par with theirs.

Following that, Shen Huang and Shen Xinya vanished from the scene to monitor Zhang Fei, while Shen Xueyi hurriedly followed her mother's instructions to organize the supporters of her and Shen Wansan.

Shen Yu looked amazed after Zhang Fei explained to her about the benefits of the training space, and she also felt happy because his other women welcomed her warmly. However, she was quite surprised to find out that the golden monkey Jie Yuan was a quasi-divine beast, so her bloodline was still higher than hers, even though her cultivation was still below hers.

"Are you really a sea serpent, Big Sis Yu?" Shen Yu nodded to Zhang Lin and showed her true form to her and the others, leaving them mesmerized by her beauty. However, she immediately transformed back into her human form a few moments later. "Woah! Your true form is also very pretty! No surprise, my big brother really wants you to be his wife!
This means you are the third beast woman in my big brother's harem. The first one is Boitata, and the second is Hu Yue, the moon fox."
"Eh?" Shen Yu was truly shocked to learn that Zhang Fei had a woman from the Moon Fox race in his harem.

Zhang Fei smiled at Shen Yu's shocked expression before explaining it to her. "Honestly, I met Yue'er before I met you and Boitata, and I wanted her to be my wife too. Unfortunately, her situation mirrors yours, as she already has a fiancé, and that man's family is far more powerful than your clan members.

Even though I am a heavenly fox, they are divine beasts, and their cultivation is in the sovereign realm, so I can't act rashly regarding her. I promised her that I would pick her up in five years, so I decided to send my first clone to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and I also sent my second clone to another realm; only then could I fulfill my promise to her."

"I see." Shen Yu nodded in understanding before speaking to him. "I'm sure you can do it, Fei. Even though they are divine beasts, you are a mythical beast, the heavenly fox. Indeed, your cultivation is still low compared to them, but you have us and your partners in the sect, and we will help you fulfill your promise to Hu Yue."

Chu Qing suddenly hugged Hu Yue from behind. "Big Sis Yu, it would be better to dual-cultivate with Fei now if you want to help him. That way, his cultivation and beast form will improve faster with the help of your yin qi and beast essence, and I guarantee that you will be completely satisfied like us."
*Poof*

After hearing that, smoke burst out of Shen Yu's head, and her face turned red at the thought of dual-cultivating with Zhang Fei. Unfortunately, her engagement with Shen Tianyu has not been canceled, and she must return to their sect within a month, so they won't be able to do it for now.
Realizing Shen Yu's problem, Chu Qing whispered in her ear. "Since you can't dual-cultivate with Fei for now, then you can do it with Fei through other means, Big Sis Yu."

"All right, you don't need to teach Big Sis Yu that kind of thing." Chu Ying immediately stopped her little sister before speaking to Shen Yu. "You don't need to listen to Qing`er; she is always naughty like this."
"I'm not naughty!" Chu Qing complained to her big sister while pouting her lips. "Moreover, me and Lin'er enjoyed doing that with Fei, so I think Big Sis Yu will definitely enjoy it too."

Zhong Yan, Ru Xue, and Qing Yi smiled wryly as they listened to Chu Qing. Even though she was much younger than them, she was much more lustful than them, and she always wanted to dual-cultivate with their husband.

"Qing'er, you can stop persuading Yu'er to do such a thing, and you guys can resume your practice." Chu Qing sighed helplessly while listening to Zhang Fei, and they went back to practicing. "You don't need to mind her words, Yu'er. Sooner or later, you will be my wife, and we will dual-cultivate when that time comes."
"En." Shen Yu nodded to Zhang Fei, and she herself was also looking forward to that day coming, so she could be his wife completely.
After that, Zhang Fei asked Mei to lower the gravity feature to level one, especially since Shen Yu had never trained in the training space before, and level two would be too overwhelming for her.

At first, Zhang Fei wanted to go to the Blazing Phoenix Sect to pick up Zhang Lingxue, but she told him that her sect's internal competition was still going on, and Zhao Ziqin was also still in seclusion. As for Ye Lian, she went to another region together with her master and disciples from the Heavenly Sword Sect, so he dropped his intention.
In the end, Zhang Fei started his own training, especially since he still had not fully mastered his sword techniques, and his skill in using a sword was also still lacking.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] was in his room watching Xia Qianqian, who was trying to break through to the Core Realm. However, he raised his eyebrows as soon as he sensed some people watching him, so he opened his map to find out their identities. "Haha! They finally appeared, and they seemed curious about me after my original body helped Yu'er earlier.
Since they came to me personally, I have to meet them."

After he said that, Zhang Fei [1] left the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and the Shen Ancestors immediately followed him. Even though they had heard that the heavenly fox had the ability to teleport, the two women were still quite surprised by it, but they were even more surprised when they saw him move so far so quickly.
"His exceptional movement technique allows him to cover 100 km in a single stride." Shen Huang muttered as her eyes followed Zhang Fei [1]'s movements.

Shen Xinya agreed with her mother, but then she raised her eyebrows because Zhang Fei [1] continued to move towards the forest, which was quite far from the Yin-Yang Pavilion. "What is he trying to do, Mother?"
"Hmm?" After thinking about it, Shen Huang answered her daughter directly. "Apparently, he noticed our presence, and he purposely lured us out to meet him."

"How is that possible?" Shen Xinya asked in shock as she turned to her mother. "His cultivation is still far below ours, and we also use artifacts to conceal our aura and presence from him, so there's no way he can detect us."

Shen Huang responded to her daughter's question with a shake of her head, and her eyes continued to focus on following Zhang Fei [1]. 'I don't know how he did it, but I have a feeling that he has known our presence since inside the tower.'

After he arrived at the edge of the forest, Zhang Fei [1] immediately looked up at the sky and asked with a smile. "Hey, you two have been following me since I was in the sect, and I intentionally came here to meet you guys. Therefore, you guys no longer need to hide yourselves."
A few moments later, Shen Huang and Shen Xinya appeared before Zhang Fei [1]. They gazed at him in astonishment before Shen Huang asked him a question. "How did you notice our presence?"

"You know what? Curiosity killed the cat. Anyway, why don't you guys introduce yourselves to me first?" Zhang Fei [1] naturally already knew their identities, but he deliberately pretended not to know them.
"I am Shen Huang, and she is my daughter, Shen Xinya."
"I see." Zhang Fei [1] nodded to them. "So, the two of you should be Yu'er's grandmother and great-grandmother, right?"
"That's right."
Zhang Fei [1] then questioned them once more. "So why are you two stalking me? Does this have anything to do with Yu'er?"
The two women exchanged glances for a moment, and Shen Huang then answered his question. "We didn't come to see you because of Yu'er, but we came to you for our own sake."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows.

Shen Xinya spoke to him directly. "We know you are a heavenly fox, and we have heard that a heavenly fox has the ability to move between realms easily, so we came to you. If you were willing, we would like to ask you to send us to another realm."

Zhang Fei [1] used his demon eyes for a moment before responding. "Indeed, I can move between realms easily, and I myself come from another realm. Unfortunately, I don't know much about other realms, and I only go back and forth between my home realm and this realm. As for a higher realm, I only know one realm, which is the realm where my race lives, so I can't send you two to that realm.
If I send you two there, I'm sure they will treat you like toys, and Yu'er will blame me for that."

Shen Huang and Shen Xinya raised their eyebrows, but they did not dare to doubt his words. They themselves were aware that the heavenly foxes were extremely arrogant and cunning, and they were only weak beasts in their eyes. If they went to their realm, they would undoubtedly face suppression.
Zhang Fei [1] could only shake his head at their reactions. "Why are the two of you so eager to go to a higher realm? Is it because your cultivation is stuck in the 10 Star Heaven Realm?"
"That's right." Shen Huang then spoke. "We've been in seclusion for so many years, but we've never managed to break through to the sovereign realm."

Zhang Fei [1] was not surprised to hear her answer, especially since the Qi in the Sky Jade Realm was not that abundant, especially for regions outside the Central Region, so it was natural that they would have difficulty breaking through to that stage.

"Actually, you two don't need to think about going to the higher realm; you can go to the Central Region, especially since the qi there is much better and denser compared to this southern region. If you guys don't want to move to that region, you might be able to choose another option."
"Another option?"
"Dual cultivate with me." Zhang Fei [1] nonchalantly replied.

Indeed, your cultivation is still low compared to them, but you have us and your partners in the sect, and we will help you fulfill your promise to Hu Yue."
Chu Qing suddenly hugged Hu Yue from behind.
"Big Sis Yu, it would be better to dual-cultivate with Fei now if you want to help him.
That way, his cultivation and beast form will improve faster with the help of your yin qi and beast essence, and I guarantee that you will be completely satisfied like us."
*Poof*
After hearing that, smoke burst out of Shen Yu's head, and her face turned red at the thought of dual-cultivating with Zhang Fei.
Unfortunately, her engagement with Shen Tianyu has not been canceled, and she must return to their sect within a month, so they won't be able to do it for now.
Realizing Shen Yu's problem, Chu Qing whispered in her ear.
"Since you can't dual-cultivate with Fei for now, then you can do it with Fei through other means, Big Sis Yu."
"All right, you don't need to teach Big Sis Yu that kind of thing." Chu Ying immediately stopped her little sister before speaking to Shen Yu.
"You don't need to listen to Qing`er; she is always naughty like this."
"I'm not naughty!" Chu Qing complained to her big sister while pouting her lips.
"Moreover, me and Lin'er enjoyed doing that with Fei, so I think Big Sis Yu will definitely enjoy it too."
Zhong Yan, Ru Xue, and Qing Yi smiled wryly as they listened to Chu Qing.
Even though she was much younger than them, she was much more lustful than them, and she always wanted to dual-cultivate with their husband.
"Qing'er, you can stop persuading Yu'er to do such a thing, and you guys can resume your practice." Chu Qing sighed helplessly while listening to Zhang Fei, and they went back to practicing.
"You don't need to mind her words, Yu'er.
Sooner or later, you will be my wife, and we will dual-cultivate when that time comes."
"En." Shen Yu nodded to Zhang Fei, and she herself was also looking forward to that day coming, so she could be his wife completely.
After that, Zhang Fei asked Mei to lower the gravity feature to level one, especially since Shen Yu had never trained in the training space before, and level two would be too overwhelming for her.

At first, Zhang Fei wanted to go to the Blazing Phoenix Sect to pick up Zhang Lingxue, but she told him that her sect's internal competition was still going on, and Zhao Ziqin was also still in seclusion.
As for Ye Lian, she went to another region together with her master and disciples from the Heavenly Sword Sect, so he dropped his intention.
In the end, Zhang Fei started his own training, especially since he still had not fully mastered his sword techniques, and his skill in using a sword was also still lacking.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] was in his room watching Xia Qianqian, who was trying to break through to the Core Realm.
However, he raised his eyebrows as soon as he sensed some people watching him, so he opened his map to find out their identities.
"Haha!
They finally appeared, and they seemed curious about me after my original body helped Yu'er earlier.
Since they came to me personally, I have to meet them."
After he said that, Zhang Fei [1] left the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and the Shen Ancestors immediately followed him.

Even though they had heard that the heavenly fox had the ability to teleport, the two women were still quite surprised by it, but they were even more surprised when they saw him move so far so quickly.
"His exceptional movement technique allows him to cover 100 km in a single stride." Shen Huang muttered as her eyes followed Zhang Fei [1]'s movements.
Shen Xinya agreed with her mother, but then she raised her eyebrows because Zhang Fei [1] continued to move towards the forest, which was quite far from the Yin-Yang Pavilion.
"What is he trying to do, Mother?"
"Hmm?" After thinking about it, Shen Huang answered her daughter directly.
"Apparently, he noticed our presence, and he purposely lured us out to meet him."
"How is that possible?" Shen Xinya asked in shock as she turned to her mother.
"His cultivation is still far below ours, and we also use artifacts to conceal our aura and presence from him, so there's no way he can detect us."

Shen Huang responded to her daughter's question with a shake of her head, and her eyes continued to focus on following Zhang Fei [1]. 'I don't know how he did it, but I have a feeling that he has known our presence since inside the tower.'
After he arrived at the edge of the forest, Zhang Fei [1] immediately looked up at the sky and asked with a smile.
"Hey, you two have been following me since I was in the sect, and I intentionally came here to meet you guys.
Therefore, you guys no longer need to hide yourselves."
A few moments later, Shen Huang and Shen Xinya appeared before Zhang Fei [1].
They gazed at him in astonishment before Shen Huang asked him a question.
"How did you notice our presence?"
"You know what?
Curiosity killed the cat.
Anyway, why don't you guys introduce yourselves to me first?" Zhang Fei [1] naturally already knew their identities, but he deliberately pretended not to know them.
"I am Shen Huang, and she is my daughter, Shen Xinya."
"I see." Zhang Fei [1] nodded to them.
"So, the two of you should be Yu'er's grandmother and great-grandmother, right?"
"That's right."
Zhang Fei [1] then questioned them once more.
"So why are you two stalking me?
Does this have anything to do with Yu'er?"
The two women exchanged glances for a moment, and Shen Huang then answered his question.
"We didn't come to see you because of Yu'er, but we came to you for our own sake."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows.
Shen Xinya spoke to him directly.
"We know you are a heavenly fox, and we have heard that a heavenly fox has the ability to move between realms easily, so we came to you.
If you were willing, we would like to ask you to send us to another realm."
Zhang Fei [1] used his demon eyes for a moment before responding.
"Indeed, I can move between realms easily, and I myself come from another realm.
Unfortunately, I don't know much about other realms, and I only go back and forth between my home realm and this realm.
As for a higher realm, I only know one realm, which is the realm where my race lives, so I can't send you two to that realm.
If I send you two there, I'm sure they will treat you like toys, and Yu'er will blame me for that."
Shen Huang and Shen Xinya raised their eyebrows, but they did not dare to doubt his words.
They themselves were aware that the heavenly foxes were extremely arrogant and cunning, and they were only weak beasts in their eyes.
If they went to their realm, they would undoubtedly face suppression.
Zhang Fei [1] could only shake his head at their reactions.
"Why are the two of you so eager to go to a higher realm?
Is it because your cultivation is stuck in the 10 Star Heaven Realm?"
"That's right." Shen Huang then spoke.
"We've been in seclusion for so many years, but we've never managed to break through to the sovereign realm."

Zhang Fei [1] was not surprised to hear her answer, especially since the Qi in the Sky Jade Realm was not that abundant, especially for regions outside the Central Region, so it was natural that they would have difficulty breaking through to that stage.
"Actually, you two don't need to think about going to the higher realm; you can go to the Central Region, especially since the qi there is much better and denser compared to this southern region.
If you guys don't want to move to that region, you might be able to choose another option."
"Another option?"
"Dual cultivate with me." Zhang Fei [1] nonchalantly replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 232: Wind Elemental Seed
paragraphs: [Ha ha! Master, your character is becoming more and more like a true incubus! You truly embrace your lust and never hold yourself back.]

'Why should I hold myself back, Mei?' Zhang Fe [1] asked while shaking his head slightly. 'Time is ticking, and five years is a short time. Besides, I don't want my life to be limited to this realm, and I want to take them to explore other realms in the future.

As for the Heavenly Moon Realm, the inhabitants are heavenly foxes like me, and they have the same abilities as mine, so I don't have any advantages there. That's why I need to increase my strength as soon as possible, and I'm willing to do whatever it takes to do so. I also don't care about morality as long as I can achieve my goals.'

After hearing that, the two women were dumbfounded, and they looked at Zhang Fei [1] in shock and disbelief. After all, Shen Yu had already chosen him as her husband, and they had also heard that he was interested in taking Shen Xueyi as his partner. However, he also proposed a dual-cultivation relationship with both of them, which they deemed absurd.
Shen Huang then took a deep breath before rejecting Zhang Fei [1]. "We do want to break through to the sovereign realm soon, but we can't dual-cultivate with you."
"Is there no other way, Zhang Fei?" Shen Xinya inquired with a frown.

Zhang Fei [1] shrugged nonchalantly in response to Shen Xinya's question. "There is no free lunch in this world; you both need my help to break through to the sovereign realm, and I need your Yi Qi to increase my cultivation so that I can fulfill my promise to someone. Indeed, you two are Yu'er's ancestors, but you guys are strangers to me, and I will never help strangers."

Shen Huang and Shen Xinya were speechless at his answer. Although they were eager to break through to the sovereign realm, they also did not want to give themselves to Zhang Fei [1]. After all, they were his seniors, especially if he married Shen Yu in the future.
[Master, I detected an extraordinary item from the heart of this forest, so I think you can leave them behind and go there right now.]

Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows a moment after he heard that. "All right, I'm just offering it to you; I'm not forcing you to accept my offer. However, if you change your mind later, you'll already know where to look for me. Since I still have other business, I'll be leaving now."
Without waiting for their answer, Zhang Fei [1] quickly teleported many times towards the heart of the forest, especially since the forest was really large.

The two Shen Ancestors released heavy sighs as they looked towards the forest's depths, but Shen Huang immediately flew away while speaking to her daughter. "Let's go back, Xinya. Since he isn't willing to help us, we just need to try harder, and we will definitely break through to the sovereign realm sooner or later."
"Yes, Mother." Unlike her mother, Shen Xinya actually felt tempted by Zhang Fei [1]'s offer, but she wasn't that crazy to accept it right away.
A while later, Zhang Fei [1] was already standing not far from the heart of the forest. "Hey, Mei! What kind of items did you detect from this place?"
[If I'm not mistaken, it should be a low-level wind elemental seed, and you might get the wind element if you use it.]
"Are you serious that the item is a wind elemental seed? Where is it located?"
[One hundred percent, Master. The wind elemental seed is located right in the heart of this forest, so it's not far from your current location.]

"I see." Zhang Fei [1] immediately used his teleportation a few more times, but he was stunned as soon as he got there. A small wind vortex surrounded a floating green seed, and a girl with a tiny body circled around it, her back adorned with four butterfly-like wings.
[She must be a woman from the fairy race, Master.] Mei then displayed the girl's status.
Name: Zefyr
Age: 250+ Years Old
Race: Fairy
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 5-Star Earth Realm
Element: Wind [Advanced Stage]
Core: Upper-Rank Wind Core
Physique: Wind Fairy Physique
Special Physique:-
Special Bloodline:-
Partners:-
Likes: Beasts, Nature
Dislikes: Human

'Oh? A female fairy with such high cultivation, I have to be careful with her, or she might kill me.' Zhang Fei [1] then raised his eyebrows after seeing that Zefyr disliked humans. 'Why does she hate humans?'
[Master, fairies are born from nature, and humans tend to destroy nature, so you shouldn't be surprised if they hate humans.]
'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Fei [1] replied with a nod of approval. 'Humans are too greedy, and I'm not much different from them either.'
[It would be better if you used your half-fox form to approach her, Master. Otherwise, you won't be able to get close to her, and she might attack you head-on.]
'Let's try approaching her first, and I'll use my half-fox form if she really wants to attack me.' Zhang Fei [1] immediately jumped down from the top of the tree.
"Who!?" Zefyr shouted as she turned to face Zhang Fei [1], and her expression turned furious. "What are you doing in this place, human? Leave or I will attack you!"
'Sigh! She's truly aggressive.' Zhang Fei ignored her words and spoke to her. "I don't want to fight you, but I came here to get that wind elemental seed, Zefyr."

"How did you know my name?" Zefyr inquired with a frown, and two wind pinwheels appeared in her tiny palms. "I hate greedy humans like you, and this wind elemental seed is a natural treasure, so I won't hand it over to you! If you insist on getting it, then I will really attack you."
"You are a wind fairy, so the wind elemental seed is useless to you, right?" Zhang Fei softly spoke as he stepped forward to approach Zefyr.
*Swoosh*

Quickly, the two wind pinwheels in Zefyr's hands flew towards Zhang Fei [1]. However, he dodged both of them by teleporting, causing her attack to split several trees in the area, and it stunned her. 'How could he dodge my fast attacks?'

"I told you that I don't want to fight with you, Zefyr." Zhang Fei [1] spoke from the top of the tree some distance behind her, and the wind elemental seed was already in his hand, especially since he used his teleportation twice in succession without her realizing it. First, he moved to the side of the seed and picked it up. Second, he used his teleportation to make his way to the tree.

"Give me that wind elemental seed, human!" Zefyr shouted loudly; her expression made it clear that she was enraged by Zhang Fei [1]'s actions, and her Wind Qi instantly erupted. A dome of wind quickly enveloped her body before she floated up and glared at him with hatred. "If you don't return it to me, then don't blame me for killing you, human!"
Mei immediately warned Zhang Fei. [You'd better quickly use your fox form, Master. [Even though fairies are gentle creatures, if you make them angry, you will suffer a heavy loss.]
'Alright.' Following Mei's instructions, Zhang Fei [1] transformed himself into a white fox with four tails, and his current fox form was significantly larger than that of an adult ordinary fox.

"Huh!?" Zefyr looked at Zhang Fei [1] as she blinked repeatedly, but she then let out a shrill scream while pointing her little finger at him. "Heavenly fox! Why is there still a heavenly fox left in this Sky Jade Realm? I remember for sure that the ancestors said that they had left this realm a long time ago."

"This is why I don't want to fight with you, especially since both of us were born from nature." Zhang Fei [1] uttered these words as he leapt down from the tree and approached Zefyr. 'Damn it! I'm not used to walking on four legs like this!'

Zefyr immediately retracted her wind qi, and her wind pinwheels disappeared. She then floated right in front of Zhang Fei [1] before patting his head like a pet fox. "I can't believe this! You really are a heavenly fox!"
Zhang Fei [1] smiled bitterly as Zefyr treated him like a pet fox. "I am indeed a Heavenly Fox, but I am also fully human."
"What do you mean by that?" Zefyr asked with a raised eyebrow. "How could you possibly become fully human if you were a Heavenly Fox?"
"I can't explain it to you in detail, but I'm telling you the truth." Zhang Fei [1] said it with a low sigh. "Anyway, I'm not from this Sky Jade Realm, and I come from another realm."

"Did you really come from another realm?" Even though Zefyr asked that, she didn't look surprised at all. She had heard from her ancestors that heavenly foxes had spatial abilities, so they could switch realms easily.
Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her as he transformed into his half-fox form. "Yeah, I really come from another realm."

"Your people should have gone to a higher realm, right? Then, why are you returning to this small realm? Isn't this a complete waste of your time?" Zefyr curiously asked as she circled around Zhang Fei [1] to observe him.

'So the heavenly fox race once lived in this realm, huh?' Zhang Fei was wondering in his heart after hearing Zefyr's question. "Unfortunately, I don't belong to their group, and I come from a realm lower than this one."
"Huh?" Zefyr was surprised to hear that right before asking in a disbelief tone. "Did you really come from a lower realm than here?"
"That's right." Zhang Fei [1] answered with a nod. "Anyway, my name is Zhang Fei, but I didn't expect to meet a fairy in this realm."

"Actually, many races other than humans live in this realm; it's just that they never show themselves to humans, especially since we hate humans, and we all live deep in the forests of the western region." Zefyr spoke as she sat on Zhang Fei's shoulder.

Since she already knew that he was a heavenly fox, she no longer showed any hostility towards him, mainly because the ancestors of the fairies and the heavenly foxes had a close relationship. "However, I'm still curious about how you can be a human and a heavenly fox at the same time."

"Long story short, I was a human at first, but due to an accident, I turned into a Heavenly Fox." Even though the fairies are gentle creatures, Zhang Fei [1] still doesn't want to tell Zefyr in detail, especially since she's new to him. "Anyway, why do you want this wind elemental seed? Is it any use to you?"
Zephyr shook her head at Zhang Fei [1]. "Actually, this seed is useless to me, especially since it is lower rank. However, it is a natural treasure, so I don't want humans to get it."

"I see." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding, but he still didn't expect that fairies hated humans so much. If he didn't have his feavenly fox bloodline, then he wouldn't be able to talk to Zefyr this casually either. "I really need this wind elemental seed, so I hope you can give it to me."
"You can have it, since you are the Heavenly Fox." Zefyr replied with a nod. "Unfortunately, you won't necessarily be successful in obtaining the wind element."
"I know that, but it wouldn't hurt if I gave it a try, right?" Zhang Fei [1] really hoped to get the wind element, but he wasn't sure he could obtain it either.
"Hehe." Zephyr chuckled at that. "However, you are lucky because I am a wind fairy, and I can help you obtain the wind element with this seed."
"Really?" Zhang Fei [1]'s eyes sparkled upon hearing that.
"Yes." Zefyr then floated in front of Zhang Fei [1]. "You can swallow the seed, and I will help you activate it, so you will get the wind element."
Zhang Fei [1] became so excited at Zefyr's words that he immediately sat cross-legged on the ground and swallowed the wind elemental seed.

"Yes." Zefyr then floated in front of Zhang Fei [1].
"You can swallow the seed, and I will help you activate it, so you will get the wind element."
Zhang Fei [1] became so excited at Zefyr's words that he immediately sat cross-legged on the ground and swallowed the wind elemental seed.
