chapters.title: Chapter 233: Obtained Wind Element
paragraphs: 'Only a 20% chance, huh?' Zhang Fei [1] inwardly muttered after getting that notification.

[After all, it's just a lower-rank wind elemental seed, so the success percentage is indeed small, Master. Unless you get a peak-grade one, then the percentage of getting the wind element will be 100%. However, not only is the lower grade rare, but the peak-grade is even rarer. Fortunately, your system is overpowered; without it, you wouldn't have been as fortunate to find one in this lower realm.]

Zhang Fei [1] did not refute Mei's words because he himself was aware that all the good things he got recently were indeed thanks to her and the system. Suddenly, he felt a faint wind qi flowing into his body, which came from the wind elemental seed.

"Focus." Zefyr spoke as she pressed her palm against Zhang Fei's chest, channeling her wind Qi into his body. "I will circulate my qi into your body to activate the wind elemental seed, and I will also help you to absorb it, so you will get the wind element afterwards."

Zhang Fei nodded and calmed his mind, and he could sense Zefyr's wind Qi start to spread throughout his body. Aside from that, he could also feel the slight movement of the wind elemental seed, which had begun to activate thanks to her qi.
[Ding]
[The chance for the host to obtain the wind element has increased to 100%.]
Not only Zhang Fei [1] was shocked by the notification, but even Mei was also shocked by it. However, none of them spoke, and they waited for Zefyr to help him complete the process.

Qiao Ran led her clan's people, the Wen Twins, and the people from the demon fox group towards the Huan Clan's residence, especially since it was already quite late and the majority of the people from the clan had already returned to their rooms to rest. Fortunately, Huan Jingtian was in the demon cave, and Huan Chong was dead, so there weren't many strong cultivators left in the clan.
The strongest among them was only at 1-Star Earth Realm, which was no match for Qiao Ran's cultivation at 3-Star Earth Realm, and she immediately moved towards that person's room.

Meanwhile, the Wen Twins infiltrated two different rooms, which were occupied by several influential members of the Huan Clan. Since they had all been controlled by Huan Jingjtian using pills from the Pang Clan, they immediately killed those people. Likewise, the people from the Qiao Clan and the demon fox group also moved quickly to slaughter the members of the clan.

Since most of them were too weak and vulnerable, Qiao Ran and the others could finish them off without much difficulty. She then led the Wen Twins to go to the Huan Clan's treasury, and they cleaned out the room without leaving anything behind. Unfortunately, Huan Jingtian had sealed most of the treasure boxes they found, preventing them from examining their contents.

After settling everything, they departed from the Huan Clan and set fire to the clan's residence, causing a significant disturbance in the city sometime later. The Wen Twins then inform Liu Hua of their success, who asks them to immediately return to the western region. She also requests that they bring Qiao Ran back, especially since Zhang Fei will need her.

Besides, Liu Hua asked the Wen Twins to let some members of the demon fox group remain in the city to keep an eye on the movements of the Pang Clan, whom she suspected would soon arrive after hearing about the destruction of the Huan Clan. This was particularly important because several other clans had become vassals of that heretical clan.
Unfortunately, Pang Hong had no information about those clans, so they couldn't destroy them all at once.

However, Liu Hua chose to leave the Guan Clan behind because they had long joined the Pang Clan, and they had no exact information about their true strength. Even Guan Yu, who had been killed by Zhang Fei, was stronger than Qiao Ran, with his cultivation being at 5-Star Earth Realm, and they wouldn't have been able to capture him if it wasn't for Zhang Lingxue.
That's why she didn't dare act rashly by ordering them to attack the clan directly, as she was worried that there were other strong cultivators in the clan.

The Wen Twins then relayed Liu Hua's orders to Qiao Ran, who subsequently instructed her clan's members to return to their own clan. After ordering several people from the demon fox group, they immediately used flying artifacts to transport everyone out of the eastern region.

Two hours later, Zefyr had already retracted her wind qi as the wind elemental seed was already fully activated, and it was only a matter of waiting for the results. However, she discovered something unusual in Zhang Fei [1]'s body, which made her wonder about it herself. 'Weird! How could he have three cultivation cores? Furthermore, one of them is the darkness core.
It should be impossible for light and darkness to coexist in one body, yet he possesses both.'
[Ding]
[You obtained the wind element.]
[The host wind element is lower-stage.]

Suddenly, a large and powerful green vortex appeared around Zhang Fei [1], and it then rose into the sky, sending the ground and many trees flying high into the sky. Luckily, Zefyr was a wind fairy, so it didn't have any impact on her. 'Phew, he finally got the wind element, and he will soon form his wind core.'

As she hovered around Zhang Fei [1], Zefyr continued to wait for him to finish forming his wind core. Half an hour later, the vortex shrunk into a sizable green ball, indicating that he had succeeded in forming it, and it immediately entered his body.

'Unbelievable! He managed to create his fourth Qi Core so easily!' Zefyr quietly mumbled in shock upon witnessing this. 'What's more, it's a peak-rank wind core! Even I, as a wind fairy, only have an upper-rank one!'

"Phew." Zhang Fei [1] breathed a sigh of relief before opening his eyes and smiling in satisfaction, and he then said to Zefyr. "Thanks for your help. Otherwise, I wouldn't have succeeded in getting the wind element, especially since the chance was so small."

"You don't have to think about it." However, Zefyr's expression turned serious before asking Zhang Fei [1]. "How did you come to possess the darkness element? Light and darkness couldn't possibly exist in one body, but you have both."
[Master, you should tell her the truth, especially since she already inspected your body when she helped you activate the wind elemental seed. Otherwise, she will hate you if you lie to her.]

"I'll show you something, but this might shock you, so I hope you don't tell anyone else what you're about to see. Okay?" After Zefyr nodded in agreement, Zhang Fei [1] transformed himself into an incubus.
"What the hell!" Zefyr immediately shouted loudly, and her beautiful eyes widened after seeing Zhang Fei [1]'s incubus form. "How... how can you also become a demon?"

Zhang Fei [1] nodded to Zefyr. "I feel confused as to how to explain the truth to you, but this is the work of the person who saved me from death. Currently, I am a human, a heavenly fox, and a demon at the same time."

Zefyr didn't immediately comment about it, especially since he himself had already proven the authenticity of Zhang Fei [1]'s aura as a human and a heavenly fox, so he knew that she wasn't lying to him. To ensure the authenticity of his demon form, he groped his horns, wings, and tail. "You are a freak! I've never heard of a creature like you before!
This way, you can gather with humans, nature races, and demons all at once!"
"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed bitterly at that. "I myself never thought I would become like this before, but this may be the will of fate, and I am powerless to resist it."
"En." Zefyr just nodded as he continued to observe Zhang Fei [1]'s incubus form.
Seeing her like that, Zhang Fei [1] immediately returned to his human form and asked her. "What's your next plan, Zefyr?"

"Since you swallowed the wind elemental seed, I have no other purpose here, and I will return to our forest city." Zefyr gave Zhang Fei a green pendant. "If you ever go to the Jingshai Forest in the western region, you can show this pendant to the guards, and they will definitely let you in to our city."

"All right." Zefyr immediately disappeared from Zhang Fei [1]'s sight after that, and he recalled the city in the middle of the forest that Chu Ying had told him about some time ago. "No wonder not everyone can enter that city; it turns out that city is where the natural race lives, so I will use my real body to go there after I come out of my seclusion."

Zhang Fei [1] then activated the portal to the Yin-Yang Pavilion, entered it, and arrived at his room. He smiled upon seeing Xia Qianqian, who had successfully broken through to the 1-Star Core Realm. He then lifted her to her feet, kissed her lips, and inquired. "How do you feel after breaking through to this stage? Even your brother hasn't reached it yet."

"Haha." Xia Qianqian giggled and wrapped her arms around Zhang Fei [1]'s neck. "At first, I thought it would take me several years to achieve it, but I've achieved it now, which is thanks to you. I'm really happy that I was able to break through to this stage earlier than my brother, so he won't be able to boss me around now, and I can live my own life freely."

"Don't worry, Xia Leng won't be able to control you anymore, especially since your cultivation is higher than his now. Moreover, I will help you improve your cultivation again, so you will be much stronger than him." Zhang Fei [1], then let go of Xia Qianqian and spoke to her again.
"Anyway, you should go see Shi Yue now and take the promotion test to become an inner disciple, so you can move to this area soon."
"Yes, I'll go see Elder Shi now, brother."

After Xia Qianqian left, Zhang Fei [1] immediately sat cross-legged and listened to Liu Hua's voice transmission, which made him satisfied after hearing of the destruction of the Huan Clan. In addition, he listened to Pang Hong's message, which confirmed the outcome he had anticipated.

'Pang De and the others should be in two different regions now to secure the two blood demon trees in those two regions. Unfortunately, they still haven't managed to locate the two trees, so I can't steal them from their hands.'
"Master?" Cheng Yu's call woke Zhang Fei [1] from his thoughts, and she then sat on his lap. "What are you thinking about, Master? Do you want to start dual-cultivating with us again?"

"No." Zhang Fei [1] rejected Cheng Yu by shaking his head. "In the past three days, my cultivation has broken through too much, so I will stop our seclusion to stabilize my cultivation first, but I will still help you guys with my yang qi."
"I see." Cheng Yu nodded in understanding. "Unfortunately, I've been here for three days, so I have to go back to the western region, or my children will be looking for me."
"Master, I also have to go back there to take care of my little brother." Tang Rou abruptly uttered these words as she rose from her bed.

Zhang Fei [1] could understand their situation, so he immediately agreed to their wishes. "All right, I will send you two back to the Chu Clan now. Anyway, once you get there, you can meet Hua'er, and I want you two to help my family take care of our shop and restaurant."
"Yes, Master."

After the two women were dressed, Zhang Fei [1] immediately opened a portal to the Chu Clan, and he closed it again after the two women disappeared from his sight. However, he released a soft sigh as soon as a new notification appeared in his mind.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 2,400 Qi]
[Reward: 2,400 red jewels]
- To Be Continued -

chapters.title: Chapter 234: Shen Xueyi Starts Moving
paragraphs: After she passed her promotion test to become an inner disciple, Xia Qianqian happily walked back to her room in the outer disciple area to tidy up her personal belongings. However, Xia Leng, Shan Yun, and Gong Zhi were already waiting for her there. Naturally, Ning Qingxue, who was still angry with her, was also there, especially since they were a team.

Xia Leng immediately moved to his little sister's side and grabbed her shoulders before bombarding her with questions. "Where have you been, Qianqian? What happened to you? Why haven't I seen you for the past three days? We've been waiting for you to take on a group mission, but we couldn't find you anywhere, and you didn't answer my voice transmission either."

Before Xia Qianqian could answer Xia Leng's question, Ning Qingxue spoke to him first. "Why don't you try to sense her cultivation? Her cultivation has already passed the foundation realm, so she is stronger than you now."

Not only was Xia Leng shocked to hear Ning Qingxue's words, but Shan Yun and Gong Zhi were also shocked, and the three of them immediately tried to sense Xia Qianqian's cultivation. Sure enough, they could no longer sense her cultivation, which meant that her cultivation was already surpassing theirs.
Moreover, her cultivation was still at the 5-Star Foundation Realm ten days ago, but she had suddenly surpassed that realm, and she did it in just ten days.

Xia Qianqian glared fiercely at Ning Qingxue, causing her to shiver after remembering the artifact she used to attack her ten days ago. She then took out her inner disciple jade, before showing it to them. "As you can see, Big Brother, I am an inner disciple now. That's why I came back here to tidy up my personal belongings, and I will move to the inner area starting today."

Seeing the three men still frozen in shock, Xia Qianqian immediately ran to her room and tidied up her things quickly, and she met them again a few moments later. "Big brother, I want to get used to my new environment first, so I can't go with you guys on a mission, but I'll join you guys again after I get used to everything."
Before she left them, Xia Qianqian turned to Ning Qiangxue and coldly spoke to her. "If you dare to trouble me again, I will not hesitate to attack you, and I will use a stronger attack than before."

'This bitch!' Ning Qiangxue only dared to curse in her heart, especially since Xia Qianqian's cultivation was already several levels higher than hers, and the difference in strength between the foundation and core realms was quite significant.
"Humph!" Xia Qianqian snorted coldly at Ning Qiangxue before leaving them.
*Smack... Smack...*
Ning Qiangxue smacked Shan Yun and Gong Zhi's heads and asked them a question. "How long are you two going to be in shock like this?"

They quickly regained consciousness before Shan Yun inquired. "How could Qianqian's cultivation break through six levels in ten days? We've worked so hard to reach our current level, but she can surpass us so easily."
"I don't know." Then, Gong Zhi turned to Ning Qiangxue. "You must know something about Qianqian, right? Moreover, she was never so cold to you before, but you two are like enemies now."
Xia Leng also looked at Ning Qingxue. "Tell me, what exactly happened to Qianqian?"

"Tch!" Ning Qingxue gritted her teeth in annoyance before telling them the truth. "Do you three remember the male disciple we met in the village? His name is Zhang Fei [1], and he has already advanced to the status of an inner disciple.
Besides, Qianqian is his dual-cultivation partner now, so I'm sure that he helped her improve her cultivation, or else her cultivation wouldn't have shot up that high."
After hearing that, Shan Yun and Gong Zhi exchanged shocked glances, as they didn't expect that Xia Qianqian would decide to become Zhang Fei [1]'s partner.

However, they still felt strange about her cultivation speed, especially since it was impossible for an inner disciple to help her increase her cultivation by six levels in ten days; even an elder would not be able to help her break through that fast.

Upon hearing that, Xia Leng's face darkened and his fists tightened, but Ning Qingxue promptly issued a warning. "You better forget your anger toward Zhang Fei [1], especially since his cultivation has reached the core realm, so you are not his match. Furthermore, he was the one who saved you three from that beast; otherwise, you guys would be dead by now."

Xia Leng naturally knew that he was not Zhang Fei [1]'s opponent, but he was still furious at him for snatching his little sister away from him. Although he was grateful to him for saving them, he still couldn't accept it. 'Damn it! I have to break through to the core realm as soon as possible, so I can teach him a lesson for snatching my little sister, and I will snatch Qianqian back from him.'
"Let's go! The four of us are enough to complete the group mission." As Xia Leng strode away, the other three immediately followed suit.

Meanwhile, Xia Qianqian had arrived at the inner area, and she was delighted because her room was not far from Zhang Fei's room [1]. After tidying up her belongings in her room, she headed straight to his room to meet him. However, he was preoccupied with his cultivation, so she, along with the other four women who had woken up long ago, waited for him.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 2,400 Qi]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 2,400 red jewels sent to inventory]

After the notification appeared in his mind, Zhang Fei [1] immediately opened his eyes, but Xia Qianqian immediately jumped onto his lap and hugged his neck. "Hehe! I'm already an inner disciple, brother. Moreover, our rooms are very close, so I can meet you every day."

"That's good." Zhang Fei [1] replied with a nod before lifting Xia Qianqian to her feet, and he then spoke to the other four women. "At first, I wanted to enter seclusion with you guys for a month, but I changed my mind because my cultivation breakthrough was too fast, so I didn't dare to break through any further.
That's why you guys can get dressed now, and we'll go find some missions, especially since I want to reach the top ten inner disciple ranks as soon as possible."

"Fei, I'm really jealous of you." Du Yuan was the first to say this to him as she started to get dressed. "When we first met at Blazing Volcano Mountain, your cultivation was still in the 1-Star Foundation realm, but you've surpassed me now."

"That's true." Ning Xiang nodded in agreement with her best friend. "However, we shouldn't be surprised by his progress, right? Back then, he was much weaker than us, but he managed to save us from death, unlike Xie Gang and Luo Hai, who fled in fear of death and left us behind."
"Hey! Xiang! You don't need to talk about those two cowards anymore!" Every time Du Yuan remembered those two, she was filled with anger.
"Haha." Ning Xiang laughed at that.
As she got dressed, Luo Yu asked Zhang Fei [1]. "Are you thinking of taking that mission to capture an adult owl bear?"

"An adult owl bear is quite strong, but now that we've reached the core realm and there are six of us, I think we can take that quest, especially since the point reward is also very high." Instead, Gu Yan answered her question.

chapters.title: Chapter 235: Shen Haoran's Trouble
paragraphs: "Zhang Fei?"
Shen Xueyi nodded to Yan Luan'er and Xi Zihua. "Yu'er went with the real Zhang Fei to somewhere else, but I don't know where he took her, and he told me that he would bring her back in a month."
"What do you mean by the real Zhang Fei, Mistress?"

"Have you guys still not noticed anything different about him?" Both women answered Shen Xueyi's question with a shake of their heads. "The Zhang Fei in our sect is his clone, and the real him lives somewhere else, but I guess that he lives in the western region, precisely in the Chu Clan, especially since Liu Hua and the Chu Sisters are his wives."

Yan Luan'er and Xi Zihua scowled upon hearing this, particularly because they had encountered several cultivators who possessed clone techniques, but none of them were able to create clones that were exact replicas of the original.

Shen Xueyi then continued. "At first, I also didn't realize that it was Zhang Fei's clone, especially since it was completely similar to his real body, including his aura and cultivation. However, my mother and grandmother noticed his clone, and they told me about it."
"What do you think is the purpose of him leaving his clone here, Zihua?" Yan Luan'er inquired, turning to face Xi Zihua.

"What else?" Xi Zihua responded with a shrug. "Since our sect is a dual cultivation sect, Zhang Fei must be looking for dual cultivation partners, and he has already found several, including Shi Yue. However, I find it strange that his clone should have no connection with his real body, and he could not possibly absorb their yin qi, leading me to believe that his actions were in vain."

Unfortunately, Xi Zihua did not know anything about Zhang Fei's demon body double, which was completely different compared to ordinary clone techniques, and all his clones were connected to each other like a bee hive, including their mind and vision.

Shen Xueyi then said to them. "All right, you two don't need to think about Zhang Fei, and you guys can start preparing everything. That way, everything will be ready when the others come out of their seclusion, and we will immediately start cleaning up Shen Haoran's loyalists."
"Yes, Mistress."

After they left, Shen Xueyi also left her private room, but she saw from a distance that Shen Haoran was walking down the stairs towards the bottom of the tower. 'He will find out about his son's condition soon, which will make him panic, and he will definitely make a scene. However, I have prepared a precaution for that, so I don't need to worry about it.'

Before long, Shen Haoran had arrived in front of Shen Tianyu's seclusion room, but his expression turned to shock as he saw his son acting like a horny pig, and he kept rubbing his dick on the floor, which made it bleed quite a lot. "What the hell is going on here? Why is he acting so disgusting?"
Shen Haoran immediately moved to his son's side and touched his back. He used his qi to examine his inner body, but he discovered nothing unusual.

In the end, Shen Haoran rendered his son unconscious, assisted him in dressing, and escorted him to the medical hall. Moments later, he had arrived at the medical hall, and he immediately informed Zhiyu Fengzhi about the symptoms his son was experiencing before ordering him to check on Shen Tianyu's condition.

Unfortunately, Zhiyu Fengzhi also could not find any abnormalities in Shen Tianyu's body, so he decided to check his subconscious and soul space. However, he still couldn't find any abnormalities in either of them, so he decided to go out before talking to Shen Haoran. "I don't know what happened to your son, but if what you said before is true, I suspect that he has fallen under someone's hypnosis.
Otherwise, he wouldn't have done such a thing, but I'm not sure who was the mastermind behind it or what kind of hypnosis that person gave him."

"Hypnosis?" Shen Haoran frowned upon hearing that. "Is there anyone in this sect with such an ability? Moreover, the people from my Shen clan are constantly monitoring every corner of the room, ensuring that no one else could sneak in under their watch. Additionally, the underground area is equipped with special formations.

Zhiyu Fengzhi shook his head at him. "As far as I can remember, no one in your clan or in this sect has the ability for hypnosis, so I think the perpetrator might be an outsider. However, I don't know how that person managed to sneak in there, and that person was probably helped by an insider."

"Hmm?" Shen Haoran fell into deep thought after hearing Zhiyu Fengzhi's answer, but he felt that it was impossible for people from his clan to help an outsider harm his son, and all sorts of questions arose in his mind. 'Who exactly is the mastermind behind my son's misfortune? Why did that person target him? Could this matter have something to do with Shen Yu?
Could it be that Shen Xueyi assisted that person in doing something to him? What's her purpose in doing this to him?'
Zhiyu Fengzhi then said to Shen Haoran. "Anyway, you can leave your son here so I can monitor his condition, and I will let you know immediately if I find anything on him."

"All right, I entrust my son to you, and I hope you can cure him as soon as possible, especially since his wedding is coming soon." After he said that, Shen Haoran immediately returned to the tower and went to the lowest floor, which was Shen Yu's seclusion room.
When he arrived, Shen Haoran saw Shen Yu seriously cultivating in the middle of the artificial lake, so he decided not to disturb her and left the place directly.

Unfortunately, he didn't realize that the person he saw wasn't the real her, especially considering that the real her was still training in the training room with Zhang Fei and the others and that Shen Huang's item had created an illusion of her.
After that, Shen Haoran went to meet some of his loyalists and ordered them to keep an eye on Shen Xueyi's movements, and he also ordered them to find the mastermind behind Shen Tianyu's misfortune.

On a hill far from the city, two men and five women were watching over a small village a little way ahead of them, but one of them seemed annoyed, especially since three of their group were being too laid-back and preferred to have fun by themselves. "Hey, Yin Tong! We're here to capture those bandits, so you better focus on our mission!"

"Hahaha!" Upon hearing that, Yin Tong burst into laughter. "Are you jealous of us, Dong'er? If that's true, then you should quickly choose your partner, and you can have fun with your partner later. If my memory serves me correctly, Yuan Zheng and Wang Jie have a deep affection for you, so it's up to you to choose one of them, lest you end up as an old maid for the rest of your life."

"Moreover, we've been waiting here for two days, but those bandits still haven't returned to their village, so we can't do anything for now." Ni Weiwei spoke casually, but the mocking smile on her face made Lin Dong'er furious. "Besides, waiting is the most boring thing in life, so it's okay if we have some fun, right?"
Unlike them, Yun Kexin didn't say anything, but from her expression, it was clear that she wanted to complete their mission as soon as possible, so they could get back to their sect.

"Tch!" Lin Dong'er gritted her teeth in anger at their behavior, and she wanted to scold them. However, Mu Lingshu immediately stopped her with a shake of her head, especially since her anger would be in vain. "Do you think those bandits are looting other villages?"
Mu Lingshu nodded and replied to Lin Dong'er. "There is such a possibility, so we can only wait patiently for now, and we will immediately make our move once they return to this village."
"Sigh." Lin Dong'er let out a heavy sigh before turning to the other two members. "Have you received any news about Lian Chengyu, Xia Bing?"
"Yes." Xia Bing replied with a nod. "Chengyu contacted me yesterday and told me that Elder Zhiyu had released him, so I asked him to follow us here, and he should arrive tonight or tomorrow morning."
"That's good."
Nanxuan Luoyue suddenly asked Lin Dong'er. "What do you think will happen to Lan Zhen? Will they kill her?"

"Why do you still care about that woman?" Lin Dong'er returned the question with a frown. "I know that you've been friends with Lan Zhen for a long time, but her Lan Clan is one of the vassals of the Pang Clan, so you shouldn't think of her anymore.

However, I heard from my father that Mistress Shen forbade them from executing her, especially since it would only alert her grandfather, and the seniors in the demon cave still needed his help to strengthen the seal, so they decided to lock her up for the time being."
"I see." Nanxuan Luoyue nodded in understanding, but her expression was filled with disappointment, especially since she and Lan Zhen had been friends since they first joined the Yin-Yang Pavilion.

"Anyway, do you know anything about Zhang Fei?" As she turned to Xia Bing, Lin Dong'er's expression turned strange upon hearing the name, and it did not escape his and Nanxuan Luoyue's eyes. "I heard that you went with Elder Lin to pick up my two cousins in that village, and I also heard that he was the one who saved them."
Mu Lingshu smiled amusedly after seeing her friend's expression, but she did not like to meddle in other people's business, so she did not say anything about the matter.

Lin Dong'er took a deep breath before answering Xia Bing. "You are right that Zhang Fei saved them, but I do not know him, so you do not need to ask me about him. If you have any business with him, you can go directly to our sect later. However, you better not bring Luoyue to see him, or he will snatch her away from you."
After hearing that, Nanxuan Luoyue questioned Lin Dong'er with suspicion. "Why do I feel that you hate him so much? Did he try to seduce you before?"

"Humph!" Lin Dong'er snorted and turned her face to the side, as she had no intention of answering Nanxuan Luoyue's question, but her attitude made her and Xia Bing sure of it. They then turned to Mu Lingshu, who immediately shook her head at them, especially since she had not witnessed Zhang Fei [1]'s action towards her.
*Drap... Drap...*

Suddenly, they heard the heavy footsteps of beasts from afar, prompting them to immediately use their senses to check that direction. Their excitement was heightened, especially since the bandits had finally returned to their village. Their expressions immediately turned serious as they observed the bandits, including Yin Tong and Ni Weiwei, who had been acting so relaxed.
"So, when are we going to make our move?"

Yin Tong was the first to answer Xia Bing. "Based on their condition, they appeared to have had a fierce battle before, and many of them are quite badly injured. However, we are unable to do so at this time due to the strength and quantity of their riding beasts, making it challenging for the seven of us to fight them."

"Look at that guy; he should be their leader." Ni Weiwei spoke as she gestured toward the bald man riding a leopard in front. "It seems the person who proposed this mission gave us incorrect information about them, as I can't sense his cultivation, which should have reached the soul realm."

"That's true." Lin Dong'er nodded with a serious expression. "I think it would be better if we aborted our mission, especially since there's no way we can defeat their leader even if we work together to gang up on him."

Xia Bing and the others nodded in agreement with Lin Dong'er, particularly considering that Yin Tong was the strongest among them. However, his cultivation was still in the 8-Star Core realm, while most of them were in the middle-stage Core realm.

Mu Lingshu unexpectedly received a voice transmission, prompting her to immediately inform Lin Dong'er through voice transmission. 'Zhang Fei [1] contacted me and inquired about our whereabouts. He is currently en route to this area to carry out some missions that aren't far from here. Furthermore, he is not traveling alone; his partners are accompanying him. How about I ask him to help us?

Lin Dong'er turned to Mu Lingshu with a frown, but she was eager to capture those bandits, so she immediately agreed with her idea. 'All right, you can contact him now and ask him to come here as soon as possible.' "Guys!

There are some core disciples from our sect on their way to this region, and Lingshu has already asked them to come here to help us, so we will wait for them to arrive before thinking about our next plans."

However, I find it strange that his clone should have no connection with his real body, and he could not possibly absorb their yin qi, leading me to believe that his actions were in vain."

Unfortunately, Xi Zihua did not know anything about Zhang Fei's demon body double, which was completely different compared to ordinary clone techniques, and all his clones were connected to each other like a bee hive, including their mind and vision.
Shen Xueyi then said to them.
"All right, you two don't need to think about Zhang Fei, and you guys can start preparing everything.
That way, everything will be ready when the others come out of their seclusion, and we will immediately start cleaning up Shen Haoran's loyalists."
"Yes, Mistress."

After they left, Shen Xueyi also left her private room, but she saw from a distance that Shen Haoran was walking down the stairs towards the bottom of the tower. 'He will find out about his son's condition soon, which will make him panic, and he will definitely make a scene.
However, I have prepared a precaution for that, so I don't need to worry about it.'

Before long, Shen Haoran had arrived in front of Shen Tianyu's seclusion room, but his expression turned to shock as he saw his son acting like a horny pig, and he kept rubbing his dick on the floor, which made it bleed quite a lot.
"What the hell is going on here?
Why is he acting so disgusting?"
Shen Haoran immediately moved to his son's side and touched his back.
He used his qi to examine his inner body, but he discovered nothing unusual.
In the end, Shen Haoran rendered his son unconscious, assisted him in dressing, and escorted him to the medical hall.
Moments later, he had arrived at the medical hall, and he immediately informed Zhiyu Fengzhi about the symptoms his son was experiencing before ordering him to check on Shen Tianyu's condition.
Unfortunately, Zhiyu Fengzhi also could not find any abnormalities in Shen Tianyu's body, so he decided to check his subconscious and soul space.
However, he still couldn't find any abnormalities in either of them, so he decided to go out before talking to Shen Haoran.
"I don't know what happened to your son, but if what you said before is true, I suspect that he has fallen under someone's hypnosis.
Otherwise, he wouldn't have done such a thing, but I'm not sure who was the mastermind behind it or what kind of hypnosis that person gave him."
"Hypnosis?" Shen Haoran frowned upon hearing that.
"Is there anyone in this sect with such an ability?
Moreover, the people from my Shen clan are constantly monitoring every corner of the room, ensuring that no one else could sneak in under their watch.
Additionally, the underground area is equipped with special formations.
Zhiyu Fengzhi shook his head at him.
"As far as I can remember, no one in your clan or in this sect has the ability for hypnosis, so I think the perpetrator might be an outsider.
However, I don't know how that person managed to sneak in there, and that person was probably helped by an insider."

"Hmm?" Shen Haoran fell into deep thought after hearing Zhiyu Fengzhi's answer, but he felt that it was impossible for people from his clan to help an outsider harm his son, and all sorts of questions arose in his mind. 'Who exactly is the mastermind behind my son's misfortune?
Why did that person target him?
Could this matter have something to do with Shen Yu?
Could it be that Shen Xueyi assisted that person in doing something to him?
What's her purpose in doing this to him?'
Zhiyu Fengzhi then said to Shen Haoran.
"Anyway, you can leave your son here so I can monitor his condition, and I will let you know immediately if I find anything on him."

"All right, I entrust my son to you, and I hope you can cure him as soon as possible, especially since his wedding is coming soon." After he said that, Shen Haoran immediately returned to the tower and went to the lowest floor, which was Shen Yu's seclusion room.
When he arrived, Shen Haoran saw Shen Yu seriously cultivating in the middle of the artificial lake, so he decided not to disturb her and left the place directly.

Unfortunately, he didn't realize that the person he saw wasn't the real her, especially considering that the real her was still training in the training room with Zhang Fei and the others and that Shen Huang's item had created an illusion of her.
After that, Shen Haoran went to meet some of his loyalists and ordered them to keep an eye on Shen Xueyi's movements, and he also ordered them to find the mastermind behind Shen Tianyu's misfortune.

On a hill far from the city, two men and five women were watching over a small village a little way ahead of them, but one of them seemed annoyed, especially since three of their group were being too laid-back and preferred to have fun by themselves.
"Hey, Yin Tong!
We're here to capture those bandits, so you better focus on our mission!"
"Hahaha!" Upon hearing that, Yin Tong burst into laughter.
"Are you jealous of us, Dong'er?
If that's true, then you should quickly choose your partner, and you can have fun with your partner later.
If my memory serves me correctly, Yuan Zheng and Wang Jie have a deep affection for you, so it's up to you to choose one of them, lest you end up as an old maid for the rest of your life."

"Moreover, we've been waiting here for two days, but those bandits still haven't returned to their village, so we can't do anything for now." Ni Weiwei spoke casually, but the mocking smile on her face made Lin Dong'er furious.
"Besides, waiting is the most boring thing in life, so it's okay if we have some fun, right?"
Unlike them, Yun Kexin didn't say anything, but from her expression, it was clear that she wanted to complete their mission as soon as possible, so they could get back to their sect.
"Tch!" Lin Dong'er gritted her teeth in anger at their behavior, and she wanted to scold them.
However, Mu Lingshu immediately stopped her with a shake of her head, especially since her anger would be in vain.
"Do you think those bandits are looting other villages?"
Mu Lingshu nodded and replied to Lin Dong'er.
"There is such a possibility, so we can only wait patiently for now, and we will immediately make our move once they return to this village."
"Sigh." Lin Dong'er let out a heavy sigh before turning to the other two members.
"Have you received any news about Lian Chengyu, Xia Bing?"
"Yes." Xia Bing replied with a nod.
"Chengyu contacted me yesterday and told me that Elder Zhiyu had released him, so I asked him to follow us here, and he should arrive tonight or tomorrow morning."
"That's good."
Nanxuan Luoyue suddenly asked Lin Dong'er.
"What do you think will happen to Lan Zhen?
Will they kill her?"
"Why do you still care about that woman?" Lin Dong'er returned the question with a frown.
"I know that you've been friends with Lan Zhen for a long time, but her Lan Clan is one of the vassals of the Pang Clan, so you shouldn't think of her anymore.

However, I heard from my father that Mistress Shen forbade them from executing her, especially since it would only alert her grandfather, and the seniors in the demon cave still needed his help to strengthen the seal, so they decided to lock her up for the time being."
"I see." Nanxuan Luoyue nodded in understanding, but her expression was filled with disappointment, especially since she and Lan Zhen had been friends since they first joined the Yin-Yang Pavilion.
"Anyway, do you know anything about Zhang Fei?" As she turned to Xia Bing, Lin Dong'er's expression turned strange upon hearing the name, and it did not escape his and Nanxuan Luoyue's eyes.
"I heard that you went with Elder Lin to pick up my two cousins in that village, and I also heard that he was the one who saved them."
Mu Lingshu smiled amusedly after seeing her friend's expression, but she did not like to meddle in other people's business, so she did not say anything about the matter.
Lin Dong'er took a deep breath before answering Xia Bing.
"You are right that Zhang Fei saved them, but I do not know him, so you do not need to ask me about him.
If you have any business with him, you can go directly to our sect later.
However, you better not bring Luoyue to see him, or he will snatch her away from you."
After hearing that, Nanxuan Luoyue questioned Lin Dong'er with suspicion.
"Why do I feel that you hate him so much?
Did he try to seduce you before?"
"Humph!" Lin Dong'er snorted and turned her face to the side, as she had no intention of answering Nanxuan Luoyue's question, but her attitude made her and Xia Bing sure of it.
They then turned to Mu Lingshu, who immediately shook her head at them, especially since she had not witnessed Zhang Fei [1]'s action towards her.
*Drap...
Drap...*
Suddenly, they heard the heavy footsteps of beasts from afar, prompting them to immediately use their senses to check that direction.
Their excitement was heightened, especially since the bandits had finally returned to their village.
Their expressions immediately turned serious as they observed the bandits, including Yin Tong and Ni Weiwei, who had been acting so relaxed.
"So, when are we going to make our move?"
Yin Tong was the first to answer Xia Bing.
"Based on their condition, they appeared to have had a fierce battle before, and many of them are quite badly injured.
However, we are unable to do so at this time due to the strength and quantity of their riding beasts, making it challenging for the seven of us to fight them."
"Look at that guy; he should be their leader." Ni Weiwei spoke as she gestured toward the bald man riding a leopard in front.
"It seems the person who proposed this mission gave us incorrect information about them, as I can't sense his cultivation, which should have reached the soul realm."
"That's true." Lin Dong'er nodded with a serious expression.
"I think it would be better if we aborted our mission, especially since there's no way we can defeat their leader even if we work together to gang up on him."
Xia Bing and the others nodded in agreement with Lin Dong'er, particularly considering that Yin Tong was the strongest among them.
However, his cultivation was still in the 8-Star Core realm, while most of them were in the middle-stage Core realm.
Mu Lingshu unexpectedly received a voice transmission, prompting her to immediately inform Lin Dong'er through voice transmission. 'Zhang Fei [1] contacted me and inquired about our whereabouts.
He is currently en route to this area to carry out some missions that aren't far from here.
Furthermore, he is not traveling alone; his partners are accompanying him.
How about I ask him to help us?

Lin Dong'er turned to Mu Lingshu with a frown, but she was eager to capture those bandits, so she immediately agreed with her idea. 'All right, you can contact him now and ask him to come here as soon as possible.' "Guys!

There are some core disciples from our sect on their way to this region, and Lingshu has already asked them to come here to help us, so we will wait for them to arrive before thinking about our next plans."

chapters.title: Chapter 236: Third Blood Demon Tree
paragraphs: On the Pandora Odyssey, Zhang Fei [1] stood by his side with his partners, observing every area they passed. He faintly smiled after receiving a reply from Mu Lingshu.
"Why do you keep smiling at yourself, brother?"
Instead, Gu Yan chuckled and confided in Xia Qianqian. "Hehe. "He must have gotten a good answer from Mu Lingshu, so he's smiling at himself like this."

"That's true." Luo Yu said it with a nod. "Ever since they first met five days ago, he's been interested in Mu Lingshu, and he seems to be interested in Lin Dong'er as well, so you shouldn't be surprised if he wants to look for them now."
"Are you really interested in Dong'er, Fei?" Ning Xiang inquired curiously.

Du Yuan also turned to Zhang Fei [1] with a suspicious look. "Dong'er is indeed pretty and sexy, but she's Elder Lin's daughter, and he's been reminding the male disciples too many times not to approach her, so they don't dare to approach her. Despite this, Yuan Zheng and Wang Jie disregarded her father's warnings and eagerly pursued her as a partner.
However, she persisted in rejecting them and repeatedly thrashed them."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed upon hearing them. "I am indeed interested in Mu Lingshu, but she has an anomaly in her body, so I have to figure out a way to cure her first before I can get her as my partner. However, I still don't have an idea how to do that, so I will use my other clones to find a solution in another realm.
Regarding Lin Dong'er, she is indeed quite pretty and sexy; however, I am not particularly intrigued by her, and I am merely teasing her."
"But you won't reject Dong'er if she falls for you, right?"

Zhang Fei [1] simply smiled at their words, leading them to believe their guess was accurate. "Anyway, we will arrive at their location in two days, and I will help you guys increase your cultivation for the next two days, especially Qianqian, who has just broken through to the core realm.
However, I will not dual-cultivate with you guys, especially since my cultivation is not completely stable yet."
At the foot of a volcano, five women were resting, but four of them appeared overwhelmed by the intense heat, their bodies drenched in sweat.

"How can you endure such scorching heat, Feltia?" Fyr, the dark elf, inquired as she took off some of her clothes, revealing her smooth, dark skin. "I've been to this sub-realm many times, but I still can't stand it."

'Haha! Of course, I can withstand this heat because, unlike you, I possess fire qi and can use my aura to envelop my body. Feltia muttered inwardly with a laugh before responding to Fyr's query. "I don't know the reason myself, but this heat is nothing to me, and I actually enjoy it."

"That's weird." Unlike Fyr, Eve was a blood-sucking demon, and her clothes were made of her blood, so she simply pulled back her clothes, revealing her naked body before Feltia's eyes. "I've met succubi many times, but none of them were able to withstand this scorching heat, and all of them didn't even want to return to this sub-realm after experiencing it once."

'This vampire is quite sexy, and her white hair is also beautiful.' Feltia then shook her head. "I don't know how to say it, but you've seen me fight before, so you should already know that I'm different from other succubi."

"Hehehe." Leora, the cat demon, who had been naked all this time, immediately hugged Feltia from behind and licked her cheek. "You're right, you are indeed different from the other succubi, especially in your speed and fighting style, and I was truly surprised to see you kill so many demon beasts that fast before.
In fact, I feel that my speed is far behind yours, and your movements are also much more agile than mine and Tessa."

"Leora is right." Eve said it while nodding. "The succubi's fighting style is almost identical to mine, but yours is completely different from theirs. Typically, they utilize their abilities to alter their bodies for combat, primarily using their wings and tails as weapons, whereas you engage in battle with those demon beasts using your bare hands.
However, I have to admit that your punching power is incredibly strong, and you can even kill those lava salamanders with a single punch."

"You're wrong about that, Eve." Feltia replied with a shake of her head. "Those lava salamanders' bodies are strong, but their rank is still below ours, so I can still defeat them easily. However, if we encounter those with a rank higher than ours, I will still be unable to defeat them."

"That's also true, but we won't encounter any higher-ranked demon beasts while we're in this area." Eve then pointed off into the distance. "If we venture deeper, we'll start encountering demon beasts at the viscount and viscountess ranks or above, and many of them are much stronger than those salamanders, especially those flaming goats."

"Honestly, I myself can't wait to fight against demon beasts that are stronger than me, so I can hone my fighting skills even more." Feltia then turned to the faun, Tessa, who was cleaning her naked body. 'This woman is not bad, and her body is also sexier than the other three, but her temper is really irritating.' "Are you still looking down on me after seeing me fight earlier?"
"Humph!" Instead, Tessa snorted coldly and refused to answer Feltia, making Eve and the others shake their heads helplessly at her attitude.

'This bitch! Once you fall into my hands, I will make you keep begging me.' Feltia then turned to Leora, who started licking her ear. "Can you stop it? I feel uncomfortable if you keep licking me like this."

"Hehehe." Leora giggled upon hearing that. "Hey, I have a succubi friend, but her scent is different from yours, and yours really intoxicates me, so I can't stop myself from licking you. Anyway, do you have a partner? How about you become my partner?"
"Not yet." Feltia responded by shaking her head. "Moreover, I'm different from you guys, and I don't like to have relationships with the same sex, so I don't want to be your partner."

Leora pursed her lips after hearing her rejection, but she didn't want to give up, especially since she really enjoyed Feltia's scent, which was similar to catnip, so she wanted to keep her by her side. "Hey, isn't succubi actually genderless?
I remember that the ability to modify the body of your race is not limited to turning your wings and tail into weapons, and my friend once used it to turn herself into an incubus."

'This horny cat! She seems to have a lot of strange ideas in her mind, but that's good, especially since I don't want to do anything with them in my succubi form.' Feltia intuitively understood this, particularly since he had previously transformed Pang Hong into a woman. However, she chose to use her demon transformation instead of applying it to herself.
"You're right about that; not only can I transform myself into an incubus, but I can also transform myself into other demons."
"Is that true?" Leora, Fyr, and Eve asked at the same time. Even Tessa, who had always been cold to Feltia, looked at her curiously.

Feltia nodded to them, then transformed herself into their respective races, surprising them with her perfect resemblance, even down to her aura. After that, she transformed herself into an incubus, making them curious about her abilities.

"Wow!" Leora immediately moved in front of Feltia and observed her ups and downs. "This is the first time I've met a demon who can transform into various demons from other races, and your transformation into our races is truly perfect!"

"That's right, Feltia. Your ability is completely different from other succubi." Fyr said while nodding repeatedly. "If Miss Ashreth knew about your abilities, she would definitely include you in her scout teams and assign you to spy on other demon rulers' sub-realms."
"Hmm?" Feltia looked at Fyr in confusion before asking her. "Why did Miss Ashreth send her scout teams to other demon rulers' sub-realms?"

"Haven't you been following the situation in our realm?" Feltia dismissed Eve's question with a shake of her head. "Our twin lords have great ambitions to become the next demon lord, so they have ordered Miss Ashreth to gather the best demons from our sub-realm, especially those with disguise abilities to spy on the other demon rulers' sub-realms."

"I see." Feltia nodded in understanding to Eve. "Honestly, I don't really care about the situation in this realm, and I care more about myself because I don't want to be suppressed by other demons, so I just focus on improving myself without caring about other matters.
That's why I hope you guys don't tell Miss Ashreth about my abilities, especially since I don't want to waste my time doing something pointless, like spying on their realm."

Fyr, Leora, and Eve agreed with Feltia directly, especially since her fighting ability is better than theirs, so they want to keep her in their group, and they can complete various missions more easily. Tessa, on the other hand, appears to hold a different perspective, primarily due to her dislike for Feltia and her fear of her taking her place.

After they rested for quite some time, Feltia and the four female demons immediately continued their journey and ventured deeper into Aries's sub-realm. However, the scorching heat and the large number of aggressive demon beasts made their journey difficult. They had to keep moving while fighting them, which quickly tired them again and necessitated frequent rests.

A man in black stood on a building not far from the Huan Clan location that had been razed to the ground after the previous big fire, leaving only the outer wall. "What the hell happened here? Why was the Huan Clan suddenly destroyed? Could it be that Liu Hua and her group were the culprits?

After all, Pang De told me that they managed to capture Pang Hong, and they probably already know the identities of our vassals. Furthermore, the locals in this city reported that none of the clan members survived, leaving only Huan Jingtian and Huan Shitian, who were still unaware of their clan's destruction. Otherwise, they should have returned to the city by now."

The man was none other than Pang Gui, one of the elders of the Pang Clan, and he immediately left the city afterwards. However, he was unaware that some people were following him from a distance using concealing artifacts, and he quickly flew towards the ocean before arriving at a remote island in the middle of the ocean.

After he arrived, Pang Gui immediately entered the heart of the forest, where there was a half-mature black tree. "Phew! Fortunately, Pang Hong did not know this location, or those people would have known this tree, and Pang De will definitely blame me if this tree falls into their hands."

After that, Pang Gui sent a voice transmission to his leader, informing him about the destruction of the Huan Clan. This news infuriated Pang De, who then ordered him to investigate the situation at the Guan and Qiao Clans.
Moreover, Pang De ordered him to find another clan to replace the Huan Clan, so Pang Gui immediately left the remote island.

Some time after Pang Gui left the island, some people from the demon fox group landed there, but none of them dared to enter the forest and reported their discovery to Liu Hua, who immediately told Zhang Fei about it. Besides, she ordered the people in the group to keep track of their enemies's movements.

However, Zhang Fei did not intend to take the blood demon tree for now, especially since the location where it was hidden was far away in the middle of the ocean, so he was not worried that the demon miasma would spread to the cities in the eastern region.
Furthermore, he was eager to adapt himself to the four-time gravity, and time passed so quickly that he didn't want to worry about other matters at the moment.

Unknowingly, two days had passed in the Sky Jade Realm, and Zhang Fei [1] had already arrived at an area not far from the bandits' village. After he brought his partners down from the Pandora Odyssey, he immediately stored it in his inventory, and then led them to Mu Lingshu and the others locations.
"Over here, Fei," Mu Lingshu called out as she waved her hand towards them.

Fyr, Leora, and Eve agreed with Feltia directly, especially since her fighting ability is better than theirs, so they want to keep her in their group, and they can complete various missions more easily.
Tessa, on the other hand, appears to hold a different perspective, primarily due to her dislike for Feltia and her fear of her taking her place.
After they rested for quite some time, Feltia and the four female demons immediately continued their journey and ventured deeper into Aries's sub-realm.
However, the scorching heat and the large number of aggressive demon beasts made their journey difficult.
They had to keep moving while fighting them, which quickly tired them again and necessitated frequent rests.
A man in black stood on a building not far from the Huan Clan location that had been razed to the ground after the previous big fire, leaving only the outer wall.
"What the hell happened here?
Why was the Huan Clan suddenly destroyed?
Could it be that Liu Hua and her group were the culprits?
After all, Pang De told me that they managed to capture Pang Hong, and they probably already know the identities of our vassals.
Furthermore, the locals in this city reported that none of the clan members survived, leaving only Huan Jingtian and Huan Shitian, who were still unaware of their clan's destruction.
Otherwise, they should have returned to the city by now."
The man was none other than Pang Gui, one of the elders of the Pang Clan, and he immediately left the city afterwards.

However, he was unaware that some people were following him from a distance using concealing artifacts, and he quickly flew towards the ocean before arriving at a remote island in the middle of the ocean.
After he arrived, Pang Gui immediately entered the heart of the forest, where there was a half-mature black tree.
"Phew!
Fortunately, Pang Hong did not know this location, or those people would have known this tree, and Pang De will definitely blame me if this tree falls into their hands."
After that, Pang Gui sent a voice transmission to his leader, informing him about the destruction of the Huan Clan.
This news infuriated Pang De, who then ordered him to investigate the situation at the Guan and Qiao Clans.
Moreover, Pang De ordered him to find another clan to replace the Huan Clan, so Pang Gui immediately left the remote island.

Some time after Pang Gui left the island, some people from the demon fox group landed there, but none of them dared to enter the forest and reported their discovery to Liu Hua, who immediately told Zhang Fei about it.
Besides, she ordered the people in the group to keep track of their enemies's movements.

However, Zhang Fei did not intend to take the blood demon tree for now, especially since the location where it was hidden was far away in the middle of the ocean, so he was not worried that the demon miasma would spread to the cities in the eastern region.
Furthermore, he was eager to adapt himself to the four-time gravity, and time passed so quickly that he didn't want to worry about other matters at the moment.
Unknowingly, two days had passed in the Sky Jade Realm, and Zhang Fei [1] had already arrived at an area not far from the bandits' village.
After he brought his partners down from the Pandora Odyssey, he immediately stored it in his inventory, and then led them to Mu Lingshu and the others locations.
"Over here, Fei," Mu Lingshu called out as she waved her hand towards them.

chapters.title: Chapter 237: Attack The Bandits
paragraphs: "Have you guys been waiting long? We-"

"Wait a minute!" Lin Dong'er suddenly exclaimed and pointed at Zhang Fei [1]. "How could your cultivation increase so rapidly in just a week? I remember for certain that your cultivation was still in the 4-Star Core Realm when we last met, but now it has reached the 10-Star Core Realm!"

Upon hearing that, Xia Bing, Lian Chengyu, and Nanxuan Luoyue gazed at Zhang Fei [1] with wide eyes, especially after they detected his cultivation. After all, they had met him before, so they were completely shocked by his rapid increase in cultivation.
Unlike them, Yin Tong, Ni Weiwei, and Yun Kexin had never met Zhang Fei [1], so they didn't know anything about him, but Lin Dong'er's words still shocked them.

Lin Dong'er then observed the five women who were with Zhang Fei [1]. "Moreover, not only yours, but their cultivation also increased too significantly! Ning Xiang and Du Yuan's cultivation broke through one level, while Luo Yu and Gu Yan broke through two levels. As for Qianqian, she had yet to break through to the core realm, but she has now reached the 2-Star Core Realm."
Xia Bing and the others were once again shocked by Lin Dong'er's words, especially since they were all dual cultivators, but none of them could match their cultivation speed.

After hearing that, Mu Lingshu shook her head, feeling that Lin Dong'er's reaction was too exaggerated, so she immediately spoke to her and the others. "You guys don't need to be surprised by their cultivation speed, do you? With so many partners at his side, Zhang Fei [1]'s cultivation is bound to soar.

Since his cultivation has reached the 10-Star Core Realm, all of his partners, especially Luo Yu, Gu Yan, and Qianqian, will naturally benefit from it, given the significant difference in their cultivation.

"That's true." Nanxuan Luoyue replied with repeated nods. "Unlike Zhang Fei [1], who has many partners, we only have one. Moreover, he has dual-cultivated with Elder Tang before, so I think it's natural if his cultivation is faster than ours."

Xia Bing nodded in agreement with her partner before speaking to Zhang Fei [1]. "I truly admire you, brother. During this time, Elder Tang has used many male disciples for his own pleasure, but you were able to tame her so easily, and she didn't dare to bother us again after that day."

"Haha." Lian Chengyu laughed and joined in talking to Zhang Fei [1]. "Previously, I wanted to meet you to ask you about how you were able to subdue Elder Tang, but there was a change in my situation, so I was only able to meet you now, Brother."

Unlike them, Yin Tong seemed jealous of Zhang Fei [1], especially since his partners were so many partners, and most of them were better than his two partners. 'Tch! This bastard! I heard he's a new disciple, but he already has so many partners! Moreover, I've been eyeing Luo Yu and Gu Yan for a long time, but they've always claimed that they don't like men.
Yet they have now become his partners, and they really piss me off!'

Ni Weiwei also harbors jealousy towards Zhang Fei [1]'s partners due to his apparent superior physical attractiveness and strength over Yin Tong. In addition, she felt that he had a close relationship with two women she disliked, Mu Lingshu and Lin Dong'er, which made her even more jealous. 'Humph!
Since he has so many partners, he definitely wouldn't mind dual-cultivating with me, so I'll try to approach and woo him later.'
Meanwhile, the tomboyish Yun Kexin didn't say anything about them, and she acted indifferent to Zhang Fei's presence [1], but her eyes kept stealing glances at him.

For a brief moment, Zhang Fei [1] used his demon eyes to examine their souls, and he found out that Xia Bing, Lian Chengyu, Nanxuan Luoyue, and Yun Kexin were not bad people. However, he frowned for a moment at Yin Tong and Ni Weiwei, especially since their souls were too dark and their jealousy was too extreme.

However, Zhang Fei [1] directly ignored them and spoke to the other two men, but he certainly wouldn't tell them the truth. "Actually, taming Tang Rou isn't difficult as long as you two are strong in bed, especially since her physique isn't that strong. Unfortunately, her cultivation level is too high, and she also used some sort of aphrodisiac liquid, leaving you guys helpless in front of her.
Fortunately, the liquid didn't work on me, so I was able to tame her."
"Haha." Xia Bing and Lian Chengyu, who were naturally aware of their own strength in bed, laughed awkwardly after hearing that, lacking the same confidence as Zhang Fei [1].

Nanxuan Luoyue smiled amusedly at Xia Bing's behavior, then hugged his arm. "You don't have to feel insecure about yourself, okay? If I wasn't satisfied with your strength in bed, then I wouldn't have stayed by your side all this time, and I would have definitely looked for another partner."

"Yeah, you're right; I should have been more confident in myself." With a sense of relief, Xia Bing hugged his partner's waist before speaking to his cousin. "I didn't expect you to decide to be his partner, Qianqian. Did your brother know about your decision?"

"My big brother already knows about our relationship." Xia Qianqian nodded in response to her cousin. "However, you know his character, so I'm sure he won't accept our relationship. Even so, I don't care whether he's willing to accept our relationship or not, especially since I feel comfortable being Zhang Fei [1]'s partner."

Xia Bing nodded in understanding as he smiled. "As long as you are comfortable sharing Zhang Fei [1] with many women, then you don't need to think about Xia Leng, especially since he is too stubborn and always believes that he knows what is best for you."
"Thank you, cousin."

Zhang Fei [1] then walked to the side of the cliff and observed the bandits' village on his map. "Why did you guys decide to take on this mission? Fortunately, you refrained from attacking them right away, as the bandit leader's cultivation has reached the 5-Star Soul Realm, and his leopard beast's strength is also in the soul realm.
Moreover, some of those bandits have already attained the 10-Star Core Realm, making it unlikely for you guys to win against them."

"Here." Lin Dong'er handed him the mission sheet, causing Zhang Fei [1] to frown after reading it. "At first, we didn't know that there was something strange about this mission, so we decided to take it, and we only realized it after the bandits returned to their village.

If my guess is right, the person who proposed this mission might have some connection with those bandits, and that person might have intentionally wanted to hand us over to them. That's why I asked Lingshu to contact you, especially since you were also on your way to this area."

"You are right." Zhang Fei [1] replied with a nod. "It would be best if you contacted your father and asked him to trace the identity of the person who submitted this mission, so we can deal with that person right after we finish off these bandits."
"All right." Ling Dong'er immediately agreed with Zhang Fei [1] and contacted Lin Hao.

"Are you sure you want to attack them, brother?" Xia Bing inquired as he made his way to Zhang Fei's side. "I don't know about your true strength, but I have a feeling that you are stronger than you look. However, the bandit leader and his beast are powerful, and while you might be able to defeat them, we will find it challenging to fight them directly.
Yin Tong and Du Yuan, the highest cultivators among us, are still at the 8-Star Core Realm, making us vulnerable to those who have attained the 10-Star Core Realm."

"We will attack them, but we don't need to do it openly, and we need some help to disrupt their situation first." Zhang Fei [1] then floated into the air, inspecting the area around the hill. Once he found what he was looking for, he immediately disappeared from their sights, confusing Xia Bing and the others.

"You guys don't need to be confused, and you will see an interesting show soon." Lin Dong'er and the others immediately turned to Luo Yu. "You don't know Zhang Fei [1] like we do, and I can assure you that his strength and abilities are far beyond your imagination. That's why we just need to wait for him to come back, and we will attack those bandits after receiving his signal."
"What do you think he will do? What kind of help does he mean?"
Luo Yu responded to Mu Lingshu's question by shaking her head. "I don't know exactly what his plans are, but he will give us a good show, so let's wait for him first."

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] was already in his half-fox form, standing in the sky just above the two flying beasts' nest. The two beasts had a head like an ostrich and a body like a martial eagle, as well as sharp claws.

Sensing Zhang Fei's presence [1], those beasts looked up at him, but he immediately released his heavenly fox aura to intimidate them. He then landed in front of them, speaking to them via telepathy. "Both of you have power on the 1-Star Earth Stage, so I want you guys to attack those bandits. If you are willing to help me, then I will do nothing to you two, but vice versa."
The two beasts shuddered at Zhang Fei's threat [1], and they then nodded at him, making him smile in satisfaction with their decision.

"They are in that village, so you two must go there immediately, and you can kill them all." Without hesitation, the two beasts flew towards the bandits' village, and Zhang Fei [1] instantly transformed back into his human form before using his Nine Cloud Steps to return to the others.

"Hey! What are you planning to do to those bandits?" However, Zhang Fei [1] only smiled and winked at Lin Dong'er, causing her to frown. "Tch! Anyway, my father was unable to trace the person's identity, leading him to believe that the person was part of their group. At first, he asked me to abort this mission, but I told him that you were with us, so he immediately changed his mind."

"That's good; I'll help you guys clear that mission, and I'll take them away to carry out our mission afterward." Mu Lingshu wanted to ask Zhang Fei [1], but they suddenly heard the shrill voices of two beasts, so they immediately looked in the direction the voices came from. "Our help has arrived, and they'll clear those bandits for us, so we won't have to break sweat to get rid of them."
"Two earth-rank ostrich-eagle beasts?" All of them turned to Zhang Fei [1] with wide-open eyes, except for his partners.
Zhang Fei [1] nodded to them. "I found them a little far from this location, and I asked them to help us get rid of those bandits."
"Haha." Luo Yu laughed and hugged Zhang Fei [1]'s arm. "I'm sure you didn't ask for their assistance, but you must have threatened them to help us, right?"
Zhang Fei [1] smiled at that and gently pinched Luo Yu's nose. "You understand me so well, huh? You're right, I did threaten them, but I had no intention of killing them."

'This bastard!' Yin Tong cursed inwardly after hearing Zhang Fei's answer [1], especially since he had always been arrogant and wanted to stand out among the other disciples, but his presence had ruined his hopes.

Unlike him, Ni Weiwei looked at Zhang Fei [1] with questions in her heart. 'How can he, with his current cultivation, threaten earth-rank ostrich-eagle beasts?' According to my understanding, only a beast with a higher bloodline can threaten another beast whose strength is greater than its own. If my guess is accurate, then this guy is likely a beast that has undergone a transformation into a human.
Otherwise, he wouldn't be able to do such a thing with his cultivation still at the Core Realm.'
Yun Kexin, who was still pretending to be indifferent, kept glancing at him, and her actions certainly didn't escape Zhang Fei's [1] eyes, so he smiled faintly at her, making her heart flutter.

Before long, the two beasts had arrived at the bandits' village, and they immediately attacked them according to Zhang Fei [1]'s orders, causing chaos among the people, who immediately fled in various directions. The two beasts' speed and strength rendered even their leader and his leopard beast helpless, resulting in numerous deaths from their attacks.
