chapters.title: Chapter 238: Sky Jade Realm History I
paragraphs: When Zhang Fei [1] saw the two beasts about to kill the bandit leader, he immediately moved to stop them and asked them to leave, especially since most of the bandits were already dead and he still needed information about the mastermind behind the mission.
After they departed, Zhang Fei [1] immediately crouched in front of the bandit leader, strangling his neck, and the other disciples immediately landed behind him.
Lin Dong'er wanted to stop Zhang Fei [1] from killing the bandit leader, but Mu Lingshu immediately held her back and shook her head. "Leave it to him."

Zhang Fei [1] then used his demon eyes to instill fear into the bandit leader's soul, causing him to shiver in fear. "Who is the one who submitted the mission to our sect? What is your purpose in luring our disciples here?"

"The person who submitted the mission is the young master of the Du Clan, Du Ruhui, and he is also a core disciple of your sect." Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows as the bandit leader gave him the name, and the disciples also looked shocked after hearing it. "I'm not sure about his reasons because he didn't tell me the truth, and he asked us to capture any disciples who took the mission."
[Master, the Du Clan is one of the vassals of the Pang Clan, so I think the purpose of him ordering these bandits has something to do with them.]
'Yeah, you're right.'
[What are you going to do to him, Master?]
'Hmm?' Zhang Fei [1] thought for a while before using his demon slave mark and memory manipulation on the bandit leader. "What's your name?"
"Tu Li."

"Pft! Hahahaha!" Lin Dong'er suddenly laughed when she heard the bandit leader's name, and the other disciples also smiled strangely at his name. "Haha! This guy is so weird! Tu and Li can also mean baldness, but he chooses to use both as his name because he is bald himself, which I find amusing."
"Anyways, what did you do to him? Why do I feel that his expression suddenly turned weird?" Mu Lingshu asked as she squatted down beside Zhang Fei [1].

"Hehe." Zhang Fei [1] chuckled and told Mu Lingshu. "The Du Clan is one of the major clans in this southern region, and they are powerful, so it would be better if we didn't tangle with them directly. Since Du Ruhui used this guy and his group to trap our disciples, I decided to use him as a means of retaliation, so I purposefully enslaved him."
"Huh?" Almost all of them were shocked by Zhang Fei [1]'s confession, except for his partners.

"What? Why are you guys so shocked? You know, the slavery technique is not an evil technique, and everyone can learn it." Zhang Fei [1] inquired with a laid-back smile, glancing briefly at Yin Tong before proceeding. "As for me, I will never use my technique carelessly, but I will not hesitate to use it on anyone who has evil intentions towards me and those closest to me."
"How many people have you enslaved?" Lin Dong'er inquired with a frown.

"This man is my fourth slave." Lin Dong'er and the others frowned even more after hearing Zhang Fei [1]'s answer, but he then told them. "The first person joined the Pang Clan; she and her clan planned to poison my wives to capture them, so I was forced to do it to protect them. The second person also has connections with that clan; she and her people repeatedly tried to kill me.
The third person is Pang Hong, and he is one of the elders of that heretic clan. Do you guys still think I am too cruel to use slavery techniques on them?"

Lin Dong'er then asked Zhang Fei [1] again. "How could you have a problem with that heretic clan? After all, your cultivation is still too low for them to care about you, so I find it strange that those people want to kill you."

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed as he stood up. "Perhaps it was fate that brought trouble between us, and it all started when I saved Liu Hua from Pang Hong's hands. Since then, there have been so many troubles that have come to me, and that is also one of the reasons I joined our sect, especially since I need the strength to fight them and protect those closest to me."

"I know that Liu Hua fell into Pang Hong's hands a few years ago, but I didn't expect that you managed to save her, and she is already your wife now." Lin Dong'er's words made Xia Bing, Lian Chengyu, and Nanxuan Luoyue shocked after knowing that Zhang Fei [1] was the son-in-law of the Liu Clan.

After all, the Liu Clan was the second-strongest clan in the southern region after the Shen Clan, and there was a lot of news about them among the public, so they also knew about what happened to Liu Hua in the past.

On the other hand, Yin Tong's expression became even uglier after knowing Zhang Fei [1]'s status, and the jealousy in his heart became even more intense. Unlike her partner, Ni Weiwei became even more ambitious to approach him, believing she could use his status as the Liu Clan's son-in-law to her advantage.
Yun Kexin, on the other hand, thought differently than her partner and sect sister. A faint smile appeared on her face, but no one, except Zhang Fei, knew what was on her mind.
"So what are your plans for Du Ruhui, brother?" Xia Bing asked him.

"Honestly, I haven't thought of any plans for Du Ruhui yet, and I will wait for him to come here again." Zhang Fei [1] then gave some healing pills to Tu Li and ordered him to distribute them to the surviving bandits. "If that man comes here again, then you must contact me immediately, and you must hold him back until I get here."
"Yes, Master." Tu Li then helped his men swallow those healing pills.

"Anyway, you guys better not discuss this matter when you all return to the sect later and keep it to yourselves," Zhang Fei [1] warned the disciples. "Otherwise, Du Ruhui will flee from our sect if he finds out about everything, and it will be troublesome for us if the Du Clan is on guard against us, as they might contact the people from the Pang Clan to attack us."

They nodded in understanding at Zhang Fei [1], except for Yin Tong, and Lin Dong'er spoke to him. "Even so, I will still inform my father about Du Ruhui, enabling him and the other elders to closely monitor him."

"I think that's fine, but tell them not to do anything to Du Ruhui for the time being." Zhang Fei [1] stole a quick glance at Yin Tong before using telepathy to tell Lin Dong'er. 'I want you to ask your father to keep an eye on this Yin guy, especially since he's not a good man and might betray us.'

Lin Dong'er raised her eyebrows as she briefly glanced at Yin Tong, and she immediately nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei [1] afterwards. 'All right, I will instruct my father to monitor him closely to prevent any potential harm to us.' "Now that we have completed our business here, we should head back to our sect."
"Would you like to join us in searching for an adult owl bear, Senior Lingshu?" Zhang Fei [1] asked him.

"I don't have any other plans in the sect, so I'll join you guys." After she answered Zhang Fei [1], Mu Lingshu then turned to Lin Dong'er. "You guys can return to our sect first, and please tell Elder Guo that I am going with them."
For a few moments, Lin Dong'er suspiciously looked at Mu Lingshu before turning to the other disciples, and they immediately took out their returning jade before breaking it.
After they disappeared, Zhang Fei [1] led the six women to leave the bandit village, and they immediately went to another area to look for an adult owl bear.

In a dense forest, a tiny woman with four butterfly wings on her back was flying nimbly through the line of trees in front of her. Before long, she had arrived in front of a crowd of trees neatly arranged like a formation, and she pressed her palm against one of them before using her qi.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
The tree formation quickly moved to the side, creating a fairly wide path in the middle. The tiny woman immediately flew in through the path before the trees closed again.
The next second, the tiny woman had appeared in a forest city, and there were many small living beings wandering around the forest city, all of whom were people of various natural races.

The forest town appears remarkably spacious, with numerous small houses nestled among the trees in the surrounding area. Despite their diminutive size, the houses boasted a sleek and sophisticated design that closely resembled homes on Earth.
Besides, there are also many tall buildings in the area, a little bit far from the entrance, making the scenery between the two areas quite contrasting with each other.

The tiny woman smiled as she observed the people, and she swiftly soared towards the lone house perched atop a towering tree in the heart of the city. Soon, she landed in front of the house, walked straight into it, and called out. "Grandpa! I'm home!"

"Oh?" A little old man greeted her with a big smile before briefly hugging her, but then he put on a look of dejection before asking. "Where have you been, Zefyr? I thought you had forgotten your grandfather."

"Hehe! You are my grandfather; how could I forget about you, Grandpa Oliver?" Zefyr laughed in response, then proceeded to explain. "Actually, I previously traveled to the southern region, and I found a low-rank wind elemental seed. However, I accidentally met a man named Zhang Fei [1] there, and he was looking for the seed.
At first, I didn't want to give it to him, but I changed my mind after I found out that he was a true heavenly fox."
After hearing Zefyr's answer, Oliver was stunned for quite a while, but his expression kept changing between shock, joy, and excitement.
"Huh? Why are you reacting like this, Grandpa?" Zefyr inquired, waving her little hand in front of Oliver's face.
Soon, Oliver came back to his senses before taking a deep breath, and his expression turned extremely serious, confusing Zefyr. "Is it true that you met a heavenly fox before?"
"Well, that's true." Zefyr responded by nodding repeatedly. "However, Grandpa, Zhang Fei [1] is a strange one."
"Hmm? What's so strange about that man?" Oliver asked with an eyebrow raised.
Zefyr hugged her grandfather's arm before bringing him to sit with her. "Zhang Fei [1] is not only a true heavenly fox, but he is also a complete human."
"Do you mean he's half human and half fox, Zefyr?"

"No." Zefyr answered by shaking her head. "He's not half-breed, Grandpa. He's a full-fledged Heavenly Fox, and he's also a full-fledged human. I don't know how he's like that, but I've seen his both forms with my own eyes, so I'm sure that I don't misrecognize him."

Suddenly, Oliver remembered something and immediately floated towards the shelves filled with hundreds or thousands of books, and he kept flying in front of all the books as he was looking for an important book.
As she watched her grandfather busy looking for a book, Zefyr sat casually on the chair while moving her legs up and down.

About half an hour later, Oliver finally found the book he was looking for and sat back down beside Zefyr again, but the book looked so old and dusty. He then waved his hand, instantly dispelling all the dust, and slowly turned each page, searching for something inside.
After a while, Oliver's eyes fell on a picture on one of the pages of the book, and it was a picture of a white fox with ten tails behind its hips. "Found it."

"Hmm?" Zefyr then looked at the image on the book's page, and under the image were many writings with strange symbols. "Isn't this the image of the heavenly fox, Grandpa? But why does this fox have ten tails?"
Oliver let out a soft sigh before asking Zefyr back. "You must still remember your great-grandfather's story about this realm, right?"
"Yes. " Zefyr nodded at Oliver.

chapters.title: Chapter 239: Sky Jade Realm History II
paragraphs: As he rubbed the fox image on the book, Oliver told his granddaughter again. "In the beginning, there was only one heavenly fox that was born in this realm, but no one knew about his existence before the great event. His power far exceeded that of the other natural races, and this ten-tailed fox in this image is his true form."
"If this ten-tailed fox is as powerful as you say, then where is he now?" Zefyr asked with a doubtful look.

"Hehe, I haven't finished telling it yet." Zefyr nodded at Oliver, who immediately continued. "In the distant past, this realm was known not as the Sky Jade Realm but as the Heaven Wilderness Realm, and it was one of the numerous realms within the upper realms.

At that time, life in this realm was calm and peaceful, especially since there were no humans living in it and there were only natural races in it. However, when human cultivators discovered and settled in this realm, the situation began to change. Their numbers continued to grow as time went on, but we were able to coexist peacefully for a long time.

However, human nature is fundamentally flawed, characterized by greed, violence, and cruelty. Besides, they reproduce faster than us, and their population eventually becomes much larger than ours, which makes our races slowly marginalized, and we become a minority in our birth realm."

"Tch!" Zefyr gritted her teeth before speaking angrily. "That's why I've always hated humans because they're lower than beasts! They killed my parents, even though they didn't do anything to them! If my great-grandfather hadn't forbidden me to kill those humans, I would have killed every human I met."

Oliver let out a heavy sigh after hearing Zefyr's words. "As time progressed, those humans began to turn hostile and hunt us natural races, resulting in a rapid decline in our populations, particularly due to our slow population growth. One day, a great war broke out between humans and the natural races in this realm, and the ten-tailed fox showed himself for the first time at that time."
"So, it was the ten-tailed fox that stopped the war?" Zefyr asked in surprise. .

"Yes." Oliver nodded at Zefyr. "The ten-tailed fox stopped the war against those human cultivators by himself, and he slaughtered three-quarters of their population, drenching the entire area of this realm with their blood."
"Huh!" Zefyr exclaimed in shock. "Is the ten-tailed fox really that powerful, Grandpa?"

"Ha ha ha!" Oliver laughed out loud, seeing his granddaughter's shocked expression. "The ten-tailed fox's power is truly terrifying, shaking even heaven, and his enormous body can cover half of this realm when he flies in the sky."
After hearing that, Zefyr's jaw dropped, especially since the Sky Jade Realm wasn't that small, which meant the ten-tailed fox's body was truly enormous.

"Hehe, I already knew you would be so shocked." Oliver spoke as she caressed Zephyr's tiny head. "After the war was over, the ten-tailed fox became the sole ruler of this realm, and his presence brought peace to this realm, allowing humans and our natural races to coexist in peace again.
Several thousand years later, he felt that the Qi in this realm had been steadily depleting, which he believed was due to his own presence."
"Then, what happened next, Grandpa?" Zefyr inquired impatiently.

"Why are you so impatient?" But Oliver immediately continued his story. "Despite the ten-tailed fox's cunning, arrogance, and cruelty, he also possesses a kind heart. After thinking about it for quite some time, he chose to sacrifice himself for the sake of all the inhabitants of this realm.

However, he also made a decision that shook this realm, particularly when he decided to use all his strength to move this realm to a very faraway location, as he didn't want strong human cultivators from other realms to come to this realm. After he exhausted his strength, he split himself into two heavenly foxes, and they are the ancestors of the current heavenly fox race."
Zefyr nodded in understanding, then asked again. "Then, what does this story have to do with Zhang Fei [1], Grandpa?"

"Before the ten-tailed fox split himself into two, he had already left an inscription on the stone in the deepest part of this forest." Zefyr raised his eyebrows upon hearing this, particularly because his grandfather and other seniors had always forbidden young members of the nature race like her from venturing there, thus preventing her from learning about it.
"Let's go; I'll show it to you, especially since you're old enough now, so you're qualified to go in there."
"Yes." Zefyr immediately flew behind Oliver.

Soon, they reached the very back of the forest city, where Oliver promptly activated the plant formation before leading Zefyr out of the city. After that, the two of them flew deeper into the forest until they arrived at a large lake, and the scenery in the area was very beautiful.
Oliver then brought Zefyr to a small piece of land in the middle of the lake, but there was only a fox statue there, as well as a stone monument with ancient writing.

"See this writing?" Oliver asked while pointing at the stone monument. "The ten-tailed fox wrote it himself, so our ancestors have always taken care of this monument, and the writing is: One day in the future, the ten-tailed fox will return to this realm once again. However, he is more than a heavenly fox; he is also a human and a demon.
He is the one who will bring peace for humans, demons, and natural races."

After hearing that, Zefyr's eyes widened in shock, and she looked at her grandfather seriously, as the features he mentioned resembled those of Zhang Fei [1]. "How could it be so coincidental? Could it be that the ten-tailed fox has the ability to foresee the future?"

"The ten-tailed fox is too mysterious, and he has always lived in this lake in solitude, so no one knew about his true abilities." Oliver then turned to Zefyr. "Aside from his two identities as a human and a heavenly fox, Zhang Fei [1] should also be a demon, right?"

"Yes, Grandpa." Zefyr replied with a nod. "At first, I didn't know that he was a demon, but when I helped him obtain the wind element, I discovered his darkness element. However, I felt strange about him because he also had the light element, and the two elements shouldn't be able to coexist in one body, but the fact is that he has both.
That's why I questioned him about this, to which he responded by revealing his demon form."

"You're right about that." Oliver expressed his agreement with a nod. "In reality, light and darkness can never coexist together, but Zhang Fei [1] is an anomaly. In this universe, he is the only living being who has three real forms: a human, a heavenly fox, and a demon.
The heavenly fox is the owner of the light element, and the demon is always related to the darkness element, so it is natural that he has both elements in his body. Have you told him about us?"
"I've given my pendant to him." Zefyr replied with a nod.
"I see." Oliver then patted Zefyr's head gently. "I want you to go to his side, and you must protect him, especially since he is the only living being who can bring peace to this universe."

"Eh?" After a moment of surprise, Zefyr immediately agreed to her grandfather's request. "I don't know where he lives, but I think he should still be in the southern region now, so I'll go to that region again to look for him."

After they arrived at the Yin-Yang Pavilion, Lin Dong'er immediately rushed to her father and told him about Du Ruhui, causing Lin Hao's face to darken. "Father, Zhang Fei [1] asked you not to do anything to him for now, especially since he has his own plans for him, and he also asked you to keep an eye on Yin Tong."
"Yin Tong? Why did he ask me to keep an eye on that brat?" Lin Hao questioned his daughter, looking puzzled.

"I don't know for sure about that." Lin Dong'er answered with a shake of her head. "However, Zhang Fei [1] told me of Yin Tong's bad character and expressed concern about his potential betrayal, prompting him to request that you monitor him closely."

Lin Hao did not understand how Zhang Fei [1] could judge a person's character, but he himself realized that Yin Tong was indeed not a good man, so he immediately agreed with that. "All right, I will watch that brat closely, and I will stop him if he shows any bad behavior.

As for Du Ruhui, I must first discuss this matter with Vice Sect Master Luan'er and Mistress Shen, especially since this matter is very serious if the Du Clan really has a relationship with the Pang Clan."
After his daughter left, Lin Hao contacted Yan Luan'er and Shen Xueyi. Shortly after, the two women arrived in front of him, so he immediately shared the information from his daughter with them.

"Actually, we already know that the Du Clan is one of the vassals of the Pang Clan, and Liu Rong has also ordered her clan members to monitor their movements." Lin Hao was surprised by Shen Xueyi's answer, which was confirmed by Yan Luan'er's nod of agreement.
"However, I didn't expect that Du Ruhui would cooperate with those bandits to trap our disciples, which means those people from the heretic clan want to use them to weaken us from within."

"I thought the same as you, Mistress." Yan Luan'er nodded and said. "Unfortunately, they are unaware of the presence of Zhang Fei [1], a dark horse in our sect. Moreover, he could defeat those bandits so easily, and our disciples would have already fallen into their hands if not for him. So, what do we do about Du Rui? Are we going to follow his plan?"
"Zhang Fei [1] can handle Du Ruhui's case, but we still need to monitor him while he stays in our sect." Shen Xueyi then questioned Lin Hao. "Did your daughter tell you anything else?"

"Zhang Fei [1] also asked me to keep an eye on Yin Tong." Both women raised their eyebrows after hearing Lin Hao's answer. "That brat from the Yin Clan doesn't have a good character, and he suspects that he might betray us."

Shen Xueyi nodded in understanding. "All right, you can keep an eye on Yin Tong, Elder Lin. If he intends to do anything bad in our sect, then you can immediately capture him and lock him up in the punishment hall."
"Yes, Mistress." After the two women left, Lin Hao also left his room, and he followed Yin Tong's movements from a distance.

Yin Tong, who was still unaware that Lin Hao was watching her, kept cursing in her room. He truly felt jealous of Zhang Fei [1], who had so many partners, and he also felt humiliated because Lin Dong'er and the others were so obedient to him.

Ni Weiwei naturally knew her partner's character, but she did not seem to care about Yin Tong, and she kept racking her brains to find a way to get close to Zhang Fei [1]. 'Who can help me get close to him? Should I use Kexin as bait to lure him to me? Nah! He won't be interested in her because she lacks beauty and is tomboyish; therefore, I need to find someone else who can assist me.'
Meanwhile, Yun Kexin sat on the chair with her head lowered, but no one knew what she was thinking, especially since she rarely spoke and always kept her feelings to herself.

paragraphs: Ning Xiang observed the male owl bear for a moment before taking out a jade flute. However, you guys should be careful, especially since we don't know for sure his mental strength, so I don't know how long my sound techniques can distract him."

"All right." Mu Lingshu immediately drew her white sword, and Luo Yu used her hardened silver threads as a weapon. After that, the two rushed to attack the male owl bear, and Ning Xiang also started playing her flute to disturb his concentration.
*Clang*
"Roar!"
Even though the owl bear felt dizzy from Ning Xiang's sound attack, he still managed to deflect Mu Lingshu's sword with his long and sturdy claws.

"Roar!"
*Swoosh*

*Slash... Slash...*

Unfortunately, the owl bear's skin was extremely thick, and Mu Lingshu's attacks only scratched his skin and had no significant impact on him. Her attack made him even more furious, so he opened his mouth wide before attacking her with a loud roar. "Roar!"

However, your sound attack seems to have a big effect on him, so I think it would be better if we attacked him from a distance."
"Yes." As she observed the owl bear, Ning Xiang nodded in agreement, and she thought of a way to take him down as soon as possible.

Luo Yu raised her eyebrows before conveying her idea to them. "How about we contact Zhang Fei [1]? He won't have any trouble taking him down, so we can go carry out other missions as soon as possible."

"No." Ning Xiang and Mu Lingshu immediately rejected Luo Yu's idea. "The three of us are cultivators, so we can't keep relying on Zhang Fei [1], and we have to fight on our own to take down this beast."

After encasing them in her qi, Gu Yan immediately fired her arrows toward the owl bear, but his tough skin deflected them. "Shit! His skin is really thick and tough."

*Bam!*

Before Wei Luan finished her words, Zhang Fei [1] had already moved in front of them and strangled You Han's neck. "I dare you to say that one more time."

"Ugh! Let go of me, you male whore!" You Han uttered those words while punching Zhang Fei [1]'s right hand, but he responded by strangling her neck even more tightly, causing her face to turn completely red from breathing difficulties. "If you don't let me go now, then my clan and sect members will hunt you down!"
Seeing that, Wei Luan immediately stood up and grabbed Zhang Fei [1]'s right hand. "Hey! Please let him go; you are a man, so it's inappropriate for you to do this to him."

"Do you think I care if she is a woman? In my eyes, men and women are equal, so she should bear the consequences of her own behavior." Zhang Fei [1] then released a bit of his aura, causing Wei Luan to stagger backwards, but Chu Xing immediately supported her before she fell. He then directed his demon-like gaze towards You Han, causing her to shudder at the sight of her blood-red eyes.
"I really despise an arrogant woman who can't control her words like you."
*Boom*
Zhang Fei [1] slammed You Han into a huge boulder, which exploded, filling her entire body with excruciating pain before she fell to the ground and spat out a mouthful of blood. "Cough... Cough..."

"You Han!" Wei Luan exclaimed in shock before flying towards her sect sister to check her condition, but she was relieved that there were no serious injuries on her body. However, she then turned to Zhang Fei [1] with a shocked look, as she did not expect that he would treat a woman so harshly.

Meanwhile, Chu Xing stood frozen in her spot, her mouth wide open in an O shape. She was also shocked to learn that her brother-in-law was so brutal. Even so, she realized that You Han's behavior was excessive and arrogant, and she should not have insulted Zhang Fei [1] and the others in such a manner.
*Roar*

Suddenly, the owl bear beast roared loudly and unleashed a shockwave attack towards them. However, Zhang Fei [1] immediately hugged Chu Xing, who was still in a daze, and carried her to jump onto a tree branch to avoid his attack.

However, Wen Luan was unprepared to avoid the owl bear beast's attack, and his shockwave attack directly hit her and You Han, sending both of them flying backward before their bodies slammed into a large tree a little away from their spot.
*Bam*
Both women fell to the ground afterward as they spurted blood from their mouths, and Wen Luan could feel that her injury was quite heavy, even though it was not too severe.

'Cough! I was too careless; I should have focused more on that beast.' Wei Luan muttered inwardly while coughing as she endured the pain in her body. She immediately took a pill from her storage ring and swallowed it while maintaining a vigilant gaze on the owl beast.
You Han, who had already sustained injuries from Zhang Fei's action [1], experienced more pain throughout her body, and her face also turned quite pale.

'Ugh! It's all because of that damn male prostitute!' You Han inwardly cursed as she took out a small jade without them noticing, and she broke it instantly. 'That bitch, Chu Xing! I will definitely have her expelled from our sect because she had a relationship with that male prostitute!'
"You guys just wait here and let me deal with that owl bear." Zhang Fei [1] spoke as he released Chu Xing from his embrace.

However, Chu Xing immediately grabbed his hand to stop him. "Hey! That owl beast bear is not an ordinary owl bear; the three of us were even overwhelmed dealing with him before, so you shouldn't face him alone. It would be better if we worked together to take him down."
Zhang Fei [1] smiled and moved Chu Xing's hand. "It's okay; that beast is just a mere beast in my eyes, so you don't need to worry about me, sister-in-law."

Zhang Fei [1] immediately jumped down from the tree, which annoyed Chu Xing because he was unwilling to heed his warning. Luo Yu spoke to her directly. "You don't have to worry about your brother-in-law, and I assure you that the beast won't be able to move in front of him."
"Hmm?" Chu Xing immediately turned to Luo Yu, and the other women nodded at her with a look as if telling her not to worry about Zhang Fei [1]. "Is he really my brother-in-law?"

"Yes." Gu Yan answered Chu Xing's question with a nod. "Honestly, we've never met your two sisters in person, but Zhang Fei [1] did tell us that Chu Ying and Chu Qing are his wives, and Mistress Shen has already received confirmation of this from your grandmother. In fact, not only your two sisters, but your aunt, Liu Hua, is also his wife."

"Huh?" Chu Xing repeatedly blinked at Gu Yan and the others, particularly because she was preoccupied with her cultivation in the sect. As a result, Liu Qingyu did not disturb her and did not inform her about the various events that had occurred previously. "How could he possibly be Aunt Hua's husband?
Moreover, she fell into Pang Hong's hands a few years ago, and I hate her very much because she repeatedly attacked my mother and the others."

Chu Xing's lack of knowledge about his family's affairs confused them, prompting Du Yuan to speak to her. "You're not wrong about that, but Zhang Fei [1] has already freed your aunt from Pang Hong's control, and they are now married. If you want to confirm the truth, then it would be better for you to contact your mother or grandmother to confirm everything."
"I see." Chu Xing immediately sent a voice transmission to her mother to confirm it, and she turned to Zhang Fei [1], who was leisurely walking towards the owl bear.
You Han, who was still lying in pain on the ground, looked at Zhang Fei with hatred in her eyes. 'Humph! He overestimated himself! I hope he dies in the hands of that owl bear beast!'
"Roar!" The owl bear beast let out a loud roar before rushing towards Zhang Fei [1] with all his might, and he swung his arms at him to crush him.

Zhang Fei [1] simply shook his head, releasing his heavenly fox aura once more to intimidate the owl bear beast. He then extended his hands to grab the beast's sharp talons, leaving the three disciples from the hidden sea palace stunned.

Even Mu Lingshu rubbed her eyes to ensure she wasn't misinterpreting the situation. Given her lack of knowledge about Zhang Fei [1] and his abilities, she was shocked by his strength to withstand the beast's attack with such ease.
"Hahaha!" Luo Yu laughed at Mu Lingshu and Chu Xing's expressions. "I told you before that Zhang Fei [1] would have no trouble dealing with that owl bear beast."
The owl bear stared at Zhang Fei [1] with a trembling body, as he could feel a terrifyingly strong pressure from his heavenly fox aura, and he fell on his knees to the ground the next second.

"I don't want to kill you, and I just want to bring you back with us alive." Zhang Fei [1] said as he patted the owl bear beast's head as if he were patting a pet's head. "However, I will not hesitate to kill you if you continue to attack us, so you better stop that and be obedient to me. Did you understand?"

Hearing that, the owl bear looked relieved and nodded to Zhang Fei [1]. He immediately sat on the ground like a tame pet. Since the situation was safe, the women immediately landed by their sides, watching the beast with an amused smile. After all, he was so fierce at first, but he has become so tame now.

After that, Zhang Fei [1] turned to two other disciples from the hidden sea palace before walking towards them. He wasn't angry with Wei Luan because she didn't insult them, but he was angry with You Han because she repeatedly insulted his women.

When Wei Luan noticed Zhang Fei [1]'s hostile gaze at You Han, she pulled her sister behind her. "What are you going to do? I know that she's wrong for insulting you guys, but it shouldn't be a serious matter, so you should stop before things get more complicated."

"Is that so? I don't care if she insults me, but I truly hate her because she keeps insulting my women." Zhang Fei [1] casually spoke as he used his demon eyes again to examine You Han's soul deeper, and he discovered many secrets hidden within her soul. "Hey! You are portraying yourself as an honorable woman, yet you harbor numerous unsavory secrets.

You may be able to deceive everyone with your attitude, but I will not be deceived by you. Previously, you insulted us again and again and equated us with prostitutes, but in reality, you are far worse than us, and countless men have enjoyed your body."
"What!?" After hearing Zhang Fei [1]'s words, Wei Luan exclaimed in shock before turning to You Han. Her expression led her to believe that his words were true.

You Han herself gazed at Zhang Fei [1] in a state of disbelief, unable to comprehend how he had discovered her secret. However, she yelled at him and refuted his claim. "You liar! I never do such things!"

"Is that so?" Zhang Fei [1] inquired, shaking his head in response. "Should I mention every one of them? You've slept with your big brother and his friends, and you've also slept with several of your friends' lovers, right? Oh, one more thing: You've also slept with a man named Ying Xiao, and if I'm not mistaken, he should be Wei Luan's fiancé, right?"
"What... what did you just say?" Wei Luan asked in shock, her body trembling violently, as she was truly shocked to hear her fiancé sleeping with Yao Han. "Is it true that they've slept together?"

You Han's face turned deathly pale as soon as Zhang Fei [1] said that, but she still couldn't understand how he got to know her secret in such detail, and she crawled backwards to get away from Wei Luan.
"Does she really do such things?" Chu Xing asked as she walked to Zhang Fei [1]'s side with her eyes fixed on You Han, who appeared frightened.
Zhang Fei [1] pointed his index finger at You Han. "Just look at her face; you should be able to tell the truth from her expression, and she's even trying to get away from Wei Luan."

Wei Luan immediately looked back, and her face was filled with disappointment as she watched Yao Han try to get away from her. Involuntary tears dripped from the corners of her eyes, and she inquired in a tone of disappointment. "Why... why did you do that to me? Wh... why did you betray me?"
You Han shivered at her question, and her body trembled even more. "Wei Luan, I-"
"What happened in this place?"
You Han didn't have time to reply to Wei Luan's question; they had already heard a woman's soft voice, and moments later, two middle-aged twin women landed gracefully in front of them.

Zhang Fei's [1] smile instantly widened as soon as he saw them, and he naturally recognized their identities, especially since they were Hai Dongyin and Hai Dongxin, whom he had met at Blazing Volcano Mountain.
"Zhang Fei!?" The Hai Twins exclaimed in surprise when they saw him.

chapters.title: Chapter 243: Capture You Han
paragraphs: All of them were surprised that the twin elders of the Hidden Sea Palace knew Zhang Fei [1], which made You Han even more frightened. Initially, she had summoned them to confront him, with the intention of tarnishing Chu Xing's reputation in their presence. However, the circumstances ultimately turned against her. 'Shit! How did he know them?'
"Long time no see, Dongxin, Dongyin." Zhang Fei [1] greeted them with a simple smile.
"Yes, long time no see, Zhang Fei."
Hai Dongyin then asked him. "Why are you in this forest? I expected that you would join the Yin-Yang Pavilion."
"That's right, I also think that you must have joined the Yin-Yang Pavilion." Hai Dongxin added.

Those women were speechless seeing their closeness, especially since the Hai Twins didn't seem to care about Zhang Fei [1] calling their names directly, and they seemed to have a lot of respect for him instead.

"Actually, I came to this forest with my partners to capture an adult owl bear." Zhang Fei [1] replied as he pointed to his partners. "Unexpectedly, we ran into my sister-in-law and your two other sect disciples."

The Hai Twins nodded in understanding and turned their gaze to the owl bear beast, which was sitting obediently on the ground. However, they were no longer surprised to see that, especially since they had witnessed Zhang Fei [1] taming a divine beast before, so a core-rank beast was nothing in his eyes.

Zhang Fei then pointed at You Han and spoke again. "Unfortunately, that woman infuriated me because she kept insulting them as prostitutes, but she herself was a prostitute who slept with a lot of men, and she even slept with her best friend's fiancé."

The Hai Twins, who immediately turned to You Han, realized that she was no longer a virgin, and they also detected some kind of yang qi in her body, indicating that she had indeed slept with several men before. They then looked at Wei Luan, who was still crying, making them believe Zhang Fei [1].
"Tell us the truth." Hai Dongyin glared at You Han, while her twin sister frowned and waited for her response.
"Elders, I-" You Han did not continue speaking and resignedly nodded to them.
"You really are disgusting, You Han!" Hai Dongxin cursed at her as soon as she saw her nod.

Hai Dongyin sighed softly and swiftly moved in front of You Han, taking back her sect identity and everything else. "Your actions are truly disgraceful, You Han. Since you have tarnished the name of our sect, we have decided to expel you from the sect. From today onwards, you are no longer a disciple of the Hidden Sea Palace."

You Han was unable to defend herself, and she could only accept their decision with resignation. However, she directed a hateful glare at Zhang Fei [1], as it was he who had placed her in such a situation. 'I won't forgive you, whore! I'll definitely kill you in the future!'
"Hey, you don't have to look at me like that." Zhang Fei [1] said it with a vile smile. "Even though you didn't say anything, you obviously think that you want to kill me, right?"

You Han's face paled upon hearing this, as she had completely forgotten that Zhang Fei [1] had the ability to read her thoughts. As soon as she noticed Zhang Fei [1] approaching her, she swiftly fled to run away from him.

Zhang Fei [1] immediately blocked You Han's path, strangled her neck, and used his life-absorption technique on her. However, he had no intention of killing her; he only wanted to weaken her, especially since he wanted to use her for something else.

"Ugh! Let me go!" You Han said it with difficulty as she tried to free herself from Zhang Fei [1]'s stranglehold. However, she gradually lost her strength due to his technique, and her body continued to weaken.
When they noticed this, the Hai Twins raised their eyebrows, and Hai Dongxin inquired. "What are you going to do to her?"

"It would be better if you didn't kill her." Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows at the Hai twins, prompting Hai Dongyin to explain the situation to him. "Although her Yao clan is not a major clan, their strength is undeniable, and they truly deserve to stand alongside our Hua, Liu, and Meng clans.
Moreover, their clans know that she is our disciple, so you will bring us great trouble if you kill her."

"The You Clan, huh?" Zhang Fei [1] muttered softly before telling the Hai Twins. "Honestly, you two don't need to worry about this woman clan, especially since my mother-in-law has already instructed members of the Liu Clan to keep a watch on them."

"What do you mean by that? Why did Matriarch Liu instruct her clan members to monitor the You Clan?" Both women asked with puzzled looks because, as far as they could remember, the clan had never caused any trouble before, and their relationship with the major clans was not bad either.
"Sometime ago, we managed to capture Pang Hong, and he is my slave now." Zhang Fei [1]'s words shocked the Hai Twins, but they then remembered Boitata's presence by his side as his contract beast.

"Since he has become my slave, I ordered him to tell us about the identities of every clan that has sided with the Pang Clan, and one of them is the You Clan, so my mother-in-law decided to do that for the time being, especially since she is still busy in the demon cave."

The Hai Twins became even more shocked after hearing the information from Zhang Fei [1], and it never crossed their mind that the You Clan would decide to side with the Pang Clan. However, they knew that the clan was very cunning; even Liu Hua had fallen into their hands before, making them think that those heretics had done something to the You Clan in order to make that decision.

You Han, whose consciousness was already thin, was also shocked to hear that her clan had chosen to side with the Pang Clan. However, she couldn't say anything to refute that, especially since Zhang Fei [1] had already absorbed most of her life force and vitality.

Zhang Fei [1] then spoke to the Hai Twins again. "Anyway, I have no intention of killing this woman, but I will not spare her either. Since she is considering killing me, I plan to send her elsewhere and utilize her for a specific purpose. This way, her clan members won't be aware of her situation, preventing them from causing trouble for you and your sect."
The Hua Twins, Chu Xing, and Wei Luan were shocked when a portal suddenly appeared in front of them, even more so when four women walked out of it.
Only Mu Lingshu, on the side of the Yin-Yang Pavilion disciples, was shocked to see that, especially since she didn't know Zhang Fei [1] that well.

Chu Xing quickly regained her composure and ran towards them. She immediately jumped onto Liu Qingyu, hugging her tightly like an octopus, much to the amusement of her mother and two sisters. "Hehehe! I miss you so much, Mother! I miss you both too, big sis and little sis."

"You are too busy with your cultivation, and you rarely contact me, let alone return to our clan." Instead, Chu Xing laughed even louder at her mother's complaints, prompting Liu Qingyu to inform her. "Anyway, Zhang Fei is indeed Hua'er's husband, and so are your two sisters."

Chu Xing immediately stopped laughing and looked at her sisters strangely. "I'm not surprised that our little sister would fall for him because he is handsome, but I didn't expect that you would fall for him too, Big Sis. Furthermore, he is our aunt's husband, yet the three of you are sharing a husband, and you haven't informed me about your marriages."

"Hehe." Chu Ying laughed softly and pinched Chu Xing's nose. "Isn't it your own fault? You were away from our clan for too long and rarely came home, so you missed a lot of things that happened recently. At first, I also didn't expect to be his wife, but I'm really happy to be his wife now."
"That's true, Sister Xing! I'm also happy to be his wife, and I really enjoy dual-cultivating with him." Chu Qing joined in as she smiled proudly.
"Tch!" Chu Xing gritted her teeth and pinched Chu Qing's cheek. "You are the youngest of the three of us, but you are the most shameless, and you are now such a horny girl!"
"Hahaha!" Chu Qing laughed and stuck out her tongue at her second sister. "I'm just telling the truth, and you will experience the same thing if you become his wife."

"Shameless!" Chu Xing exclaimed as she jumped down from her mother's embrace, briefly glancing at Zhang Fei [1] before turning to Liu Hua. "Are you really back to normal now? I hated you before because you kept attacking my mother and the others, even though we are your family."

"I'm sorry, okay?" Liu Hua then patted Chu Xing's head. "Back then, I was completely under Pang Hong's control, and I couldn't do anything to resist his order. However, everything is fine now, and he has become Fei's slave."
"I see." Chu Xing nodded in understanding. "I will forgive you then, and I'm glad we can finally get back together."

The Hua Twins were not surprised to hear about the Yuan Clan, but they were completely shocked to learn that the Du and Cai Clans were also siding with the Pang Clan. "What are your plans for them?"

"We don't have any plans for them yet." Zhang Fei [1] answered Hai Dongxin's question. "For now, we want to focus on our strength first, especially since their vassals are too many and they are spread across various regions, so we cannot act rashly.

The Hai Twins nodded in agreement. Although they had not participated in the first demon invasion, they had heard much about their power and cruelty from their ancestors, and they absolutely could not underestimate them, or the people of their realm would suffer.
Zhang Fei [1] then spoke to Liu Qingyu and the others. "You guys can go back inside to continue your training, and you can bring Chu Xing there if she wants."

"No." Chu Xing immediately rejected that. "There will be an internal competition in our sect in a few days, and I want to participate in it, so I will go back there after I accompany Sister Luan back to her clan."

"Long time no see, Dongxin, Dongyin." Zhang Fei [1] greeted them with a simple smile.

Hai Dongyin then asked him.

The Hai Twins nodded in understanding and turned their gaze to the owl bear beast, which was sitting obediently on the ground.

Zhang Fei then pointed at You Han and spoke again.

"Unfortunately, that woman infuriated me because she kept insulting them as prostitutes, but she herself was a prostitute who slept with a lot of men, and she even slept with her best friend's fiancé."

The Hai Twins, who immediately turned to You Han, realized that she was no longer a virgin, and they also detected some kind of yang qi in her body, indicating that she had indeed slept with several men before.
They then looked at Wei Luan, who was still crying, making them believe Zhang Fei [1].
"Tell us the truth." Hai Dongyin glared at You Han, while her twin sister frowned and waited for her response.
"Elders, I-" You Han did not continue speaking and resignedly nodded to them.
"You really are disgusting, You Han!" Hai Dongxin cursed at her as soon as she saw her nod.
Hai Dongyin sighed softly and swiftly moved in front of You Han, taking back her sect identity and everything else.
"Your actions are truly disgraceful, You Han.
Since you have tarnished the name of our sect, we have decided to expel you from the sect.
From today onwards, you are no longer a disciple of the Hidden Sea Palace."
You Han was unable to defend herself, and she could only accept their decision with resignation.
However, she directed a hateful glare at Zhang Fei [1], as it was he who had placed her in such a situation. 'I won't forgive you, whore!
I'll definitely kill you in the future!'
"Hey, you don't have to look at me like that." Zhang Fei [1] said it with a vile smile.
"Even though you didn't say anything, you obviously think that you want to kill me, right?"
You Han's face paled upon hearing this, as she had completely forgotten that Zhang Fei [1] had the ability to read her thoughts.
As soon as she noticed Zhang Fei [1] approaching her, she swiftly fled to run away from him.
Zhang Fei [1] immediately blocked You Han's path, strangled her neck, and used his life-absorption technique on her.
However, he had no intention of killing her; he only wanted to weaken her, especially since he wanted to use her for something else.
"Ugh!
Let me go!" You Han said it with difficulty as she tried to free herself from Zhang Fei [1]'s stranglehold.
However, she gradually lost her strength due to his technique, and her body continued to weaken.
When they noticed this, the Hai Twins raised their eyebrows, and Hai Dongxin inquired.
"What are you going to do to her?"
"It would be better if you didn't kill her." Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows at the Hai twins, prompting Hai Dongyin to explain the situation to him.
"Although her Yao clan is not a major clan, their strength is undeniable, and they truly deserve to stand alongside our Hua, Liu, and Meng clans.
Moreover, their clans know that she is our disciple, so you will bring us great trouble if you kill her."
"The You Clan, huh?" Zhang Fei [1] muttered softly before telling the Hai Twins.
"Honestly, you two don't need to worry about this woman clan, especially since my mother-in-law has already instructed members of the Liu Clan to keep a watch on them."
"What do you mean by that?

Why did Matriarch Liu instruct her clan members to monitor the You Clan?" Both women asked with puzzled looks because, as far as they could remember, the clan had never caused any trouble before, and their relationship with the major clans was not bad either.
"Sometime ago, we managed to capture Pang Hong, and he is my slave now." Zhang Fei [1]'s words shocked the Hai Twins, but they then remembered Boitata's presence by his side as his contract beast.

chapters.title: Chapter 244: You Han's Fate
paragraphs: {Ding}
{You got Science Capsule x1}
{100,000,000 has been deducted from your balance.}

Zhang Fei smiled bitterly when he saw the notification, especially since it was too expensive. Despite its high cost, he chose to ignore it, as he had numerous other uses for it. He then took it from the system inventory, causing confusion among the women, particularly those from the Sky Jade Realm.

"Where did you get the capsule, brother? What's its use too?" Zhang Lin inquired as she closely examined the large capsule, which bore a striking resemblance to modern medical equipment with a more futuristic shape and numerous peculiar buttons surrounding it.

Zhang Fei always struggled to explain the equipment he purchased from the system, as it was impossible for him to share information about the system and Mei. "I know you're curious about the origin of this equipment, but I can't explain it to you, Lin. Anyway, this capsule has many functions that I can't explain one by one, and you can see one of its functions soon."
Afterwards, Zhang Fei lifted and laid the weakened You Han into the capsule before closing the lid, which immediately released cold air and anesthetic, causing her to quickly fall into a deep sleep.
"What exactly do you want to do to this girl, Fei'er?" Liu Hua inquired with her gaze fixed on You Han.

"Be patient, Hua'er." Zhang Fei turned to Janette while pointing at the glass tube at the end of the capsule. "Hey, I want you to put enough of your blood, as well as your nails and hair, into this tube, so we can start the process right away."

Although she was confused about Zhang Fei's intentions, Janette immediately carried out his orders by slashing her finger before dripping her green blood, which looked more like tree sap, into the glass tube. After that, she added her nails and a lock of her blonde hair to it.
'Start now, Mei.'
[Okay.]
{Ding}
{DNA of a Dryad detected}
{Do you want to mutate the target into a Dryad?}

'Yes!' Zhang Fei unhesitatingly answered it as he purposely captured You Han for that, and he wanted to use her as a guinea pig to turn a human into a Dryad so Janette could be safe from the rulers' pursuit.
{Ding}
{The mutation process has started.}
{Remaining time: five hours}

Zhang Fei smiled in relief and turned to Janette. "Actually, I don't know if this will work since this is the first time I've used it, and we'll know the results in five hours, but you and the other Dryads will be safe if this does work."
"Thank you, Fei." Janette felt pleased with Zhang Fei's concern for her and her race, even though she was not his official woman.

Lillea was also pleased with ZhangFei's care for them, especially since her race had been suffering for the past few hundred years since the birth of her daughter, and their numbers continued to decline due to the actions of the rulers. "How much more female essence do you need to promote to Viscount Rank?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and pulled Lillea into his arms. "My rank will rise to Viscount if I make you orgasm four times."

"I see." Lillea nodded in understanding and pulled Zhang Fei towards the bed, making Janette smile strangely at her mother's behavior, but she ignored it and joined the others to train at four times gravity. "If that's the case, we can do it now, so you can rise to Viscount Rank faster. However, I am unable to continue assisting you on my own once you have reached Viscount Rank.

This is due to the fact that reaching Earl Rank will take a significant amount of time, and the amount of female essence you require will also increase. Therefore, you will need to look for other female demons to help you."

Naturally, Zhang Fei had already realized this, so he decided to leave his second clone in the Diyu Realm. However, his second clone still couldn't do anything, and he still had to wait for the right time to do so. He then laid Lillea down on the bed, positioned himself beside her, and began to stimulate her while engaging in conversation.

"Actually, I already have a few targets, and one of them is Ashreth, but I still have to be careful to do it so that she and the other demons don't get suspicious of me, especially since all of them only like the same sex."

"Mhn~" Lillea instantly moaned and squirmed as Zhang Fei started stimulating her. "Ashreth is one of the trusted subordinates of the Amaris Twins, especially the Black Amaris, so I think you made the right decision in choosing her, and you might be able to use her to do something to the twins later."
"All right, we don't need to talk about this, and I will satisfy you for now."
Lillea nodded to Zhang Fei and surrendered herself completely to the pleasure that was starting to fill her body, but she also wanted to enjoy his yang qi, so she asked him to do it in a 69 position.
Zhang Fei did not mind Lillea's request, so he immediately fulfilled it by laying her on top of him, and they began to satisfy each other in a 69 position.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 2,700 Qi]
[Reward: 2,700 red jewels.]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 100 Demons]
[Reward: 10,000 Female Essences]

When the two notifications appeared, Zhang Fei realized it was already a new day in the three realms. However, he didn't care about the two quests, especially since his two clones would take care of them. Instead, he preferred to focus on pleasing Lillea.

About an hour later, Lillea had reached her fourth orgasm, which made Zhang Fei finally reach the Viscount rank. Not only did he benefit from their intimacy, but her cultivation also increased quite a bit, especially since he kept supplying her with his yang qi.
[You gained 10,000 female essences from Lillea.]
[Congratulations! Your Demon Rank has been upgraded to Viscount Rank.]
"Phew." Zhang Fei exhaled a breath of relief and smiled with satisfaction. 'How much female essence do I need to reach the Earl Rank, Mei?'
[I'll show it to you, master.]
Demon Rank:
- Viscount Rank [Female Essence: 204,600/600,000]
'Hmm? 400,000 female essences again, huh?' Zhang Fei muttered inwardly as he got out of bed and transformed into his incubus form to observe the difference.

"Your appearance hasn't changed much, but your demon aura has grown stronger." Lillea, who was lying on the bed, commented after seeing Zhang Fei's incubus form. "However, the female demons who are with your second clone might be suspicious of your increase in rank, especially since you are the only demon who can increase it so quickly; even the demon lord can't do it."
"I know." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with that. "Don't worry; I will definitely be very careful with those demons. Anyway, you can take a rest first, and I will continue my training."
"All right." Lillea agreed with that, especially since she was quite exhausted after having four orgasms in a row.

As he waited for You Han's transformation into a Dryad to complete, Zhang Fei began to resume his training. However, he did not train in the center area of the training space, and he practiced his sword under Liu Qingyu's guidance on the other side of the area instead. Despite having studied the basic sword manual, he had not truly mastered swordsmanship, particularly in terms of sword intent.
Four hours later, several consecutive notifications appeared in Zhang Fei's mind.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 100 Demons.]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 10,000 female essences are added to the balance.]
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 2,700 Qi]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 2,700 red jewels sent to inventory.]
[Ding]
[The target has completed the mutation process and transformed into a Dryad.]

After receiving the third notification, Zhang Fei rushed to the side of the science capsule, and the women immediately stopped their training before following him, as they were genuinely curious about the outcome.
*Swoosh*

Zhang Fei smiled with satisfaction after he saw the changes in You Han, but the women reacted in shock to the point their eyes widened, and they then turned to Janette, who was just as shocked as them, especially since the woman had turned into herself.

"Heh! It turns out that my experiment was successful." Zhang Fei said it with a happy smile. 'What about her, Mei? Are her characteristics the same as those of the original Janette? Including the demon lord seed?'

[Master, she is exactly the same as the original Janette, but she doesn't have the real demon lord seed, and she only has the seed's aura. Even so, I'm sure that the rulers won't be able to tell the difference, especially since they themselves have never seen those seeds in person.]

'Good then.' Zhang Fei nodded with a sigh of relief and turned to the women with an amused smile. "Why are you guys so shocked? This way, I can use this woman as a substitute for Janette, and she will be completely safe."
"I really can't believe this, Fei!" Janette shouted as she looked at You Han. "This capsule is amazing! This woman is completely identical to me, including my aura."

"However, this woman doesn't have the real demon lord seed, right? I think it's just its aura." Lillea spoke confidently because she had obtained and used the seed before, so she could naturally distinguish it clearly.

"Yes, you are right about that." Zhang Fei answered Lillea while nodding. "Since the real Demon Lord Seed is inside Janette's body, You Han only gets the aura, but I don't think it's a big deal, especially since the rulers won't be able to tell the difference."

Lillea nodded in understanding, realizing that she wouldn't be able to discern the difference if she hadn't discovered the true demon lord seed. "Anyway, I've been here long enough, so I should get back to my race, or they'll be worried about me."

"Wait a minute, Lillea. I have to do something to this woman first, and you can take her with you afterwards." Zhang Fei used some of his demon abilities on You Han, so she could help him with something. "It's done! I'll send you two back to the Dryad Forest now.

However, it would be better if you sent someone to spread the news about her to the Amaris Twins's sub realm, especially since they want your daughter alive, and I've prepared something inside this woman's body that will have an effect on them, so I can carry out my next plan against them more easily."
"All right, I'll do it as soon as I get there."
Following that, Zhang Fei sent Lillea and You Han to the Dryad Forest in the Diyu Realm, and he resumed his training with the other women.
After arriving at the forest, Lillea immediately went to meet one of her race members, and she instructed her to go to the Amaris Twins' sub realm, as requested by Zhang Fei.

Meanwhile, in Aries's sub-realm, the female demons, particularly Leora, the cat demon, appeared utterly exhausted. Even Eve, the blood-sucking demon, was not much different from her, especially since both of them were close-range fighters.
Although Fyr and Tessa also looked exhausted, their fatigue did not make them as exhausted as the other two, mainly because they always relied on long-range attacks.
However, Feltia was different from them, and she still looked fresh despite having fought so many beasts before, which confused the four female demons.

"Hey, Feltia! How did your demon rank suddenly rise to Viscountess rank?" Fyr questioned her, her eyes full of suspicion. "Moreover, your body strength is too extraordinary for a succubi, and you don't even look tired."

"Hehe." Feltia chuckled and turned to Fyr. "I've told you guys many times that I'm different from other succubi, so I have the ability to absorb essences from other demons, and the amount will increase depending on their strength. Moreover, the amount of essences I need to advance from Baroness to Viscountess is not too much, so I can rank up faster thanks to their demon essences.
However, I can't possibly advance to Countess Rank anytime soon, and I need a lot more demon essences for that."

Fyr seemed doubtful of Feltia's explanation, but Eve then spoke to her. "Actually, some succubi and incubus can do that, and I can do it too. However, unlike her, we cannot do it indirectly; instead, we must do something against our targets to absorb their demon essences."

chapters.title: Chapter 246: The Amaris Twins
paragraphs: "Why did you come here so early, Brother Wei?" Ying Feng, the patriarch of the Ying Clan, inquired with confusion. Even Sun Mei'er and Ying Xiao, who sat beside him, appeared confused by his unexpected arrival, especially given Wei Jiang's unfavorable expression.
Wei Jiang briefly glanced at Ying Xiao before answering Ying Feng's question. "Brother Ying, I'm sorry to disturb you so early, but I came here to cancel our children's engagement."
"What!?" Ying Xiao shouted as he rose from his seat. "What happened, Uncle Wei? Why do you want to cancel my engagement with Luan'er?"

Ying Xiao's parents also frowned at that, but they still remained calm, and Ying Feng spoke to Wei Jiang. "You must give us a reasonable explanation, Brother Wei. Otherwise, I will not accept this matter, especially since it will damage my clan's reputation."
"Didn't this happen because of your son?" Wei Jiang said it while pointing his finger at Ying Xiao. "If only your son hadn't cheated on my daughter, then-"
*Bam*
Ying Feng immediately slammed the table and roared at Wei Jiang. "What do you mean by accusing my son like that!? There's no way my son would do something like that!"
Unlike her husband, Sun Mei'er glanced at their son first, and she could see that Ying Xiao was stiffening after hearing Wei Jiang's words.
"You don't need to be angry just yet, husband." As she patted her husband's hand, Sun Mei'er turned her gaze to Wei Jiang. "Please tell us the truth, Brother Wei."

Wei Jiang nodded at Sun Mei'er. "Luan'er just returned home, but her expression looked gloomy, and she said she wanted to end her engagement with Xiao'er. Initially, she hesitated to disclose the reason, but Chu Xing bluntly informed us that your son was involved in an affair with You Han.
I also found it difficult to believe before, but the elder Hai Twins came with them, and they both confirmed it, so I finally believed it and came here directly."
"Elder Hai Twins?"

"They are still in my clan; if you don't believe me, then you can come to my clan and ask them." Wei Jiang then turned to Ying Xiao. "You Han has already confessed her affair with you to them, and they expelled her from the Hidden Sea Palace, so there's no need for you to conceal the truth from your parents."

Hearing that the Hai Twins had already done so, Ying Feng and Sun Mei'er immediately turned to their son and stared at him with a frown, causing Ying Xiao to shudder and break out in a cold sweat. "I-"

"Are you still unwilling to admit what you did?" Sun Mei'er asked as she glared at her son sharply. "We raised you and taught you to be a responsible man, Xiao'er. If you really had an affair with You Han, then you must have the courage to admit your own actions, or we will be very disappointed in you."
Ying Feng didn't say anything, but he kept staring at his son with a darkened face as he waited for his confession.
"I'm sorry, Father, Mother. But that-"

"Stop it, Xiao'er." Sun Mei'er interrupted Ying Xiao by shaking her head. "I don't want to hear any excuses from you; I just want to hear your answer as to whether you had an affair with You Han or not."
After hearing that, Ying Xiao stopped defending himself and lowered his face, nodding to his parents. "Yes, I did have an affair with You Han."

The two of them let out heavy sighs after hearing Ying Xiao's answer, and Sun Mei'er then looked at Wei Jiang again before agreeing to his request. "Since Xiao'er has admitted it, then we will accept the annulment of our children's engagement, brother Wei.
Although their marriage failed, our two clans have known each other for a long time, so I hope this incident will not ruin our good relationship."

"Don't worry, I'm not that petty, and our clan relationship will never change." Ying Feng and Sun Mei'er felt relieved after they heard that, and Wei Jiang immediately stood up. "I should return to my clan now, especially since my wife has prepared a small banquet to welcome the arrival of the elder Hai Twins, so I have to accompany them."
*Bam*
Ying Xiao was suddenly sent flying and slammed heavily into the stone pillar, causing him to spit out a mouthful of blood. "Cough... Cough..."

"You bastard!" Ying Feng roared furiously at his son. "Your actions have completely tarnished our clan's reputation! If you dare to leave this clan for a single step, you can do so for good. As for your status as the heir of this clan, I will transfer it to your little brother."
After he said that, Ying Feng hurriedly left the main hall. Sun Mei'er looked at her son for a moment before sighing softly, and she rose to her feet before following her husband away.
'Fuck! That damn bitch, You Han! All this happened because of her; I will kill her later!' Ying Xiao then stood up as he wiped the blood off his lips, and he immediately returned to his room.
Unfortunately, Ying Xiao was unaware that You Han had left the Sky Jade Realm, and Zhang Fei had sent her to the Diyu Realm in the form of a Dryad.
"So what about Ying Feng's decision, husband?" Yi Na immediately inquired upon her husband's return to their clan.

Wei Jiang sighed softly as he sat beside his wife. "At first, Ying Feng didn't want to accept it, but Xiao'er eventually admitted his affair with You Han, so Sun Mei'er decided to accept the annulment of their engagement. Anyway, have you asked our daughter about how he could find out about their affair?"

Yi Na's expression changed immediately when her husband asked. "Luan'er told me that she and the others accidentally met a male disciple from the Yin-Yang Pavilion named Zhang Fei [1] while they were hunting owl beasts, and he was the one who revealed their affair to him.

However, you don't have to worry about that, and I have already sternly warned her not to have any further communication with him. After all, they are no different from prostitutes, and the male disciples of that sect must have a lot of women, so I don't want her to fall for that kind of man."
"You're right." Wei Jiang replied with a nod of agreement. Although he didn't hate dual cultivators, he certainly didn't want his only daughter to fall for that kind of man. "Is everything ready?"
Yi Na shook her head at her husband. "Not yet, but everything It will be ready soon, and we can start the small banquet once everything is ready."

After that, Wei Jiang used his senses to check his daughter's room, but he didn't find Wei Luan there. He then remembered Chu Xing, checked her room, and found her sleeping with his daughter. Immediately, he withdrew his senses and went to another area.

In front of a cave, Zhang Fei [1] was deep in thought, thinking of several plans, including the third blood tree demon in the eastern region. However, he then opened his map to search for the location of the Wen Twins, and he found that the two had almost arrived at the Chu Clan along with Qiao Ran and the people from the demon fox group.
'It seems that Huan Jingtian still doesn't know that his clan has been destroyed, and Qiao Fei also doesn't know that her Qiao Clan has submitted to us.'

[I believe Pang Gui should have informed Huan Jingtian about the destruction of the Huan Clan, Master. However, there were so many powerful cultivators in the demon cave, so he and his father did not dare to make any moves.
As for Qiao Fei, that person from the Pang Clan must not have realized that her Qiao Clan had already submitted to you, so she still didn't know anything about the situation within her clan.]

'Yeah, you might be right about that, but I don't need to care about them.' Zhang Fei [1] replied with a nod. 'After all, only Huan Jingtian and Huan Shitian are left of the clan, and they won't be able to do anything to reverse the situation. I'm more concerned about how to get rid of that Tessa, or I won't be able to do anything about the three female demons.'

[Hehehe! I thought Fyr had already fallen for your second clone, and Leora and Eve would also fall for her soon. However, Tessa proved to be a nuisance, and Eve had been wary of her from the start. So what are your plans for her?]

'Hehe.' Zhang Fei [1] laughed with a wicked smile on his face. 'I won't take any action against Tessa for the time being, but I already have a plan for her, which I will implement as soon as we reach our destination.

Although I don't like her character, her female essence is probably as strong or even stronger than Fyr and Eve, and I'll make her completely obedient to me so I can harvest her female essence. In addition, I am anticipating the Twin Amaris' response upon learning about Janette's return, and I hope they will act swiftly to capture You Han, allowing me to initiate my initial plan against them.'
[If you can get the Twin Amaris as your servants, I think your demon rank can reach Earl rank faster.]
*Tap... Tap...*

Hearing the sound of footsteps, Zhang Fei [1] immediately turned his head and saw Mu Lingshu, who walked out of the cave with sleepy eyes. "Why don't you continue sleeping? It's still early now, and we only have one mission left, so you guys can go back to the sect today."
"I'm used to waking up at this time, and I will start my sword training soon.' Mu Lingshu replied as she sat down beside Zhang Fei [1]. "Does that mean you won't return to the sect with us?"
"No." Zhang Fei [1] responded with a shake of the head. "I promised to meet my sister-in-law in the city, so I will go directly to see her after our last mission is completed."
"I see." Mu Lingshu nodded in understanding. "I still can't believe that you actually have connections with the Liu and Chu Clans, and they are powerful clans in their respective regions."

After hearing that, Zhang Fei [1] smiled and turned to face Mu Lingshu. "Actually, I myself never thought that I would be able to get Hua'er, Ying'er, and Qing'er as my wives. In fact, my meeting with them was by chance, but they are my wives now, and I am truly grateful to have them by my side."

"If I were in their shoes, I'm not sure if I could share you with so many women, especially considering that you also have a few partners within our sect." However, Mu Lingshu's expression turned sad before looking up at the dawn sky. "Unfortunately, I will never be able to feel such feelings, especially with my body condition like this, and I will probably never get married in my entire life."

"Why are you so pessimistic?" Zhang Fei [1] then embraced Mu Lingshu's shoulders, causing her heart to flutter, and spoke encouragingly. "The disorder in your body is indeed difficult to cure, but that doesn't mean it can't, so don't ever give up on your condition, okay?"
"Okay." Mu Lingshu hurriedly stood up as she felt uncomfortable with Zhang Fei [1]'s embrace, and he then took out her sword before starting her sword training.

Meanwhile, in a half-black and half-white room, there were two large thrones, one white and the other black. Furthermore, on each throne, there are two women in their early twenties who have completely identical faces without the slightest difference. They are the Amaris Twins, two of the Diyu Realm's 12 rulers.

The white amaris has long white hair along the waist, and her sexy body was flaunted by a long white dress with a slit on the side of her lower dress. Her skin was as white as chalk, her eyes were sharp red, and her breasts were a bit big at D-Cup. She has two white horns on her head, combined with two white wings on her back.

The black Amaris' appearance is completely similar to that of her twin sister, but her entire body is black. However, her expression is much more serious compared to the white Amaris, who look more playful.
Below them, there were several female demons prostrating themselves, and one of them was the dark elf, Ashreth.
However, one of them suddenly informed the Amaris Twins. "My lords, one of my race members has just told me that Janette has returned, and she is in the Dryad Forest now."
