paragraphs: "Are you sure about that, Naeth?" The black Amaris asked with a raised eyebrow, especially since she and her twin sister had been searching for Janette for so long. Unfortunately, their efforts for the past two years had never been successful because she had fled to the human realm, and they could not set foot there under the watchful eyes of the people from the other two realms.

Naeth answered her question with a nod. "I do not know where it came from, but this news has spread quickly in this sub-realm, and I have ordered some of them to go to the Dryad Forest to verify the truth of this news."
The black Amaris then turned to her twin sister. "Do you think someone deliberately spread false news about Janette's return?"

"That is possible." The white Amaris then picked up a white book beside her throne and opened it, and there were so many unusual demon-beast images on every page of the book. When she reached the middle page, she stopped and placed her index finger on a picture of a four-winged white demon bird before using her power.

Instantly, the four-winged white demon bird came out of the page of the book and flew quickly away from the tower. The white Amaris then waved her hand, causing a small cluster of white clouds to rise in front of them, revealing everything the demon bird had seen.

Ashreth and the female demon, who was kneeling on the floor, looked amazed at the white Amaris's ability. The four-winged white demon bird had quickly left their sub-realm to head to the Dryad Forest, arriving there after some time had passed.

In the small cluster of white clouds, the Amaris Twins could see that Janette was indeed in the Dryad Forest, so they immediately ordered Naeth and several other demons to move there as quickly as possible, and they also asked the other demons to return to their respective places.
However, the black Amaris abruptly stopped Ashreth and questioned her. "Aren't you going to report to me about the arrival of that succubi?"
Ashreth smiled wryly at her question, and she then answered the black Amaris. "Forgive me, my Lord. I didn't mean to hide Feltia from you, but -"

"But you want to enjoy that succubi all to yourself, right, my horny servant?" Ashreth shivered at the sharp gaze of the black Amaris' red eyes. "Forget it; I have no interest in that succubi, so you can have her for yourself.
However, it would be best if you went to Zygoz's sub-realm to investigate her background, especially since she is not an ordinary succubi, and her raw strength is far stronger than her race."
"Is there something unusual about Feltia, my lord?" Ashreth asked in confusion.

The black Amaris then waved her hand, and she used the same ability as her twin sister, causing a small black cloud to appear in front of them, which immediately showed Feltia fighting with the demon beasts.

Ashreth looked shocked after she saw Feltia killing so many demon beasts with ease; she had never seen a succubi who could move or fight like her. After all, succubi always fight by modifying some parts of their bodies, especially their wings and tails, but she actually fights like a close-range fighter, which is unusual for her race.
"Do you understand now?"

"Yes, my lord." Ashreth replied with a nod. "In that case, I will go to Lord Zygoz's sub-realm to investigate Feltia's background in person, and I will report everything to you if I find anything suspicious about her."

The black Amaris fell into thought as she looked at Ashreth, who had started to walk away. "If you do find anything suspicious about Feltia, then you must capture and bring her here, and I will use my other abilities to find out her purpose in coming to this sub-realm."
"Yes, my lord."

After Ashreth disappeared from their sight, the black Amaris pulled her twin sister onto her lap before kissing her, which the white Amaris immediately reciprocated. A while later, both of them were completely naked, and their kisses became more intense as they groped each other's bodies.
"What do you think is Feltia's purpose in coming to our sub-realm? Do you think Zygoz deliberately sent her here to spy on us?" The white Amaris inquired after they had stopped their kiss.

"That's impossible; I believe that Zygos would never do such a thing, especially since he is too lazy to fight for the position of the next demon lord." The black Amaris tried to think of other possibilities about Feltia's purpose. "Sigh, I can't guess her purpose, and we can only wait for the results of Ashreth's investigation for now."

"What if we summon Feltia to meet us directly?" The white Amaris then put her arm around her twin sister's neck. "That way, we don't have to waste time, and we can kill her right away if she has bad intentions toward us."

Instead, the black Amaris raised an eyebrow, particularly considering that they had never summoned low-ranked demons to their tower and that summoning Feltia would only incite jealousy among the other demons. "I don't think we need to do that, and Ashreth can deal with her if she finds anything suspicious about her.
Moreover, she's not in our sub-realm right now, and she's out with some of her spies."
"I see." The white Amaris nodded in understanding before kissing her twin sister again, and they quickly began to pleasure each other.

A few hours later, Naeth and several female demons arrived at the Dryad Forest and hurried to meet Lillea in her private room, where they discovered the fake Jannete. "Queen Lillea, my lord ordered us to come here to pick up your daughter, and you better not stop us from bringing her. Otherwise, we will massacre your race's members and eradicate your race entirely from this realm."

Upon hearing that, Lillea wore a worried expression and sighed heavily, immediately agreeing to their request. "All right, you can take my daughter to the Lord Amaris Twins, but I hope you will not disturb my race's lives again after today."
Naeth didn't say anything and ordered some other demons to tie up the fake Janette with a special device, and they immediately took her away from the Dryad forest afterward.

After the Amaris Twins's subordinates left, some senior Dryads came to Lillea and asked about the matter directly, and she spoke to them to calm them down. "You guys don't need to worry about my daughter, because she is fine somewhere else, and the woman they just brought is my fake daughter.
You guys should pretend not to know about this matter and never discuss it outside; otherwise, they might find out the truth, which would endanger our race."
"Yes, my queen."
"All right, you can go now." After they left, Lillea was surprised by the sudden appearance of a man she did not expect, and she wanted to stand up to greet him, but he immediately stopped her.
"That human kid must have told you about me, right?"

"Yes." Lillea gave the man a nod and asked him back. "What exactly is your purpose in pretending to disappear, Lord Oz? Zhang Fei told me some things from your previous conversation, but I am a native of this realm, so I understand some things better than he does, and I believe that you have other purposes in doing this."
"Haha!" Oz laughed at that. "You do have good observation, Lillea. You're right, I do have another reason, which is related to my predecessor."
"The first demon lord?"

"Yes." Oz nodded to Lillea before explaining. "For thousands of years, I have always felt strange about the disappearance of my predecessor. I have tried to find traces of him for that long, but I have never managed to find any clues about it. After contemplating the matter for a considerable amount of time, I came to the conclusion that one of his twelve aides was a traitor.
Zygoz also agreed with me, so we immediately planned for my disappearance."

"Traitor among the twelve?" Lillea softly muttered and thought about it before asking Oz. "Do you think that Virgil is the traitor? After all, she is the second-oldest after Zygoz, and she also has the power of light."

"No." Oz immediately denied this. "Virgil does have the power of light, but I fully believe that she is not the traitor. Even so, I cannot be sure who among them is the traitor, but I might be able to find out the truth after one of them ascends to become the third demon lord. Unfortunately, it won't happen anytime soon, especially now that their powers are equal."
Lillea agreed with that. "So, which one of them do you suspect is the traitor?"

"The white Amaris." Lillea raised her eyebrows upon hearing Oz's answer. "She is the second demon who has the power of light, but she never used it in front of anyone, including her twin sister. Unfortunately, I have not found any evidence of her involvement in the disappearance of my predecessor, so I have not made any moves against her."
Oz's words made Lillea realize several things. "Is that why you met Zhang Fei before he left for the Amaris Twins's sub-realm?"

"Yeah." However, Oz let out a heavy sigh before speaking again. "Actually, I hope that the human kid is willing to become the next demon lord, especially since I'm tired of everything. Unfortunately, this realm is too small for him, and his ambition is too high, so he rejected my request. "

"Haha." Lillea laughed after hearing that. "In fact, Zhang Fei could easily take over this Diyu Realm, especially since he had many powerful humans on his side. However, this realm and all the demons living in it were of little use to him, so he was not interested in it, and he is more interested in taking over the other demon realm."

Naturally, Oz still remembers that. "That kid had already told me about the other demon realm, and he also told me that my strength was only equal to that of the demons in that realm's duke and duchess ranks.
Honestly, I want to ask him to send me there, but I can't rest assured before I find the traitor, so I suppressed my desire to go there, and I will stay here until I succeed in finding the truth."

Lillea wasn't too surprised by Oz's answer, especially since she knew that he also had great ambitions. However, his ambition wasn't to rule or subdue a realm; his ambition was to become the strongest of all demons, so it was only natural that he wanted to go to other demon realms to challenge all the demons there.

"Perhaps Zhang Fei can help you find out the truth, especially since he himself already has some plans against the Amaris Twins. However, I won't say anything about his plans, and you can wait for him to carry them out, which has already begun."

"Regarding that kid's plans, how did he manage to produce such a perfect clone of your daughter?" Although I have never seen the demon lord seed with my own eyes, I am quite familiar with its aura, and the aura I sensed from your daughter was different from the original aura of the seed, so I knew that she was not the real one." However, Lillea chose not to answer Oz's questions about it, leaving him feeling helpless.
"Do you think his plan for the Twin Amaris will work?"

"One hundred percent." Lillea answered with a confident look. "I've been with Zhang Fei for a while now, so I know more or less about his abilities, and I'm confident that the Amaris Twins will completely submit to him later. Therefore, there's no need for you to overthink this situation; let him handle everything, and we'll know whether the white Amaris is the traitor or not.
However, the black Amaris is very sensitive, and she might have already noticed the presence of his clone in their sub-realm, so I think you should do something to help him."

"Do you think I haven't thought about that?" Oz asked with a faint smile. "After all, I am the second demon lord, remember? I anticipated that the black Amaris would notice and suspect the presence of his clone in her sub-realm, so I've taken some precautions to ensure she won't find anything suspicious about his clone."
After they talked about a few other things, Oz immediately left the Dryad Forest, and Lillea chose to rest while waiting for Zhang Fei to pick her up.

chapters.title: Chapter 248 : Village And Valley
paragraphs: When the Wen Twins and Qiao Ran arrived at the Chu Clan, Zhang Fei immediately brought them into the training space, where they handed him everything they had brought from the Qiao and Huan Clans. He then stored them in the system inventory and took Mei Xiang out of the portable mansion to train with the others; otherwise, she would be the weakest among them and be of no use to him.
Moments later, Mei informed Zhang Fei. [I will show you the results now, master.]
Red Jewels: 450,000,000
Green Jewels: 20,000,000
Blue Jewels: 1,500,000
Lower Grade Beast Core: 25,000
Intermediate Grade Beast Core: 5,500
Advanced Grade Beast Core: 1,500

'Hahahaha !' Zhang Fei inwardly laughed after he read that. 'Hey! Major clans, such as the Huan and Qiao clans, are indeed different! They are truly rich! Moreover, the number of beast cores they have stored is also quite large, so I can buy some beast techniques.'
[Which beast techniques do you want to buy, Master?]

'I haven't thought about it yet, and I'll pick a few later.' Zhang Fei then said to all his women. "Anyway, I'll go out first to get the third blood demon tree, and I will take it to the Diyu Realm afterward."

After that, Zhang Fei left the training space and used his Nine Cloud Steps to go to the eastern region, but it took him quite a bit of time. He even had to rest several times because the distance between the two regions was too far apart—two times further than when he went to the Central Region—and he did not want to continue relying on Qi recovery pills.

Liu Hua and the others immediately resumed their training, while Qiao Ran and Mei Xiang found it overwhelming to train at the second gravity level. After all, they had never trained at the first level, and the other women let them struggle on their own, especially since all of them had fully adapted to the first level, so they didn't want to waste time waiting for them.

After a lengthy flight, Zhang Fei [1] and the six women reached a village near a remote valley, where Xia Qianqian inquired. "Is this really the location of our last mission, brother? This village is really creepy, and I have a bad feeling about these people."
"I feel the same way, Fei." Luo Yu observed the expressionless faces of the villagers, making them appear as if they were living dead.
Gu Yan shuddered as she sensed the villagers' gazes on her. "Hey, guys! Somehow I feel like they want to eat us alive, so it would be better if we left this village as soon as possible."

"Why are you acting like a scaredy cat?" Ning Xiang asked Gu Yan as she shook her head. "These villagers' cultivation is far below ours, and they won't be able to do anything to us, so you shouldn't be this afraid of them."

Du Yuan nodded in agreement with Ning Xiang. "However, there is indeed something strange about these people, but I don't feel any negative aura from them, so I think it's just their character that is strange, especially since this village is too remote and they probably rarely get visitors."

Unlike them, Mu Lingshu did not say anything about the village's situation, but her expression clearly showed that she was fully alert to the villagers, and her right hand tightly gripped the hilt of her sword.

Zhang Fei [1] also felt that there was something strange about the villagers, and he had already ordered Mei to examine them, but she couldn't detect any significant strangeness from them other than their strange expressions.

Zhang Fei [1] then led them to question the villagers about their mission, but none of them wanted to answer. Instead, they simply shook their heads in response to each question, which made them feel even more weird about their behavior.

Ultimately, Zhang Fei [1] and his companions made the decision to depart from the village and explore deeper into the valley, particularly because their mission's objective lay there. However, the villagers kept looking at them from a distance, and their expressions turned hideous; even their mouths kept muttering an unusual language.
When they arrived in the valley, the women became frightened when they saw many human and beast skeletons lying in every area they passed, making the area look like an abandoned graveyard.
"What the hell is going on with this place? How can there be so many skeletons here?" Gu Yan asked as she hugged Zhang Fei [1]'s right arm, and he could feel that her body was shaking quite hard.

On the left side, Xia Qianqiang also tightly hugged Zhang Fei [1]'s left arm, feeling as frightened as Gu Yan. She immediately closed her eyes, as the scene in the area made her feel extremely uncomfortable.
Meanwhile, Du Xuan and Ning Xiang squatted beside the pile of skeletons and examined them; they discovered that some of them were new skeletons, causing them to frown. "Fei! Look at these skeletons!

Zhang Fei [1] promptly brought the two women, with Mu Lingshu trailing behind them, to approach them. They both scowled upon seeing the new skeleton remains. "These people haven't died too long, but I don't understand how their skeletons could be this clean, and there are no traces of injuries or blood on them as if they were skinned clean."
"Could there be carnivorous beasts in this valley?" Mu Lingshu inquired after observing those skeletons.

"That could be true." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement and then looked towards the heart of the valley, checking the location with his map. However, he didn't see any red dots there, indicating that there was no life in that area. "If I think about it, I don't think it was carnivorous beasts that did this to these people, and I suspect that it was the villagers who did it to them."
"Huh?" The six women looked at Zhang Fei [1] with a shocked expression. "Do you think they are cannibals?"

"I don't dare to say for sure, and it's just my guess for now." Zhang Fei [1] then turned around and looked towards the village. "Honestly, I've never met such a person before, but I've heard that people like them exist in this world, and their strange expressions make me think so. Anyway, we don't need to think about them; if they want to do something like that to us, we simply have to kill them."
"So what should we do now? Are we going to wait here?" Mu Lingshu asked this.

"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] then pointed towards the heart of the valley. "I have a feeling that our last mission is related to that village and the villagers, but I'm sure they won't act in broad daylight, especially since we are stronger than them. That's why we will rest here until nightfall, and they might make their move by then."

Although some of them did not like Zhang Fei [1]'s idea, especially Gu Yan and Xia Qianqian, they still agreed with him and rushed to the heart of the valley. Since they had a lot of free time, Ning Xiang, Du Yuan, Luo Yu, and Mu Lingshu decided to spar with each other, especially since the place was very spacious.
Meanwhile, Naeth and the others had brought the fake Janette, who was still unconscious, to the Amaris Twins, and the two immediately ordered them to leave the tower afterward.

"Hmm? This aura is really that of a demon lord seed." The Black Amaris then pressed against Janette's chest to examine her, but she soon frowned. "This is really weird; I can't feel the presence of the seed in her body."

"Could it be that the demon lord seed has completely merged with her body?" The white Amaris asked as her fingers traced along the fake Janette's front body. "After all, this little dryad was born from Lillea and the seed, and she's over 500 years old now, so I think the seed has completely merged with her body."

"Yeah, you might be right about that." The black Amaris then kissed the fake Janette and absorbed her demon power, but she didn't realize that she was also absorbing something else, which was intentionally planted by Zhang Fei in her body. However, it would not have an immediate effect on her, especially since he didn't want her to notice it. "Hehehe!
Her demon power is indeed much stronger than that of other Dryads, including Lillea, and it must be due to the effect of the demon lord seed, which we can absorb in turn to make us stronger."

"Yes." The white Amaris nodded before kissing the fake Janette before absorbing her demon power; she also unknowingly absorbed the thing that Zhang Fei had planted in her body. "The demon lord seed is indeed amazing, but we can't achieve the maximum effect because it has merged with her body. Therefore, I believe we should begin our search for the remaining nine seeds.
That way, our power will be able to surpass the other rulers, and we will become the third demon lord."

After hearing that, the black Amaris let out a heavy sigh, as she herself really wanted to get one of the nine demon lord seeds. "Unfortunately, we and the other rulers have searched for them all over our realm, but we've never found a single one of them. Moreover, Rose told me that Lillea found one not because she was looking for it, but because the seed summoned her to its location by itself."

"Do you think we should forget about those demon seeds?" After considering her twin sister's words, the white Amaris inquired. "Unlike us and the other rulers, Lillea had no intention of looking for the seed; as a result, it chose her and summoned her to its location. That's why we should forget about them, and one of them might summon us if we have no desire to obtain it."

"Perhaps you're right about that, so we don't have to keep thinking about them." The black Amaris then turned to the fake Janette. "Moreover, we have this Dryad now, and we have to make the best use of the demon seed inside her body, so the other rulers won't be able to stop us if we want to rise to become the next demon lord in the future."
The white Amaris faintly smiled as she gazed at the fake Janette, mulling over an idea without her twin sister's knowledge. "Anyway, what about Ashreth? Has she contacted you?"

"Not yet." With a shake of her head, the black Amaris answered her question. "We don't know where Feltia lives in Zygoz's sub-realm, and his sub-realm is a bit bigger than ours, so she must still be looking for her living place. Why do you ask about that? Are you still thinking about summoning that succubi to this tower?"

"Yes." The white Amaris didn't deny it. "We both know that Feltia is far different than the other succubi, so I'm sure her demon power must be strong enough to increase our strength. That's why I considered summoning her here, so we could equally share her demon power."

The black Amaris nodded in understanding. "All right, we will wait for Feltia to return to our sub-realm, and I will immediately ask Ashreth to bring her here regardless of whether she has bad intentions or not, so we can absorb her demon power for ourselves."
"In that case, I'll go check something first, and I'll be back in a few days."

After her twin sister left their room, the black Amaris immediately woke up the fake Janette, causing her panic and fear when she saw her. ' Ugh! Where am I? Who is this woman? Why does she look so scary?
The black Amaris smiled at her expression and grabbed her cheeks. "Are you afraid of me, young Dryad?"

'Dryads? What did she mean by that?' Zhang Fei deliberately did not manipulate her mind, so the fake Janette or You Han still had her own memories intact, even though she had turned into a Dryad. She became increasingly panicked as she tried to speak, especially since no words came out of her mouth. 'What happened to me? Why can't I talk?"

"Hmm?" The black Amaris raised her eyebrows when she saw the fake Janette unable to speak, so she opened her mouth. "Oh? I don't know what happened to you, but you no longer have a tongue and vocal cords, so it's no wonder you can't speak. Anyway, you don't have to be afraid of me, especially since I won't kill you, and I might treat you well as long as you can serve me properly."

sentences.text: When the Wen Twins and Qiao Ran arrived at the Chu Clan, Zhang Fei immediately brought them into the training space, where they handed him everything they had brought from the Qiao and Huan Clans.
He then stored them in the system inventory and took Mei Xiang out of the portable mansion to train with the others; otherwise, she would be the weakest among them and be of no use to him.
Moments later, Mei informed Zhang Fei.
[I will show you the results now, master.]
Red Jewels: 450,000,000
Green Jewels: 20,000,000
Blue Jewels: 1,500,000
Lower Grade Beast Core: 25,000
Intermediate Grade Beast Core: 5,500
Advanced Grade Beast Core: 1,500
'Hahahaha !' Zhang Fei inwardly laughed after he read that. 'Hey!
Major clans, such as the Huan and Qiao clans, are indeed different!
They are truly rich!
Moreover, the number of beast cores they have stored is also quite large, so I can buy some beast techniques.'
[Which beast techniques do you want to buy, Master?]
'I haven't thought about it yet, and I'll pick a few later.' Zhang Fei then said to all his women.
"Anyway, I'll go out first to get the third blood demon tree, and I will take it to the Diyu Realm afterward."
After that, Zhang Fei left the training space and used his Nine Cloud Steps to go to the eastern region, but it took him quite a bit of time.

He even had to rest several times because the distance between the two regions was too far apart—two times further than when he went to the Central Region—and he did not want to continue relying on Qi recovery pills.
Liu Hua and the others immediately resumed their training, while Qiao Ran and Mei Xiang found it overwhelming to train at the second gravity level.

After all, they had never trained at the first level, and the other women let them struggle on their own, especially since all of them had fully adapted to the first level, so they didn't want to waste time waiting for them.
After a lengthy flight, Zhang Fei [1] and the six women reached a village near a remote valley, where Xia Qianqian inquired.
"Is this really the location of our last mission, brother?
This village is really creepy, and I have a bad feeling about these people."
"I feel the same way, Fei." Luo Yu observed the expressionless faces of the villagers, making them appear as if they were living dead.
Gu Yan shuddered as she sensed the villagers' gazes on her.
"Hey, guys!
Somehow I feel like they want to eat us alive, so it would be better if we left this village as soon as possible."
"Why are you acting like a scaredy cat?" Ning Xiang asked Gu Yan as she shook her head.
"These villagers' cultivation is far below ours, and they won't be able to do anything to us, so you shouldn't be this afraid of them."
Du Yuan nodded in agreement with Ning Xiang.

"However, there is indeed something strange about these people, but I don't feel any negative aura from them, so I think it's just their character that is strange, especially since this village is too remote and they probably rarely get visitors."

Unlike them, Mu Lingshu did not say anything about the village's situation, but her expression clearly showed that she was fully alert to the villagers, and her right hand tightly gripped the hilt of her sword.

Zhang Fei [1] also felt that there was something strange about the villagers, and he had already ordered Mei to examine them, but she couldn't detect any significant strangeness from them other than their strange expressions.
Zhang Fei [1] then led them to question the villagers about their mission, but none of them wanted to answer.
Instead, they simply shook their heads in response to each question, which made them feel even more weird about their behavior.
Ultimately, Zhang Fei [1] and his companions made the decision to depart from the village and explore deeper into the valley, particularly because their mission's objective lay there.
However, the villagers kept looking at them from a distance, and their expressions turned hideous; even their mouths kept muttering an unusual language.
When they arrived in the valley, the women became frightened when they saw many human and beast skeletons lying in every area they passed, making the area look like an abandoned graveyard.
"What the hell is going on with this place?
How can there be so many skeletons here?" Gu Yan asked as she hugged Zhang Fei [1]'s right arm, and he could feel that her body was shaking quite hard.
On the left side, Xia Qianqiang also tightly hugged Zhang Fei [1]'s left arm, feeling as frightened as Gu Yan.
She immediately closed her eyes, as the scene in the area made her feel extremely uncomfortable.
Meanwhile, Du Xuan and Ning Xiang squatted beside the pile of skeletons and examined them; they discovered that some of them were new skeletons, causing them to frown.
"Fei!
Look at these skeletons!
Zhang Fei [1] promptly brought the two women, with Mu Lingshu trailing behind them, to approach them.
They both scowled upon seeing the new skeleton remains.
"These people haven't died too long, but I don't understand how their skeletons could be this clean, and there are no traces of injuries or blood on them as if they were skinned clean."
"Could there be carnivorous beasts in this valley?" Mu Lingshu inquired after observing those skeletons.
"That could be true." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement and then looked towards the heart of the valley, checking the location with his map.
However, he didn't see any red dots there, indicating that there was no life in that area.
"If I think about it, I don't think it was carnivorous beasts that did this to these people, and I suspect that it was the villagers who did it to them."
"Huh?" The six women looked at Zhang Fei [1] with a shocked expression.
"Do you think they are cannibals?"
"I don't dare to say for sure, and it's just my guess for now." Zhang Fei [1] then turned around and looked towards the village.
"Honestly, I've never met such a person before, but I've heard that people like them exist in this world, and their strange expressions make me think so.
Anyway, we don't need to think about them; if they want to do something like that to us, we simply have to kill them."
"So what should we do now?
Are we going to wait here?" Mu Lingshu asked this.
"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] then pointed towards the heart of the valley.
"I have a feeling that our last mission is related to that village and the villagers, but I'm sure they won't act in broad daylight, especially since we are stronger than them.
That's why we will rest here until nightfall, and they might make their move by then."
Although some of them did not like Zhang Fei [1]'s idea, especially Gu Yan and Xia Qianqian, they still agreed with him and rushed to the heart of the valley.
Since they had a lot of free time, Ning Xiang, Du Yuan, Luo Yu, and Mu Lingshu decided to spar with each other, especially since the place was very spacious.
Meanwhile, Naeth and the others had brought the fake Janette, who was still unconscious, to the Amaris Twins, and the two immediately ordered them to leave the tower afterward.
"Hmm?
This aura is really that of a demon lord seed." The Black Amaris then pressed against Janette's chest to examine her, but she soon frowned.
"This is really weird; I can't feel the presence of the seed in her body."
"Could it be that the demon lord seed has completely merged with her body?" The white Amaris asked as her fingers traced along the fake Janette's front body.
"After all, this little dryad was born from Lillea and the seed, and she's over 500 years old now, so I think the seed has completely merged with her body."

"Yeah, you might be right about that." The black Amaris then kissed the fake Janette and absorbed her demon power, but she didn't realize that she was also absorbing something else, which was intentionally planted by Zhang Fei in her body.
However, it would not have an immediate effect on her, especially since he didn't want her to notice it.
"Hehehe!
Her demon power is indeed much stronger than that of other Dryads, including Lillea, and it must be due to the effect of the demon lord seed, which we can absorb in turn to make us stronger."
"Yes." The white Amaris nodded before kissing the fake Janette before absorbing her demon power; she also unknowingly absorbed the thing that Zhang Fei had planted in her body.
"The demon lord seed is indeed amazing, but we can't achieve the maximum effect because it has merged with her body.
Therefore, I believe we should begin our search for the remaining nine seeds.
That way, our power will be able to surpass the other rulers, and we will become the third demon lord."
After hearing that, the black Amaris let out a heavy sigh, as she herself really wanted to get one of the nine demon lord seeds.
"Unfortunately, we and the other rulers have searched for them all over our realm, but we've never found a single one of them.
Moreover, Rose told me that Lillea found one not because she was looking for it, but because the seed summoned her to its location by itself."
"Do you think we should forget about those demon seeds?" After considering her twin sister's words, the white Amaris inquired.
"Unlike us and the other rulers, Lillea had no intention of looking for the seed; as a result, it chose her and summoned her to its location.
That's why we should forget about them, and one of them might summon us if we have no desire to obtain it."
"Perhaps you're right about that, so we don't have to keep thinking about them." The black Amaris then turned to the fake Janette.

"Moreover, we have this Dryad now, and we have to make the best use of the demon seed inside her body, so the other rulers won't be able to stop us if we want to rise to become the next demon lord in the future."
The white Amaris faintly smiled as she gazed at the fake Janette, mulling over an idea without her twin sister's knowledge.
"Anyway, what about Ashreth?
Has she contacted you?"
"Not yet." With a shake of her head, the black Amaris answered her question.
"We don't know where Feltia lives in Zygoz's sub-realm, and his sub-realm is a bit bigger than ours, so she must still be looking for her living place.
Why do you ask about that?
Are you still thinking about summoning that succubi to this tower?"
"Yes." The white Amaris didn't deny it.
"We both know that Feltia is far different than the other succubi, so I'm sure her demon power must be strong enough to increase our strength.
That's why I considered summoning her here, so we could equally share her demon power."
The black Amaris nodded in understanding.

"All right, we will wait for Feltia to return to our sub-realm, and I will immediately ask Ashreth to bring her here regardless of whether she has bad intentions or not, so we can absorb her demon power for ourselves."
"In that case, I'll go check something first, and I'll be back in a few days."
After her twin sister left their room, the black Amaris immediately woke up the fake Janette, causing her panic and fear when she saw her. ' Ugh!
Where am I?
Who is this woman?
Why does she look so scary?
The black Amaris smiled at her expression and grabbed her cheeks.
"Are you afraid of me, young Dryad?"
'Dryads?
What did she mean by that?' Zhang Fei deliberately did not manipulate her mind, so the fake Janette or You Han still had her own memories intact, even though she had turned into a Dryad.
She became increasingly panicked as she tried to speak, especially since no words came out of her mouth. 'What happened to me?
Why can't I talk?"
"Hmm?" The black Amaris raised her eyebrows when she saw the fake Janette unable to speak, so she opened her mouth.
"Oh?
I don't know what happened to you, but you no longer have a tongue and vocal cords, so it's no wonder you can't speak.
Anyway, you don't have to be afraid of me, especially since I won't kill you, and I might treat you well as long as you can serve me properly."

chapters.title: Chapter 249: Meridian Rupturing Pill
paragraphs: The fake Janette's mouth kept opening and closing because she wanted to say something to the black Amaris, but no words came out without vocal cords. 'Damn it! This must be the work of that bastard prostitute! Where am I, really? Who is this woman?'

"It's okay; you don't have to say anything. You just have to serve me well, and everything will be fine." With a strong shake of her head, the fake Janette refused, but the black Amaris immediately used her illusion on her. "Since my sister isn't here, I'll have some fun with you first."
Afterwards, the black Amaris strips the fake Janette naked, and she begins to have fun with her as she slowly absorbs her demon power.

Unfortunately, the black Amaris is still unaware of the thing Zhang Fei left inside the fake Janette's body, and she continues to absorb it along with her demon power, which gradually makes her fall into his trap.

The white amaris had reached a remote location in her area, and she swiftly entered a completely white building before sprinting towards the deepest part of the place. Inside, a golden trumpet floated in the center of the room, while a portal was embedded in the back wall. "Luckily, my twin sister never liked bright areas, and she also completely trusted me, so she never investigated my area.
Otherwise, she would have found this place long ago, and my plan is bound to be a mess."
After that, the white Amaris grabbed the trumpet and played it, and the portal on the back wall began to light up along with the sound of the trumpet.

Minutes later, a man walked out of the portal, wearing shiny golden-white armor and a golden-white helmet covering his head. He has long golden hair, two golden eyes, and two white wings on his back. "Why did you summon me, Amaris?"

"Ha ha." The white Amaris laughed before telling him. "Theo, my sister and I have already obtained Janette, and the demon lord seed is truly inside her body. Unfortunately, it has already completely merged with her body, so we cannot get the maximum effect."

"My higher-ups have been expecting that, especially since the demon lord seed has been in her body for too long. Nevertheless, her demon power should enable you two to outperform the other demon rulers.

Therefore, absorb her demon power as soon as possible, and we will begin our plan to invade the Diyu Realm once again." Theo then took out a small golden dagger and handed it to the white Amaris, who immediately accepted it and put it away. "Your twin sister doesn't have the power of light like you, so she is useless to us.
That's why we must get rid of her as soon as you two ascend to the throne as demon lords, or she might cause us trouble in the future."

"I know." The white Amaris answered Theo with a faint smile. "Unfortunately, we still haven't found Oz's whereabouts, even though we've been trying to find him for so long, so we think he may have left this realm and gone to the human realm. If he's still alive, he may return to this realm one day, and we won't be able to defeat him, which would mess up our plans."

"Regarding Oz, my higher-ups are still searching for his whereabouts in the human realm together with the people from the Xian Clan, but they haven't managed to find him yet." Theo suddenly remembered something and took out a golden apple before giving it to her. "This fruit will strengthen your light power even more, allowing you to overcome your twin sister's dark power."
As the white Amaris joyfully consumed the golden apple, a bright white light engulfed her body, and she could feel her light power had significantly increased.
Since Theo was wearing a helmet, the white Amaris didn't notice the strange smile on his face. He turned around and disappeared into the portal, which immediately closed on its own.

"Haha!" The white Amaris laughed so loudly as she raised both of her fists up, making her laughter echo throughout the place. For so many years, I have been trying to surpass my twin sister, and I have surpassed her now. This way, she will no longer be able to dominate me, and I will be the one dominating her from now on."
After that, the white Amaris immediately left the area, but she didn't immediately return to her tower, choosing to go to another area instead.

After he used the Nine Cloud Steps again and again, Zhang Fei finally arrived at a small island in the middle of the sea in the eastern region, which was where the third blood demon tree was hidden. "Phew! Luckily, I have my movement technique, or it would have taken me a few days to get here."
[Unfortunately, your Nine Cloud Steps have not yet advanced to level three, Master. Otherwise, you could travel 200 km in one fell swoop.]

"Well, it doesn't matter, especially since this realm isn't that big." Zhang Fei then walked towards the forest on the isolated island, but he momentarily raised his eyebrows before smiling faintly, especially since he felt someone's killing intent directed at him, and he naturally already knew the identity of its owner. 'Hey, Boitata! Get ready to face that person.'
[Humph! That guy is just a weak ant, and I can crush him easily.]

'Why are you always acting so arrogant? You are indeed powerful in this realm, but you won't be as strong as you are now if we go to other realms in the future, so you should start learning to change your attitude.' Zhang Fei then stopped walking as soon as the owner of the killing intent stepped out of the forest. "Hey! I expected you to wait for me in this place, Pang Gui."

Pang Gui glared at Zhang Fei as he released his aura to suppress him, but Boitata certainly wouldn't let that happen. To protect her husband, she released her aura from within the beast's space, causing their enemy to frown in response. "So you are Zhang Fei, who repeatedly thwarted Pang Hong's plans, huh? Does that mean you were also the one who destroyed the Huan Clan? How did you find this place?"

"Do you think I will tell you how I found this place?" Zhang Fei asked back while shaking his head. "However, you are right that I was the one who destroyed the Huan Clan, and I will also destroy your Pang Clan sooner or later."

"Hahaha!" Pang Gui laughed out loud after hearing that. "You are bragging too much, Brat! Do you think you can destroy my Pang Clan? You might be able to defeat and capture Pang Hong, but I and the others are different from him. We still have some of our ancestors; even a strong cultivator like Chang Wuhen wouldn't dare say that kind of thing."

"I don't know Chang Wuhen, nor do I know her true strength, so I won't comment on her. However, I am different from her, and I have great confidence in myself." Pang Gui raised his eyebrows as Zhang Fei smiled faintly. "Anyway, you are too arrogant, and you seem to have forgotten something important. Do you think I can destroy the Huan Clan with my current strength?"
Pang Gui's heart jolted after hearing Zhang Fei's question, and he just remembered Boitata's existence beside him. 'Crap! I totally forgot about that woman.'
"Too late!"

"Guah!" Pang Gui immediately fell to the ground as soon as Boitata came out of the beast space and pressed him down, and then he stomped her foot on his head forcefully, causing the ground beneath him to cave in. 'Shit! This woman's as strong as Pang De!'

"Do you still think that I can't do something to your Pang Clan?" Zhang Fei questioned Pang Gui as he moved next to him and squatted down. "I will not kill you at this time, as I am still unable to confront your clan directly. Instead, I will use you as my new pawn, just like I did with Pang Hong."
'Shit! I'm too foolish to have forgotten about this woman!' Pang Gui could only curse in his heart as he lay helplessly beneath Boitata's feet.

Zhang Fei then touched his head, applied his demon slave mark, and utilized his memory manipulation ability. However, Zhang Fei refrained from using his body modification on him, particularly because he needed him to perform another task.

A while later, Pang Gui had become completely loyal to Zhang Fei, so Boitata immediately released him from her pressure, and he kneeled on one knee in front of them. "Is there anything I can do for you, Master?"

"Pang De ordered you to recruit several clans in this region as vassals of your clan, right?" Pang Gui nodded and explained the identity of each clan to Zhang Fei, and he also told him about the strength of their main members. 'Is there anything I can use against those people in the item shop, Mei?'

[There is an item you can use on them, and they will suffer for quite a long time before they die, but it probably won't have much effect on cultivators in the Heaven Realm and above, Master. Do you want to buy it?]

Zhang Fei himself couldn't care about the fate of those people, especially since he didn't know them. Furthermore, they were conspiring with the Pang Clan to cause trouble in the Sky Jade Realm, which could potentially harm his closest people. Therefore, he made the decision to take action against them first. 'Yes, you can buy some, and I will use this guy to kill all the people from those clans.'
[All right.]
{You got meridian rupturing pill x100}
{1,000,000 red jewels have been deducted from your balance.}
[Meridian Rupturing Pill: This pill gradually causes the meridians of the person who takes it to rupture, which will turn them into a criple.]

'Hey! Although the effect won't be instantaneous, it's still very good, and the people from those clans will suffer as their cultivation slowly disappears before becoming cripples. Perhaps they will eventually commit suicide, thereby saving me the time and effort of dealing with them.' Zhang Fei then took those pills, gave them to Pang Gui, and instructed him to use them immediately on those people.
After Pang Gui left, Boitata immediately entered the beast space again, especially since Zhang Fei intended to take the third blood demon tree, and he had always felt uneasy with the demon miasma.

As he walked into the forest, Zhang Fei continued to absorb all the demon miasma that filled the area until he arrived at the location of the third blood tree demon, and he immediately pulled it out before leaving for the Diyu Realm.

Once he arrived there, Zhang Fei went to see Millia, who immediately took him to the Dryad Garden, and he saw that the demon miasma there was much thicker, especially since there were two blood demon trees there. "Does this miasma have any negative effects on you and all these plants?"
"No." Millia answered with a shake of her head. "This miasma doesn't have any negative effects, but I still don't know about its benefits, especially since no one can absorb it, including my queen."
"Hmm? That's weird." Zhang Fei muttered softly as he absorbed all the demon miasma, making the garden clean again, but Millia looked at him in shock. "Haha! Why are you looking at me like that?"
"How did you absorb the demon miasma? Didn't it have any effect on you?" Millia asked as she looked at Zhang Fei with a curious gaze.

Instead, Zhang Fei gave a faint smile and pulled Millia closer before initiating a kiss, startling her. However, she did not refuse it, especially since they had kissed before. "Are you worried about me?"
Millia pouted her lips and moved away from Zhang Fei immediately. "You are my princess's man, and my queen also likes you; therefore, I don't want anything to happen to you."
"Don't worry, the demon miasma has no effect on me." Zhang Fei then planted the third blood demon tree there, and he immediately went to meet Lillea.
Seeing his departure, Millia rubbed her own lips, and a sweet smile appeared on her mature face before leaving the garden.

"Earlier, Oz came here to see me, and he told me a few things." Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that, and Lillea told him about her conversation with the second demon lord, causing him to be even more surprised. "What about your plans for the Amaris Twins?"

"My plan has begun, but it still needs some time to run perfectly, or they will realize the trap I placed inside You Han's body, and everything will fail miserably." Lillea nodded in understanding at Zhang Fei. "Anyway, I didn't expect that the white Amaris also had the power of light, and I think Oz's guess about her might be right.
However, I don't want to think about her for now, and I will take care of her when the time comes. Anyway, let's go back to the training space, so you can protect your people better."
"All right."

I'm too foolish to have forgotten about this woman!' Pang Gui could only curse in his heart as he lay helplessly beneath Boitata's feet.
Zhang Fei then touched his head, applied his demon slave mark, and utilized his memory manipulation ability.
However, Zhang Fei refrained from using his body modification on him, particularly because he needed him to perform another task.
A while later, Pang Gui had become completely loyal to Zhang Fei, so Boitata immediately released him from her pressure, and he kneeled on one knee in front of them.
"Is there anything I can do for you, Master?"

"Pang De ordered you to recruit several clans in this region as vassals of your clan, right?" Pang Gui nodded and explained the identity of each clan to Zhang Fei, and he also told him about the strength of their main members. 'Is there anything I can use against those people in the item shop, Mei?'
[There is an item you can use on them, and they will suffer for quite a long time before they die, but it probably won't have much effect on cultivators in the Heaven Realm and above, Master.
Do you want to buy it?]
Zhang Fei himself couldn't care about the fate of those people, especially since he didn't know them.
Furthermore, they were conspiring with the Pang Clan to cause trouble in the Sky Jade Realm, which could potentially harm his closest people.
Therefore, he made the decision to take action against them first. 'Yes, you can buy some, and I will use this guy to kill all the people from those clans.'

{1,000,000 red jewels have been deducted from your balance.}
[Meridian Rupturing Pill: This pill gradually causes the meridians of the person who takes it to rupture, which will turn them into a criple.]
'Hey!
Although the effect won't be instantaneous, it's still very good, and the people from those clans will suffer as their cultivation slowly disappears before becoming cripples.

Perhaps they will eventually commit suicide, thereby saving me the time and effort of dealing with them.' Zhang Fei then took those pills, gave them to Pang Gui, and instructed him to use them immediately on those people.
After Pang Gui left, Boitata immediately entered the beast space again, especially since Zhang Fei intended to take the third blood demon tree, and he had always felt uneasy with the demon miasma.

As he walked into the forest, Zhang Fei continued to absorb all the demon miasma that filled the area until he arrived at the location of the third blood tree demon, and he immediately pulled it out before leaving for the Diyu Realm.

Once he arrived there, Zhang Fei went to see Millia, who immediately took him to the Dryad Garden, and he saw that the demon miasma there was much thicker, especially since there were two blood demon trees there.
"Does this miasma have any negative effects on you and all these plants?"
"No." Millia answered with a shake of her head.
"This miasma doesn't have any negative effects, but I still don't know about its benefits, especially since no one can absorb it, including my queen."
"Hmm?
That's weird." Zhang Fei muttered softly as he absorbed all the demon miasma, making the garden clean again, but Millia looked at him in shock.
"Haha!
Why are you looking at me like that?"
"How did you absorb the demon miasma?
Didn't it have any effect on you?" Millia asked as she looked at Zhang Fei with a curious gaze.
Instead, Zhang Fei gave a faint smile and pulled Millia closer before initiating a kiss, startling her.
However, she did not refuse it, especially since they had kissed before.
"Are you worried about me?"
Millia pouted her lips and moved away from Zhang Fei immediately.
"You are my princess's man, and my queen also likes you; therefore, I don't want anything to happen to you."
"Don't worry, the demon miasma has no effect on me." Zhang Fei then planted the third blood demon tree there, and he immediately went to meet Lillea.
Seeing his departure, Millia rubbed her own lips, and a sweet smile appeared on her mature face before leaving the garden.

"Earlier, Oz came here to see me, and he told me a few things." Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that, and Lillea told him about her conversation with the second demon lord, causing him to be even more surprised.
"What about your plans for the Amaris Twins?"

"My plan has begun, but it still needs some time to run perfectly, or they will realize the trap I placed inside You Han's body, and everything will fail miserably." Lillea nodded in understanding at Zhang Fei.
"Anyway, I didn't expect that the white Amaris also had the power of light, and I think Oz's guess about her might be right.
However, I don't want to think about her for now, and I will take care of her when the time comes.
Anyway, let's go back to the training space, so you can protect your people better."
"All right."

chapters.title: Chapter 250: Encounter A Demon
paragraphs: [Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 2,800 Qi]
[Reward: 2,800 red jewels.]

Zhang Fei [1], who was adding firewood to the campfire, let out a soft sigh after hearing the notification, especially since the day had changed, but the target he was waiting for still hadn't shown up.

Meanwhile, the six women sat huddled around the campfire, hugging each other as the temperature in the valley continued to drop, and the Qi covering their bodies could not withstand the chilling air, making them extremely cold.

"Do you think those villagers will really make a move on us, brother?" As she stretched both hands toward the campfire, Xia Qianqian inquired, but her body continued to shiver from the cold. "We've waited for so long, and it's already midnight, but there's still no sign of them making a move."

"Ugh! It would be better if we left this place, Fei." Gu Yan groaned and tightly hugged Luo Yu. "This place is too creepy, and this chilling air also penetrates to my bones, making me extremely uncomfortable."

Hearing that, Luo Yu immediately conveyed her idea to Gu Yan and the other women. "How about we dual-cultivate with him in turn? Our passion and his hot yang qi will cause our bodies to warm up, significantly reducing the coldness.
"I agree with you!" Du Yuan and Ning Xiang, who also felt cold, immediately agreed without hesitation.

Zhang Fei [1] laughed as he listened to their words. He then glanced at Mu Lingshu, who appeared awkward, particularly because she was still a virgin, and felt extremely embarrassed if she had to watch them dual-cultivate with him in front of her.

Xia Qianqian, who was sitting right next to Mu Lingshu, immediately noticed her expression. She smiled faintly before standing up from her seat and moving to Zhang Fei [1]'s laps. She put her arms around his neck as she whispered to him. 'What if we do it in front of Senior Sister Lingshu, brother?
Maybe if he watches us dual-cultivate, she'll feel something, and it would be great for her if she could actually feel it.'

'No.' Zhang Fei [1] denied Xia Qianqian's words. 'Lingshu's abnormality is really unusual, and I'm sure that she won't get turned on even if she watches us dual-cultivate. Instead, our activities will make her feel even more awkward and embarrassed, especially since she always distances himself from such a thing.'

Xia Qianqian then looked at Mu Lingshu with a look of pity, particularly because dual cultivation had always brought her immense pleasure. She felt sorry for her because she couldn't experience the same pleasure as she and the other women. "Brother, I-"

Xia Qianqian didn't continue her sentence because they suddenly felt a cold air sweeping over them, which was much colder than before, coming from the direction of the village. They immediately jumped to their feet while taking out their respective weapons, and they also released their Qi to prepare for the enemies' attacks.

Sensing that unusual aura, Zhang Fei [1] stood up in front of the women as he took out the demon exterminating sword, which immediately vibrated with excitement. 'Hmm? Demon, huh? Otherwise, my sword wouldn't be this excited, and it's so eager to attack them.'
Not long after, Zhang Fei [1] and the others saw the villagers walking towards them, but their appearances no longer looked like humans, and they looked like living corpses instead.
'Ugh! What's wrong with them? Why did their appearances turn so horribly?' Gu Yan inquired quietly, hiding behind Zhang Fei [1].

Xia Qianqian and the other women were also shocked to see the changes in the villagers' appearances, but Zhang Fei [1] immediately calmed them down while observing the map, which is filled with red dots as many as the number of people. 'What really happened to them, Mei? You told me before that there was nothing strange about them, but they've become like that now.'

[Based on the system scan, they are no longer humans but living corpses.] Mei's answer made Zhang Fei [1] frown. [In this universe, there are many cultivators with strange abilities, such as ghost and corpse cultivators, who have the ability to control ghosts and corpses.]

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding, especially since he had also read about them in his old novels about cultivators and the like. 'If that's the case, that means these people have been dead for a long time, and a corpse cultivator uses their corpses for certain purposes.
However, I am a little confused about them, especially since their aura and appearance were previously no different from humans, and the map did not show any hostile signs from them.'

[I don't have a definite answer to that, Master. Perhaps the corpse cultivator who turned them into this state used a method to disguise their death aura, and the system couldn't detect it. Anyway, I've been trying to track down the mastermind behind this incident, but I haven't been able to find him or her, so I think you should lure him or her out by destroying these living corpses.]
'Could the mastermind be someone from the Pang Clan?' Zhang Fei [1] suspected that, especially since that clan was the only one he knew to possess evil techniques.
"What should we do now, brother? Do we have to fight them?" Xia Qianqian fearfully asked Zhang Fei [1], especially since those living corpses were getting closer to them.

"Yes, we will fight them and destroy them." They were shocked to hear Zhang Fei's [1] answer. "These people have actually been dead for a long time, and a corpse cultivator purposefully used their corpses to harm the cultivators who came to this area. If my guess is correct, the person who issued the mission was the mastermind behind their condition, and he or she deliberately lured us into a trap."

Mu Lingshu nodded in agreement and said to them. "I also heard about the corpse cultivators, and these people do indeed resemble the characteristics of the living corpses used by them as weapons, so it would be better if we made a move now to end their suffering once and for all."

"You guys don't need to move, and I'll take care of them myself." Zhang Fei [1] said that as he transformed into his half-fox form with four long tails dancing behind him, his action stunned Mu Lingshu, who was seeing his other form for the first time.

Without delay, Zhang Fei [1] teleported above the crowd of those living corpses, and he also used his sword element method to channel his light qi into the demon exterminating sword before dancing among the crowd.

"Hey, guys, is he a demihuman?" Mu Lingshu asked, her eyes moving to follow Zhang Fei [1]'s movements. She was surprised to find that his sword skills were quite good, even though his swordmanship was still not as good as hers.

Luo Yu shook her head and answered him. "I find it hard to explain to you, but Zhang Fei [1] is not a demihuman. In fact, he is a full-fledged human, but he is also a full-fledged fox beast, and his current form is his half-fox form, so he looks like a demihuman."
"Besides, he still has one more form, and that's—Mhn!"

Luo Yu immediately stopped Gu Yan by covering her mouth with her hand, especially since Zhang Fei [1]'s other form was a demon, and not everyone could accept the presence of demons among them. Moreover, they didn't know Mu Lingshu that well, and she was worried that she would hate him if she knew his third form.
"Why did you stop her? What exactly is his other form?" Mu Lingshu asked Luo Yu with a frown.
Luo Yu immediately rejected Mu Lingshu. "Sorry, I won't tell you about his third form, and you can ask him directly if you are curious about it."
Luo Yu's answer made Mu Lingshu frown even more, but she suddenly felt something coming from behind them, so she immediately moved to attack it.
*Clang*
However, it immediately deflected her attack before it struck back at Mu Lingshu, which hit her chest and sent her flying far back, and her expression was a little hurt by it.
Seeing that, Du Yuan immediately moved to catch Mu Lingshu, and she landed near the other women again. "Are you all right?"
"Yeah, I'm fine." Mu Lingshu immediately wiped away the blood on the corners of her lips. "I think that creature is the mastermind behind this incident."

Du Yuan and the others were shocked after they looked at the creature, because its appearance was much more terrifying than that of the villagers. Its body resembled a skinless skeleton, complemented by dark green eyes.

"Keh... keh... keh..." The creature laughed eerily as its body slowly changed before becoming a human woman, and she then licked her lips as she stared coldly at Mu Lingshu and the others. "It's been a while since humans have come here, and I'm really hungry now, so I'm going to eat you all, like the humans who came here before you."
Xia Qianqian and the others shuddered upon hearing that, and the woman immediately moved towards them to capture them, making them panic, especially since her strength was far above theirs.
Fortunately, Zhang Fei [1], who was slaughtering those living corpses, noticed this and immediately teleported in front of his partners before kicking the woman away.

"Gyah!" The woman screamed in pain from Zhang Fei [1]'s attack, especially since his legs were covered by his light element, which was her nemesis. However, she landed directly on the ground and glared at him fiercely, not daring to attack him directly. 'How can a demihuman like him have such a potent light element?'

"At first, I thought it was a corpse cultivator who made the villagers like that, but I didn't expect the culprit to be a demon." Zhang Fei observed the woman with seriousness. 'Show her status, Mei.'
[Wait a minute.]
Name: Arshila
Age: 3000+ Years Old
Gender: Female
Race: Lich
Rank: Marchioness
Element: Dark
Physique: Undead Demon
Abilities: Necro Power, Fear Aura, Necromancy, Dark Arts, Soul Manipulation, etc.
Strong: Darkness
Weak: Light
'Marchioness rank demon, huh?' Zhang Fei [1] muttered inwardly, but his expression changed slightly upon reading Arshila's abilities, as her necromancy piqued his interest.
[Do you intend to mimic her necromancy, master?]
'Yes.' Zhang Fei [1] replied with a slight nod. 'Her soul manipulation should be quite good, but I'm not interested in that, and her necromancy is much more useful.'

Suddenly, the six women attacked him from behind, but he immediately dodged their attacks and swiftly knocked them unconscious before sending them into the training space. He then frowned at Arshila, as he was sure that she was using her soul manipulation on them. "You're a demon from the Netherworld realm, right?
Anyway, you've made a fatal mistake in using your ability to control their souls, and I will never forgive anyone who dares to use those closest to me."
[Anyway, you have to be careful, Master. Even though her rank is marchioness, she is much stronger than Lillea, and you should summon Boitata to deal with her.]
'I know, Mei.'
"How... how do you know about my realm?" Arshila asked with a shocked expression, especially since no one in the Sky Jade Realm should know about that realm.

"If my guess is correct, you must be one of the demons they purposefully left behind in this realm to prepare for their next invasion, right?" Arshila frowned upon hearing Zhang Fei [1]'s words, but her expression changed as soon as he turned into a demon. "As you can see, I am also a demon, but I am different from you."
"Impossible!" Arshila shouted loudly to Zhang Fei [1]. "You clearly have a light element! How can you be a demon?"
"You're going to die soon, so I'm not going to waste my time with you." Zhang Fei [1] said so with a shake of his head.

"Ha ha ha!" After hearing that, Arshila burst into laughter. "Do you think a viscount-rank demon like you can kill me? Heh! I don't know how you can transform into a beast and a demon, but you're still not my opponent, even if you have such a strong light element."
"Hmm? " Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows as all of the skeletons in the area stood up, and many ghosts came out from the ground, immediately encircling him.
[Master, they are the ghosts of the villagers and the people who came here before, so it would be better if you killed Arshila immediately, and these ghosts can be free from her control.]
